text: Æfter Matheus gerecednysse, hēr is on cnēorisse bōc Hǣlendes Crīstes, Dauides suna, Abrahames suna.
text_bare: Æfter Matheus gerecednysse, her is on cneorisse boc Hælendes Cristes, Dauides suna, Abrahames suna.

text: Sōðlīce Abraham gestrȳnde Isaac; Isaac gestrȳnde Iacob; Iacob gestrȳnde Iudam and his gebrōðra;
text_bare: Soðlice Abraham gestrynde Isaac; Isaac gestrynde Iacob; Iacob gestrynde Iudam and his gebroðra;

text: Iudas gestrȳnde Phares and Zaram of þām wīfe þe wæs genemned Thamar; Phares gestrȳnde Esrom; Esrom gestrȳnde Aram;
text_bare: Iudas gestrynde Phares and Zaram of þam wife þe wæs genemned Thamar; Phares gestrynde Esrom; Esrom gestrynde Aram;

text: Aram gestrȳnde Aminadab; Aminadab gestrȳnde Naason; Naason gestrȳnde Salmon;
text_bare: Aram gestrynde Aminadab; Aminadab gestrynde Naason; Naason gestrynde Salmon;

text: Salmon gestrȳnde Booz of þām wīfe Raab; Booz gestrȳnde Obeth of þām wīfe Ruth; Obeth gestrȳnde Iesse;
text_bare: Salmon gestrynde Booz of þam wife Raab; Booz gestrynde Obeth of þam wife Ruth; Obeth gestrynde Iesse;

text: Iesse gestrȳnde þone cyning Dauid; Dauid cyning gestrȳnde Salomon of þām wīfe þe wæs Urias wīf.
text_bare: Iesse gestrynde þone cyning Dauid; Dauid cyning gestrynde Salomon of þam wife þe wæs Urias wif.

text: Salomon gestrȳnde Roboam; Roboas gestrȳnde Abiam; Abia gestrȳnde Asa;
text_bare: Salomon gestrynde Roboam; Roboas gestrynde Abiam; Abia gestrynde Asa;

text: Asa gestrȳnde Iosaphath; Iosaphath gestrȳnde Ioram; Ioras gestrȳnde Oziam;
text_bare: Asa gestrynde Iosaphath; Iosaphath gestrynde Ioram; Ioras gestrynde Oziam;

text: Ozias gestrȳnde Ioatham; Ioatham gestrȳnde Achaz; Achaz gestrȳnde Ezechiam;
text_bare: Ozias gestrynde Ioatham; Ioatham gestrynde Achaz; Achaz gestrynde Ezechiam;

text: Ezechias gestrȳnde Mannasen; Mannases gestrȳnde Amon; Amon gestrȳnde Iosiam;
text_bare: Ezechias gestrynde Mannasen; Mannases gestrynde Amon; Amon gestrynde Iosiam;

text: Iosias gestrȳnde Iechoniam and his gebroþru, on Babilonis gelēorednysse.
text_bare: Iosias gestrynde Iechoniam and his gebroþru, on Babilonis geleorednysse.

text: And æfter Babilonys gelēorednysse, Iechonias gestrȳnde Salathiel; Salathiel gestrȳnde Zorobabel;
text_bare: And æfter Babilonys geleorednysse, Iechonias gestrynde Salathiel; Salathiel gestrynde Zorobabel;

text: Zorobabel gestrȳnde Abiud; Abiud gestrȳnde Eliachim ; Eliachim gestrȳnde Azor;
text_bare: Zorobabel gestrynde Abiud; Abiud gestrynde Eliachim ; Eliachim gestrynde Azor;

text: Azor gestrȳnde Sadoc; Sadoc gestrȳnde Achim; Achim gestrȳnde Eliud;
text_bare: Azor gestrynde Sadoc; Sadoc gestrynde Achim; Achim gestrynde Eliud;

text: Eliud gestrȳnde Eleazar; Eleazar gestrȳnde Mathan; Mathan gestrȳnde Iacob;
text_bare: Eliud gestrynde Eleazar; Eleazar gestrynde Mathan; Mathan gestrynde Iacob;

text: Iacob gestrȳnde Ioseph Marian wer, of þǣre wæs ācenned'sē Hǣlend þe is genemned Crīst.
text_bare: Iacob gestrynde Ioseph Marian wer, of þære wæs acenned'se Hælend þe is genemned Crist.

text: Eornostlīce ealle cnēoressa fram Abrahame oð Dauid synd fēowertȳne cnēoressa; and fram Dauide oð Babilonis gelēorednysse fēowertȳne cnēoressa; and fram Babilonis gelēorednesse oð Crīst fēowertȳne cnēoressa.
text_bare: Eornostlice ealle cneoressa fram Abrahame oð Dauid synd feowertyne cneoressa; and fram Dauide oð Babilonis geleorednysse feowertyne cneoressa; and fram Babilonis geleorednesse oð Crist feowertyne cneoressa.

text: Sōðlīce þus wæs Crīstes cnēores: Ðā þæs Hǣlendes mōdor Maria wæs Iosepe beweddod, ǣr hī tōsomne becōmun, hēo wæs gemēt on innoðe hæbbende of þām Hālegan Gāste.
text_bare: Soðlice þus wæs Cristes cneores: Ða þæs Hælendes modor Maria wæs Iosepe beweddod, ær hi tosomne becomun, heo wæs gemet on innoðe hæbbende of þam Halegan Gaste.

text: Sōðlīce Iosep hyre wer, ðā hē wæs rihtwīs and nolde hī gewīdmǣrsian, hē wolde hī dīhlīce forlǣtan.
text_bare: Soðlice Iosep hyre wer, ða he wæs rihtwis and nolde hi gewidmærsian, he wolde hi dihlice forlætan.

text: Him þā sōðlīce ðās þing ðencendum Drihtnes engel on swefnum ætȳwde, and him tō cwæð, Iosep, Dauides sunu, nelle þū ondrǣdan Marian þīne gemæccean tō onfōnne; þæt on hire ācenned ys, hyt ys of þām Hālgan Gāste.
text_bare: Him þa soðlice ðas þing ðencendum Drihtnes engel on swefnum ætywde, and him to cwæð, Iosep, Dauides sunu, nelle þu ondrædan Marian þine gemæccean to onfonne; þæt on hire acenned ys, hyt ys of þam Halgan Gaste.

text: Witodlīce hēo cenð sunu, and þū nemst hys naman Hǣlend; hē sōðlīce hys folc hāl gedēð fram hyra synnum.
text_bare: Witodlice heo cenð sunu, and þu nemst hys naman Hælend; he soðlice hys folc hal gedeð fram hyra synnum.

text: Sōþlīce eal þys wæs geworden þæt gefylled wǣre þæt fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh þone wītegan,
text_bare: Soþlice eal þys wæs geworden þæt gefylled wære þæt fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh þone witegan,

text: Sōðlīce sēo fǣmne hæfð on innoðe, and hēo cenð sunu, and hī nemnað his naman Emanuhel, þæt ys gereht on ūre geþēode, God mid ūs.
text_bare: Soðlice seo fæmne hæfð on innoðe, and heo cenð sunu, and hi nemnað his naman Emanuhel, þæt ys gereht on ure geþeode, God mid us.

text: Ðā ārās Iosep of swefene, and dyde swā Drihtnes engel him bebēad, and hē onfēng his gemæccean;
text_bare: Ða aras Iosep of swefene, and dyde swa Drihtnes engel him bebead, and he onfeng his gemæccean;

text: and hē ne grētte hī.
text_bare: and he ne grette hi.

text: Hēo cende hyre frumcennedan sunu, and nemde hys naman Hǣlend.
text_bare: Heo cende hyre frumcennedan sunu, and nemde hys naman Hælend.

text: Eornustlīce þā sē Hǣlend ācenned wæs on Iudeiscre Bethleem, on þæs cyninges dagum Herodes, þā cōmon þā tungolwītegan fram ēastdǣle tō Hierusalem,
text_bare: Eornustlice þa se Hælend acenned wæs on Iudeiscre Bethleem, on þæs cyninges dagum Herodes, þa comon þa tungolwitegan fram eastdæle to Hierusalem,

text: and cwǣdon, Hwǣr ys sē Iudea Cyning þe ācenned ys?
text_bare: and cwædon, Hwær ys se Iudea Cyning þe acenned ys?

text: Sōðlīce wē gesāwon hys steorran on ēastdǣle, and wē cōmon ūs him tō geēadmēdenne.
text_bare: Soðlice we gesawon hys steorran on eastdæle, and we comon us him to geeadmedenne.

text: Ðā Herodes þæt gehȳrde, ðā wearð hē gedrēfed and eal Hierosolimwaru mid him.
text_bare: Ða Herodes þæt gehyrde, ða wearð he gedrefed and eal Hierosolimwaru mid him.

text: And þā gegaderode Herodes ealle ealdras þǣra sācerda and folces wrīteras, and āxode hwǣr Crīst ācenned wǣre.
text_bare: And þa gegaderode Herodes ealle ealdras þæra sacerda and folces writeras, and axode hwær Crist acenned wære.

text: Ðā sǣdon hī him.
text_bare: Ða sædon hi him.

text: On Iudeiscere Bethlem; witodlīce þus ys āwriten þurh þone wītegan,
text_bare: On Iudeiscere Bethlem; witodlice þus ys awriten þurh þone witegan,

text: And þū Bethleem, Iudea land, witodlīce ne eart þū lǣst on Iuda ealdrum; of ðē forð gǣð sē heretoga sē þe recð mīn folc Israhel.
text_bare: And þu Bethleem, Iudea land, witodlice ne eart þu læst on Iuda ealdrum; of ðe forð gæð se heretoga se þe recð min folc Israhel.

text: Herodes þā clypode on sundersprǣce ðā tungelwītegan, and befrān hī georne hwænne sē steorra him ætēowde.
text_bare: Herodes þa clypode on sunderspræce ða tungelwitegan, and befran hi georne hwænne se steorra him æteowde.

text: And hē āsende hī tō Bethlem, and ðus cwæð, Farað and āxiað geornlīce be þām cilde; and þonne gē hyt gemētað, cȳþað eft mē, þæt ic cume and mē tō him gebidde.
text_bare: And he asende hi to Bethlem, and ðus cwæð, Farað and axiað geornlice be þam cilde; and þonne ge hyt gemetað, cyþað eft me, þæt ic cume and me to him gebidde.

text: Ðā hī þæt gebod gehȳrdon, þā fērdon hī; and sōþlīce sē steorra þe hī on ēastdǣle gesāwon him beforan fērde, oð hē stōd ofer þǣr þæt cild wæs.
text_bare: Ða hi þæt gebod gehyrdon, þa ferdon hi; and soþlice se steorra þe hi on eastdæle gesawon him beforan ferde, oð he stod ofer þær þæt cild wæs.

text: Sōþlīce þā ðā tungelwītegan þone steorran gesāwon, fægenodon swȳðe myclum gefēan.
text_bare: Soþlice þa ða tungelwitegan þone steorran gesawon, fægenodon swyðe myclum gefean.

text: And gangende intō þām hūse hī gemētton þæt cild mid Marian hys mēder; and hī āðenedon hī, and hī tō him gebǣdon; and hī untȳndon hyra goldhordas, and him lāc brōhton, þæt wæs gold and rēcels and myrre.
text_bare: And gangende into þam huse hi gemetton þæt cild mid Marian hys meder; and hi aðenedon hi, and hi to him gebædon; and hi untyndon hyra goldhordas, and him lac brohton, þæt wæs gold and recels and myrre.

text: And hī āfēngon andsware on swefnum þæt hī eft tō Herode ne hwyrfdon; ac hī on ōðerne weg on hyra rīce fērdon.
text_bare: And hi afengon andsware on swefnum þæt hi eft to Herode ne hwyrfdon; ac hi on oðerne weg on hyra rice ferdon.

text: Þā hī þā fērdon, þā ætȳwde Drihtnes engel Iosepe on swefnum, and þus cwæð, Ārīs and nim þæt cild and his mōdor, and flēoh on Egypta land, and bēo þǣr oð þæt ic ðē secge; tōweard ys þæt Herodes sēcð þæt cild tō forspillenne.
text_bare: Þa hi þa ferdon, þa ætywde Drihtnes engel Iosepe on swefnum, and þus cwæð, Aris and nim þæt cild and his modor, and fleoh on Egypta land, and beo þær oð þæt ic ðe secge; toweard ys þæt Herodes secð þæt cild to forspillenne.

text: Hē ārās þā and nam þæt cild and his mōdor on niht, and fērde on Egyptum;
text_bare: He aras þa and nam þæt cild and his modor on niht, and ferde on Egyptum;

text: and wæs þǣr oð Herodes forðsīð: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, Of Egyptum ic mīnne sunu geclypode.
text_bare: and wæs þær oð Herodes forðsið: þæt wære gefylled þæt ðe fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh ðone witegan, Of Egyptum ic minne sunu geclypode.

text: Ðā wæs Herodes swȳde gebolgen, for þām þe he beþǣht wæs fram þām tungelwītegum, and hē āsende þā and ofslōh ealle þā cild þe on Bethleem wǣron, and on eallum hire gemǣrum, fram twȳwintrum cilde and binnan þām, æfter þǣre tīde þe hē geāxode fram ðām tungelwītegum.
text_bare: Ða wæs Herodes swyde gebolgen, for þam þe he beþæht wæs fram þam tungelwitegum, and he asende þa and ofsloh ealle þa cild þe on Bethleem wæron, and on eallum hire gemærum, fram twywintrum cilde and binnan þam, æfter þære tide þe he geaxode fram ðam tungelwitegum.

text: Ðā wæs gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh Hieremiam þone wītegan,
text_bare: Ða wæs gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh Hieremiam þone witegan,

text: Stefn wæs on hēhnysse gehȳred, wōp and mycel þotorung; Rachel wēop hyre bearn, and hēo nolde bēon gefrēfred, for þām þe hī nǣron.
text_bare: Stefn wæs on hehnysse gehyred, wop and mycel þotorung; Rachel weop hyre bearn, and heo nolde beon gefrefred, for þam þe hi næron.

text: Sōðlīce þā Herodes wæs forð faren, witodlīce on swefne Drihtnes engel ætȳwde Iosepe on Egyptum,
text_bare: Soðlice þa Herodes wæs forð faren, witodlice on swefne Drihtnes engel ætywde Iosepe on Egyptum,

text: and þus cwæð, Ārīs and nim þæt cild and his mōdor, and far on Israhela land; nū synd forð farene þe ðæs cildes sāwle sōhton.
text_bare: and þus cwæð, Aris and nim þæt cild and his modor, and far on Israhela land; nu synd forð farene þe ðæs cildes sawle sohton.

text: Hē ārās ðā and onfēng þæt cild and his mōdor, and cōm on Israhela land.
text_bare: He aras ða and onfeng þæt cild and his modor, and com on Israhela land.

text: Ðā hē gehȳrde þæt Archelaus rīxode on Iudea þēode for ðone fæder Herodem, hē ondrēd þyder tō faranne; and on swefnum gemynegod hē fērde on Galileisce dǣlas,
text_bare: Ða he gehyrde þæt Archelaus rixode on Iudea þeode for ðone fæder Herodem, he ondred þyder to faranne; and on swefnum gemynegod he ferde on Galileisce dælas,

text: and hē cōm þā and eardode on þǣre ceastre ðe is genemned Nazareth: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, for þām ðe hē Nazarenisc byð genemned.
text_bare: and he com þa and eardode on þære ceastre ðe is genemned Nazareth: þæt wære gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh ðone witegan, for þam ðe he Nazarenisc byð genemned.

text: On þām dagum cōm Iohannes sē fulluhtere, and bodude on þām wēstene Iudee,
text_bare: On þam dagum com Iohannes se fulluhtere, and bodude on þam westene Iudee,

text: and cwæð, Dōþ dǣdbōte; sōðlīce genēalǣceð heofona rīce.
text_bare: and cwæð, Doþ dædbote; soðlice genealæceð heofona rice.

text: Ðis ys sē be þām þe gecweden ys þurh Esaiam ðone wītegan, Clypiendes stefn wæs on wēstene, Gegearwiað Drihtnes weg, dōþ his sīðas rihte.
text_bare: Ðis ys se be þam þe gecweden ys þurh Esaiam ðone witegan, Clypiendes stefn wæs on westene, Gegearwiað Drihtnes weg, doþ his siðas rihte.

text: Sē Iohannes witodlīce hæfde rēaf of olfenda hǣrum, and fellenne gyrdel embe hys lendenu; and hys mete wæs gærstapan and wuduhunig.
text_bare: Se Iohannes witodlice hæfde reaf of olfenda hærum, and fellenne gyrdel embe hys lendenu; and hys mete wæs gærstapan and wuduhunig.

text: Ðā fērde tō him Hierosolimwaru and eal Iudea ðēod, and eal þæt rīce wiðgeondan Iordanen.
text_bare: Ða ferde to him Hierosolimwaru and eal Iudea ðeod, and eal þæt rice wiðgeondan Iordanen.

text: And hī wǣron gefullode on Iordane fram him, and hī andettan hyra synna.
text_bare: And hi wæron gefullode on Iordane fram him, and hi andettan hyra synna.

text: Sōðlīce þā hē geseh manega þǣra sunderhālgena and þǣra rihtwīsendra tō his fulluhte cumende, hē cwæð tō him, Lā, nǣddrena cyn, hwā geswutelode ēow to flēonne fram þām tōweardan yrre?
text_bare: Soðlice þa he geseh manega þæra sunderhalgena and þæra rihtwisendra to his fulluhte cumende, he cwæð to him, La, næddrena cyn, hwa geswutelode eow to fleonne fram þam toweardan yrre?

text: Eornostlīce dōþ medemne wæstm þǣre dǣdbōte;
text_bare: Eornostlice doþ medemne wæstm þære dædbote;

text: and ne cweþað betwux ēow, Wē habbað Abraham ūs tō fæder.
text_bare: and ne cweþað betwux eow, We habbað Abraham us to fæder.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt God ys swā mihtig þæt hē mæg of þysum stānum āweccean Abrahames bearn.
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow þæt God ys swa mihtig þæt he mæg of þysum stanum aweccean Abrahames bearn.

text: Eallunga ys sēo æx tō ðǣra trēowa wurtrumum āsett.
text_bare: Eallunga ys seo æx to ðæra treowa wurtrumum asett.

text: Eornustlīce ǣlc trēow þe gōdne wæstm ne bringð byð forcorfen, and on fȳr āworpen.
text_bare: Eornustlice ælc treow þe godne wæstm ne bringð byð forcorfen, and on fyr aworpen.

text: Witodlīce ic ēo wfullige on wætere tō dǣdbōte.
text_bare: Witodlice ic eo wfullige on wætere to dædbote.

text: Sē þe æfter mē tōwerd ys, hē ys strengra Þonne ic, ðæs gescȳ neom ic wyrðe tō berenne; hē ēow fullað on Hālgum Gāste and on fȳre:
text_bare: Se þe æfter me towerd ys, he ys strengra Þonne ic, ðæs gescy neom ic wyrðe to berenne; he eow fullað on Halgum Gaste and on fyre:

text: ðes fann ys on his handa, and hē āfeormað his þyrscelflōre; and hē gegaderað hys hwǣte on his bern; þā ceafu hē forbærnð on unādwǣscendlīcum fȳre.
text_bare: ðes fann ys on his handa, and he afeormað his þyrscelflore; and he gegaderað hys hwæte on his bern; þa ceafu he forbærnð on unadwæscendlicum fyre.

text: Þā cōm sē Hǣlend fram Galilea tō Iordane tō Iohanne þæt hē hine fullode.
text_bare: Þa com se Hælend fram Galilea to Iordane to Iohanne þæt he hine fullode.

text: Iohannes þā sōðlīce forbēad him, and cwæð, Ic sceal fram þē bēon gefullod, and cymst ðū tō mē?
text_bare: Iohannes þa soðlice forbead him, and cwæð, Ic sceal fram þe beon gefullod, and cymst ðu to me?

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend him and cwæð.

text: Lǣt nū; þus unc gedafnað ealle rihtwīsnesse gefyllan.
text_bare: Læt nu; þus unc gedafnað ealle rihtwisnesse gefyllan.

text: Þā forlēt hē hine.
text_bare: Þa forlet he hine.

text: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend gefullod wæs, hrædlīce hē āstāh of ðām wætere; and him wurdon þǣrrihte heofenas ontȳnede, and hē geseah Godes Gāst niþer stīgende swā swā culfran, and wunigende ofer hine.
text_bare: Soþlice þa se Hælend gefullod wæs, hrædlice he astah of ðam wætere; and him wurdon þærrihte heofenas ontynede, and he geseah Godes Gast niþer stigende swa swa culfran, and wunigende ofer hine.

text: And sōðlīce þā cōm stefn of heofenum, and þus cwæð, Hēr is mīn gecorena Sunu on þām mē gelīcode.
text_bare: And soðlice þa com stefn of heofenum, and þus cwæð, Her is min gecorena Sunu on þam me gelicode.

text: Ðā wæs sē Hǣlend gelǣd fram Gāste on wēsten þæt hē wǣre fram dēofle costud.
text_bare: Ða wæs se Hælend gelæd fram Gaste on westen þæt he wære fram deofle costud.

text: And þā þā hē fæste fēowurtig daga and fēowurtig nihta, þā ongan hyne syððan hingrian.
text_bare: And þa þa he fæste feowurtig daga and feowurtig nihta, þa ongan hyne syððan hingrian.

text: And þā genēalǣhte sē costniend, and cwæð, Gyf þū Godes Sunu sȳ, cweð þæt þās stānas tō hlāfe gewurðon.
text_bare: And þa genealæhte se costniend, and cwæð, Gyf þu Godes Sunu sy, cweð þæt þas stanas to hlafe gewurðon.

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend, Hit ys āwriten, Ne leofað sē man be hlāfe ānum, ac be ǣlcon worde þe of Godes mūðe gǣð.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend, Hit ys awriten, Ne leofað se man be hlafe anum, ac be ælcon worde þe of Godes muðe gæð.

text: Þā gebrōhte sē dēofol hine on þā hālgan ceastre, and āsette hine ofer þæs temples hēahnesse,
text_bare: Þa gebrohte se deofol hine on þa halgan ceastre, and asette hine ofer þæs temples heahnesse,

text: and cwæð tō him, Gyf þū Godes Sunu eart, āsend þē þonne nyðer; sōþlīce hit ys āwriten, Þæt hē his englum bebēad be ðē, þæt hig þē on hyra handum beron, þē lǣs þe ðīn fōt æt stāne ætsporne.
text_bare: and cwæð to him, Gyf þu Godes Sunu eart, asend þe þonne nyðer; soþlice hit ys awriten, Þæt he his englum bebead be ðe, þæt hig þe on hyra handum beron, þe læs þe ðin fot æt stane ætsporne.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend eft tō him, Hit ys āwriten, Ne costna þū Drihten þīnne God.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend eft to him, Hit ys awriten, Ne costna þu Drihten þinne God.

text: Eft sē dēofol hine genam, and lǣdde hine on swīðe hēahne munt, and ætēowde him ealle middaneardes rīcu and hyra wuldor,
text_bare: Eft se deofol hine genam, and lædde hine on swiðe heahne munt, and æteowde him ealle middaneardes ricu and hyra wuldor,

text: and cwæþ tō him, Ealle þās ic sylle þē, gyf þū feallende tō mē geēadmētst.
text_bare: and cwæþ to him, Ealle þas ic sylle þe, gyf þu feallende to me geeadmetst.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gang þū sceocca on bæc; sōþlīce hit ys āwriten, Tō Drihtne þīnum Gode þū ðē geēaðmētsð, and him ānum þēowast.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Gang þu sceocca on bæc; soþlice hit ys awriten, To Drihtne þinum Gode þu ðe geeaðmetsð, and him anum þeowast.

text: Ðā forlēt sē dēofol hine, and englas genēalǣhton and him þēnodon.
text_bare: Ða forlet se deofol hine, and englas genealæhton and him þenodon.

text: Sōðlīce þā sē Hǣlend gehȳrde þæt Iohannes belǣwed wæs, þā fērde hē tō Galileam;
text_bare: Soðlice þa se Hælend gehyrde þæt Iohannes belæwed wæs, þa ferde he to Galileam;

text: and forlǣtenre þǣre ceastre Nazareth, hē cōm and eardode on Capharnaum, on þām sǣgemǣrum, on endum Zabulon and Neptalim:
text_bare: and forlætenre þære ceastre Nazareth, he com and eardode on Capharnaum, on þam sægemærum, on endum Zabulon and Neptalim:

text: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh Esaiam þone wītegan,
text_bare: þæt wære gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh Esaiam þone witegan,

text: Ðēoda folc ðe on þȳstrum sæt geseah mycel lēoht, and sittendum on earde dēaþes sceade is lēoht ūp āsprungen.
text_bare: Ðeoda folc ðe on þystrum sæt geseah mycel leoht, and sittendum on earde deaþes sceade is leoht up asprungen.

text: Syððan ongan sē Hǣlend bodian and cweðan, Dōð dǣdbōte; sōðlīce heofona rīce genēalǣcð.
text_bare: Syððan ongan se Hælend bodian and cweðan, Doð dædbote; soðlice heofona rice genealæcð.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend ēode wið ðā Galileiscean sǣ, hē geseh twēgen gebrōðru, Symonem, sē wæs genemned Petrus, and Andream his brōþor, sendende hyra nett on þā sǣ; sōðlīce hī wǣron fisceras.
text_bare: Þa se Hælend eode wið ða Galileiscean sæ, he geseh twegen gebroðru, Symonem, se wæs genemned Petrus, and Andream his broþor, sendende hyra nett on þa sæ; soðlice hi wæron fisceras.

text: And hē sǣde him, Cumað æfter mē, and ic dō þæt gyt bēoð manna fisceras.
text_bare: And he sæde him, Cumað æfter me, and ic do þæt gyt beoð manna fisceras.

text: And hī þǣrrihte forlēton hyra net, and him fyligdon.
text_bare: And hi þærrihte forleton hyra net, and him fyligdon.

text: And þā hē þanon ēode, he geseh twēgen ōðre gebrōþru, Iacobum Zebedei and Iohannem his brōþur, on scype mid hyra fæder Zebedeo, rēnigende hyra nett, and hē clypode hī.
text_bare: And þa he þanon eode, he geseh twegen oðre gebroþru, Iacobum Zebedei and Iohannem his broþur, on scype mid hyra fæder Zebedeo, renigende hyra nett, and he clypode hi.

text: Hī ðā sōna forlēton hyra nett and hyra fæder, and him fylidon.
text_bare: Hi ða sona forleton hyra nett and hyra fæder, and him fylidon.

text: And þā befērde sē Hǣlend ealle Galileam, lǣrende on hyra gesomnungum; and hē wæs bodiende godspel þæs rīces, and hǣlende ǣlce ādle and ǣlce untrumnysse on þām folce.
text_bare: And þa beferde se Hælend ealle Galileam, lærende on hyra gesomnungum; and he wæs bodiende godspel þæs rices, and hælende ælce adle and ælce untrumnysse on þam folce.

text: And ðā fērde hys hlīsa intō ealle Syriam; and hī brōhton him ealle yfel hæbbende missenlīcum ādlum and on tintregum gegripene, and þā ðe dēofelsēocnyssa hæfdon, and mōnoðsēoce, and laman, and hē þā gehǣlde.
text_bare: And ða ferde hys hlisa into ealle Syriam; and hi brohton him ealle yfel hæbbende missenlicum adlum and on tintregum gegripene, and þa ðe deofelseocnyssa hæfdon, and monoðseoce, and laman, and he þa gehælde.

text: And him fyligdon mycele menigu fram Galilea, and fram Decapoli, and fram Hierusalem, and fram Iudea, and fram begeondan Iordanen.
text_bare: And him fyligdon mycele menigu fram Galilea, and fram Decapoli, and fram Hierusalem, and fram Iudea, and fram begeondan Iordanen.

text: Sōðlīce þā sē Hǣlend geseh þā menigu, hē āstāh on þone munt; and þā hē sæt, þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas tō him.
text_bare: Soðlice þa se Hælend geseh þa menigu, he astah on þone munt; and þa he sæt, þa genealæhton his leorningcnihtas to him.

text: And hē ontȳnde his mūð and lǣrde hī, and cwæð,
text_bare: And he ontynde his muð and lærde hi, and cwæð,

text: Ēadige synt þā gāstlīcan þearfan, for þām hyra ys heofena rīce.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa gastlican þearfan, for þam hyra ys heofena rice.

text: Ēadige synt þā līðan, for þām þe hī eorðan āgun.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa liðan, for þam þe hi eorðan agun.

text: Ēadige synt þā ðe nū wēpað, for þām þe hī bēoð gefrēfrede.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa ðe nu wepað, for þam þe hi beoð gefrefrede.

text: Ēadige synt þā ðe rihtwīsnesse hingriað and þyrstað, for þām þe hī bēoð gefyllede.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa ðe rihtwisnesse hingriað and þyrstað, for þam þe hi beoð gefyllede.

text: Ēadige synt þā mildheortan, for þām þe hī mildheortnysse begytað.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa mildheortan, for þam þe hi mildheortnysse begytað.

text: Ēadige synt þā clǣnheortan, for þām þe hī God gesēoð.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa clænheortan, for þam þe hi God geseoð.

text: Ēadige synt þā gesybsuman, for þām ðe hī bēoð Godes bearn genemnede.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa gesybsuman, for þam ðe hi beoð Godes bearn genemnede.

text: Ēadige synt þā þe ēhtnysse þoliað for rihtwīsnysse, for þām þe hyra ys heofonan rīce.
text_bare: Eadige synt þa þe ehtnysse þoliað for rihtwisnysse, for þam þe hyra ys heofonan rice.

text: Ēadige synt gē þonne hī wyriað ēow, and ēhtað ēow, and secgeað ǣlc yfel ongēn ēow, lēogende for mē.
text_bare: Eadige synt ge þonne hi wyriað eow, and ehtað eow, and secgeað ælc yfel ongen eow, leogende for me.

text: Geblissiað and gefægniað, for þām þe ēower mēd ys mycel on heofonum; swā hī ēhton þā wītegan þe beforan ēow wǣron.
text_bare: Geblissiað and gefægniað, for þam þe eower med ys mycel on heofonum; swa hi ehton þa witegan þe beforan eow wæron.

text: Gē synt eorþan sealt; gyf þæt sealt āwyrð on þām þe hit gesylt bið, hit ne mæg syððan tō nāhte, būton þæt hit sȳ ūt āworpen, and sȳ fram mannum fortreden.
text_bare: Ge synt eorþan sealt; gyf þæt sealt awyrð on þam þe hit gesylt bið, hit ne mæg syððan to nahte, buton þæt hit sy ut aworpen, and sy fram mannum fortreden.

text: Gē synt middaneardes lēoht.
text_bare: Ge synt middaneardes leoht.

text: Ne mæg sēo ceaster bēon behȳd þe byð uppan munt āset.
text_bare: Ne mæg seo ceaster beon behyd þe byð uppan munt aset.

text: Nē hī ne ǣlað hyra lēohtfæt, and hit under cȳfe settað, ac ofer candelstæf þæt hit onlīhte eallum þe on þām hūse synt.
text_bare: Ne hi ne ælað hyra leohtfæt, and hit under cyfe settað, ac ofer candelstæf þæt hit onlihte eallum þe on þam huse synt.

text: Swā onlīhte ēower lēoht beforan mannum þæt hī gesēon ēowre gōdan weorc, and wuldrian ēowerne Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
text_bare: Swa onlihte eower leoht beforan mannum þæt hi geseon eowre godan weorc, and wuldrian eowerne Fæder þe on heofenum ys.

text: Nelle gē wēnan þæt ic cōme tōwurpan þā ǣ, oððe þā wītegan; ne cōm ic nā tōwurpan, ac gefyllan.
text_bare: Nelle ge wenan þæt ic come towurpan þa æ, oððe þa witegan; ne com ic na towurpan, ac gefyllan.

text: Sōþes on eornost ic secge ēow, Ǣr þām gewīte heofon and eorðe, ān i oððe ān prica ne gewīt fram þǣre ǣ, ǣr þām ealle þing gewurðan.
text_bare: Soþes on eornost ic secge eow, Ær þam gewite heofon and eorðe, an i oððe an prica ne gewit fram þære æ, ær þam ealle þing gewurðan.

text: Eornostlīce sē ðe tōwyrpð ān of þysum lǣstum bebodum, and þā men swā lǣrð, sē byð lǣst genemned on heofonan rīce; sōþlīce sē ðe hit dēð and lǣrð, sē biþ mycel genemned on heofonan rīce.
text_bare: Eornostlice se ðe towyrpð an of þysum læstum bebodum, and þa men swa lærð, se byð læst genemned on heofonan rice; soþlice se ðe hit deð and lærð, se biþ mycel genemned on heofonan rice.

text: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Būton ēower rihtwīsnyss māre sȳ þonne þǣra wrītera and sundorhālgena, ne gā gē on heofonan rīce.
text_bare: Soðlice ic secge eow, Buton eower rihtwisnyss mare sy þonne þæra writera and sundorhalgena, ne ga ge on heofonan rice.

text: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ealdum tīdum, Ne ofsleh þū; sē þe ofslihð, sē byð dōme scyldig.
text_bare: Ge gehyrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ealdum tidum, Ne ofsleh þu; se þe ofslihð, se byð dome scyldig.

text: Ic secge ēow sōþlīce þæt ǣlc þe yrsað hys brēþer byð dōme scyldig; sōþlīce se þe segð hys brēðer, þu āwordena, he byð geþeahte scyldig; sē þe segð, Þū stunta, sē byþ scyldig helle fȳres.
text_bare: Ic secge eow soþlice þæt ælc þe yrsað hys breþer byð dome scyldig; soþlice se þe segð hys breðer, þu awordena, he byð geþeahte scyldig; se þe segð, Þu stunta, se byþ scyldig helle fyres.

text: Eornostlīce gyf þū bringst þīne lāc to wēofode, and þū þǣr geþencst þæt ðīn brōðor hæfð ǣnig þing agēn ðē,
text_bare: Eornostlice gyf þu bringst þine lac to weofode, and þu þær geþencst þæt ðin broðor hæfð ænig þing agen ðe,

text: lǣt þǣr þīne lāc beforan þām altare, and gang ǣr and gesybsuma wið þīnne brōðer, and þonne cum þū syððan and bring þīne lāc.
text_bare: læt þær þine lac beforan þam altare, and gang ær and gesybsuma wið þinne broðer, and þonne cum þu syððan and bring þine lac.

text: Bēo þū onbūgende þīnum wiðerwinnan hraðe, þā hwīle þe ðū eart on wege mid him; þē lǣs þe ðīn wiðerwinna þē sylle ðām dēman, and sē dēma þē sylle ðām þēne, and þū sȳ on cwertern send.
text_bare: Beo þu onbugende þinum wiðerwinnan hraðe, þa hwile þe ðu eart on wege mid him; þe læs þe ðin wiðerwinna þe sylle ðam deman, and se dema þe sylle ðam þene, and þu sy on cwertern send.

text: Sōþes ic secge þē, Ne gǣst þū þanone, ǣr ðū āgylde þone ȳtemestan fēorðling.
text_bare: Soþes ic secge þe, Ne gæst þu þanone, ær ðu agylde þone ytemestan feorðling.

text: Gē gehȳrdon þæt on ealdum cwydum gecweden wæs, Ne unrihthǣme ðū;
text_bare: Ge gehyrdon þæt on ealdum cwydum gecweden wæs, Ne unrihthæme ðu;

text: sōðlīce ic secge ēow þæt ǣlc þǣra þe wīf gesyhð and hyre gewylnað eallunga, þæt sē gesyngað on hys heortan.
text_bare: soðlice ic secge eow þæt ælc þæra þe wif gesyhð and hyre gewylnað eallunga, þæt se gesyngað on hys heortan.

text: Gyf þīn swȳðre ēage þē ǣswicie, āhola hit ūt, and āwurp hyt fram þē; sōðlīce þē ys betere þæt ān þīnra lima forwurþe, þonne eal þīn līchama sī on helle āsend.
text_bare: Gyf þin swyðre eage þe æswicie, ahola hit ut, and awurp hyt fram þe; soðlice þe ys betere þæt an þinra lima forwurþe, þonne eal þin lichama si on helle asend.

text: And gyf þīn swīðre hand þē āswīce, āceorf hī of, and āwurp hī fram þē; witodlīce þē ys betere þæt ān þīnra lima forwurðe, þonne eal þīn līchama fare tō helle.
text_bare: And gyf þin swiðre hand þe aswice, aceorf hi of, and awurp hi fram þe; witodlice þe ys betere þæt an þinra lima forwurðe, þonne eal þin lichama fare to helle.

text: Sōðlīce hit ys gecweden, Swā hwylc swā his wīf forlǣt, hē sylle hyre hyra hīwgedāles bōc.
text_bare: Soðlice hit ys gecweden, Swa hwylc swa his wif forlæt, he sylle hyre hyra hiwgedales boc.

text: Ic secge ēow tō sōðum þæt ǣlc þe his wīf forlǣt būton forlegennysse þingum, hē dēð þæt hēo unrihthǣmð; and sē unrihthǣmð þe forlǣtene æfter him genimð.
text_bare: Ic secge eow to soðum þæt ælc þe his wif forlæt buton forlegennysse þingum, he deð þæt heo unrihthæmð; and se unrihthæmð þe forlætene æfter him genimð.

text: Eft gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ealdum cwydum, Ne forswere þū; sōðlīce Drihtne þū āgyltst þīne āðās.
text_bare: Eft ge gehyrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ealdum cwydum, Ne forswere þu; soðlice Drihtne þu agyltst þine aðas.

text: Ic secge ēow sōþlīce þæt gē eallunga ne swerion, nē þurh heofon, for þām þe hēo ys Godes þrymsetl;
text_bare: Ic secge eow soþlice þæt ge eallunga ne swerion, ne þurh heofon, for þam þe heo ys Godes þrymsetl;

text: nē þurh eorðan, for þām ðe hēo ys hys fōtscamul; nē þurh Hierusalem, for þām þe hēo ys mǣres cyninges ceaster.
text_bare: ne þurh eorðan, for þam ðe heo ys hys fotscamul; ne þurh Hierusalem, for þam þe heo ys mæres cyninges ceaster.

text: Nē ðū ne swere þurh þīn hēafod, for þām þe þū ne miht ǣnne locc gedōn hwītne oððe blacne.
text_bare: Ne ðu ne swere þurh þin heafod, for þam þe þu ne miht ænne locc gedon hwitne oððe blacne.

text: Sōðlīce sī ēower sprǣc, Hyt ys, hyt ys, Hyt nys, hyt nys; sōðlīce gyf þǣr māre byð, þæt bið of yfele.
text_bare: Soðlice si eower spræc, Hyt ys, hyt ys, Hyt nys, hyt nys; soðlice gyf þær mare byð, þæt bið of yfele.

text: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Ēage for ēage, and tōð for tēð;
text_bare: Ge gehyrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Eage for eage, and toð for teð;

text: sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Ne winne gē ongēn þā ðe ēow yfel dōþ; ac gyf hwā þē slēa on þīn swȳþre wenge, gegearwa him þæt ōðer.
text_bare: soþlice ic secge eow, Ne winne ge ongen þa ðe eow yfel doþ; ac gyf hwa þe slea on þin swyþre wenge, gegearwa him þæt oðer.

text: And þām ðe wylle on dōme wið þē flītan, and niman þīne tunecan, lǣt him tō þīnne wǣfels.
text_bare: And þam ðe wylle on dome wið þe flitan, and niman þine tunecan, læt him to þinne wæfels.

text: And swā hwā swā þē genyt þūsend stapa, gā mid him ōðre twā þūsend.
text_bare: And swa hwa swa þe genyt þusend stapa, ga mid him oðre twa þusend.

text: Syle þām ðe þē bidde; and þām ðe wylle æt þē borgian, ne wyrn þū him.
text_bare: Syle þam ðe þe bidde; and þam ðe wylle æt þe borgian, ne wyrn þu him.

text: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Lufa þīnne nēxtan, and hata þinne fēond.
text_bare: Ge gehyrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Lufa þinne nextan, and hata þinne feond.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Lufiað ēowre fȳnd, and dōþ wel þām ðe ēow yfel dōð, and gebiddað for ēowre ēhteras and tǣlendum ēow:
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow, Lufiað eowre fynd, and doþ wel þam ðe eow yfel doð, and gebiddað for eowre ehteras and tælendum eow:

text: þæt gē sīn ēowres Fæder bearn þe on heofonum ys, sē þe dēð þæt hys sunne ūp āspringð ofer þā gōdan and ofer þā yfelan; and hē lǣt rīnan ofer þā rihtwīsan and ofer þā unrihtwīsan.
text_bare: þæt ge sin eowres Fæder bearn þe on heofonum ys, se þe deð þæt hys sunne up aspringð ofer þa godan and ofer þa yfelan; and he læt rinan ofer þa rihtwisan and ofer þa unrihtwisan.

text: Gyf gē sōðlīce þā lufiað þe ēow lufiað, hwylce mēde habbað gē?
text_bare: Gyf ge soðlice þa lufiað þe eow lufiað, hwylce mede habbað ge?

text: hū ne dōð mānfulle swā?
text_bare: hu ne doð manfulle swa?

text: And gyf gē þæt ān dōð þæt gē ēowre gebrōðra wylcumiaþ, hwæt dō gē māre?
text_bare: And gyf ge þæt an doð þæt ge eowre gebroðra wylcumiaþ, hwæt do ge mare?

text: hū ne dōð hǣþene swā?
text_bare: hu ne doð hæþene swa?

text: Eornustllce bēoð fulfremede, swā ēower heofonlīce Fæder is fullfremed.
text_bare: Eornustllce beoð fulfremede, swa eower heofonlice Fæder is fullfremed.

text: Begȳmað þæt gē ne dōn ēowre rihtwīsnesse beforan mannum þæt gē sīn geherede fram him; elles næbbe gē mēde mid ēowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
text_bare: Begymað þæt ge ne don eowre rihtwisnesse beforan mannum þæt ge sin geherede fram him; elles næbbe ge mede mid eowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.

text: Eornustlīce þonne þū þīne ælmessan sylle, ne blāwe man bȳman beforan þē, swā līceteras dōð on gesomnungum and on wīcum þæt hī sīn geārwurþode fram mannum.
text_bare: Eornustlice þonne þu þine ælmessan sylle, ne blawe man byman beforan þe, swa liceteras doð on gesomnungum and on wicum þæt hi sin gearwurþode fram mannum.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Hī onfēngon hyra mēde.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Hi onfengon hyra mede.

text: Sōþlīce þonne þū þīne ælmessan dō, nyte þīn wynstre hwæt dō þīn swȳþre;
text_bare: Soþlice þonne þu þine ælmessan do, nyte þin wynstre hwæt do þin swyþre;

text: þæt þīn ælmesse sȳ on dīglum, and þīn Fæder hit āgylt þē sē þe gesyhþ on dīglum.
text_bare: þæt þin ælmesse sy on diglum, and þin Fæder hit agylt þe se þe gesyhþ on diglum.

text: And þonne gē ēow gebiddon, ne bēo gē swylce līceteras; þā lufiað þæt hig gebiddon hī, standende on gesomnungum and on strǣta hyrnum þæt men hig gesēon.
text_bare: And þonne ge eow gebiddon, ne beo ge swylce liceteras; þa lufiað þæt hig gebiddon hi, standende on gesomnungum and on stræta hyrnum þæt men hig geseon.

text: Sōþ ic secge ēow, Hig onfēngon hyra mēde.
text_bare: Soþ ic secge eow, Hig onfengon hyra mede.

text: Ðū sōþlīce, þonne þū ðē gebidde, gang intō þīnum hēdclyfan, and þīnre dura belocenre, bide þīnne Fæder on dīhlum; and þīn Fæder þe gesyhð on dīhlum hyt āgylt þē.
text_bare: Ðu soþlice, þonne þu ðe gebidde, gang into þinum hedclyfan, and þinre dura belocenre, bide þinne Fæder on dihlum; and þin Fæder þe gesyhð on dihlum hyt agylt þe.

text: Sōðlīce þonne gē ēow gebiddon, nelle gē sprecan fela, swā swā hǣðene; hig wēnað þæt hī sīn gehȳrede on hyra menigfealdan spǣce.
text_bare: Soðlice þonne ge eow gebiddon, nelle ge sprecan fela, swa swa hæðene; hig wenað þæt hi sin gehyrede on hyra menigfealdan spæce.

text: Nellen gē eornostlīce him geefenlǣcan; sōðlīce ēower Fæder wāt hwæt ēow þearf ys ǣr þām þe gē hyne biddað.
text_bare: Nellen ge eornostlice him geefenlæcan; soðlice eower Fæder wat hwæt eow þearf ys ær þam þe ge hyne biddað.

text: Eornustlīce gebiddað ēow ðus: Fæder ūre þū þe eart on heofonum, Sī þīn nama gehālgod.
text_bare: Eornustlice gebiddað eow ðus: Fæder ure þu þe eart on heofonum, Si þin nama gehalgod.

text: Tōbecume þīn rīce.
text_bare: Tobecume þin rice.

text: Gewurþe ðīn willa on eorðan swā swā on heofonum.
text_bare: Gewurþe ðin willa on eorðan swa swa on heofonum.

text: Ūrne gedæghwāmlīcan hlāf syle ūs tō dæg.
text_bare: Urne gedæghwamlican hlaf syle us to dæg.

text: And forgyf ūs ūrne gyltas, swā swā wē forgyfað ūrum gyltendum.
text_bare: And forgyf us urne gyltas, swa swa we forgyfað urum gyltendum.

text: And ne gelǣd þū ūs on costnunge, ac ālȳs ūs of yfele.
text_bare: And ne gelæd þu us on costnunge, ac alys us of yfele.

text: Sōþlīce.
text_bare: Soþlice.

text: Witodlīce gyf gē forgyfað mannum hyra synna, þonne forgyfþ ēower sē heofenlīca Fæder ēow ēowre gyltas.
text_bare: Witodlice gyf ge forgyfað mannum hyra synna, þonne forgyfþ eower se heofenlica Fæder eow eowre gyltas.

text: Gyf gē sōðlīce ne forgyfað mannum, nē ēower Fæder ne forgyfð ēow ēowre synna.
text_bare: Gyf ge soðlice ne forgyfað mannum, ne eower Fæder ne forgyfð eow eowre synna.

text: Sōðlīce þonne gē fæston, nellon gē wesan swylce lēase līcceteras; hig fornymað hyra ansȳna þæt hig ætēowun mannum fæstende.
text_bare: Soðlice þonne ge fæston, nellon ge wesan swylce lease licceteras; hig fornymað hyra ansyna þæt hig æteowun mannum fæstende.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt hig onfēngon hyra mēde.
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow þæt hig onfengon hyra mede.

text: Ðū sōðlīce, þonne ðū fæste, smyra þīn hēafod, and þweah þīne ansȳne;
text_bare: Ðu soðlice, þonne ðu fæste, smyra þin heafod, and þweah þine ansyne;

text: þæt þū ne sȳ gesewen fram mannum fæstende, ac þīnum Fæder þe ys on dīglum; and þīn Fæder þe gesyhð on dȳglum hit āgylt þē.
text_bare: þæt þu ne sy gesewen fram mannum fæstende, ac þinum Fæder þe ys on diglum; and þin Fæder þe gesyhð on dyglum hit agylt þe.

text: Nellen gē goldhordian ēow goldhordas on eorþan, þǣr ōm and moððe hit fornimð, and þǣr ðēofas hit delfað and forstelaþ.
text_bare: Nellen ge goldhordian eow goldhordas on eorþan, þær om and moððe hit fornimð, and þær ðeofas hit delfað and forstelaþ.

text: Goldhordiað ēow sōðlīce goldhordas on heofenan, þǣr nāðor ōm nē moþðe hit ne fornimð, and ðār ðēofas hit ne delfað nē ne forstelaþ;
text_bare: Goldhordiað eow soðlice goldhordas on heofenan, þær naðor om ne moþðe hit ne fornimð, and ðar ðeofas hit ne delfað ne ne forstelaþ;

text: witodlīce þǣr ðīn goldhord is, þǣr is ðīn heorte.
text_bare: witodlice þær ðin goldhord is, þær is ðin heorte.

text: Ðīnes līchaman lēohtfæt is þīn ēage; gyf þīn ēage bið ānfeald, eall þīn līchama bið beorht.
text_bare: Ðines lichaman leohtfæt is þin eage; gyf þin eage bið anfeald, eall þin lichama bið beorht.

text: Gif þīn ēage sōþlīce bið mānfull, eall þīn līchama byþ ðȳsterfull.
text_bare: Gif þin eage soþlice bið manfull, eall þin lichama byþ ðysterfull.

text: Eornustlīce gyf þæt lēoht þe on ðē is synt þȳstru, hū mycle bēoþ ðā þȳstru!
text_bare: Eornustlice gyf þæt leoht þe on ðe is synt þystru, hu mycle beoþ ða þystru!

text: Ne mæg nān man twām hlāfordum þēowian; oððe hē sōðlīce ǣnne hatað and ōðerne lufað, oððe hē bið ānum gehȳrsum and ōðrum ungehȳrsum.
text_bare: Ne mæg nan man twam hlafordum þeowian; oððe he soðlice ænne hatað and oðerne lufað, oððe he bið anum gehyrsum and oðrum ungehyrsum.

text: Ne magon gē Gode þēowian and woruldwelan.
text_bare: Ne magon ge Gode þeowian and woruldwelan.

text: For þām ic secge ēow þæt gē ne sīn ymbhȳdige ēowre sāwle hwæt gē eton, ne ēowrum līchaman mid hwām gē sȳn ymbscrȳdde.
text_bare: For þam ic secge eow þæt ge ne sin ymbhydige eowre sawle hwæt ge eton, ne eowrum lichaman mid hwam ge syn ymbscrydde.

text: Hū nys sēo sawl sēlre þonne mete, and ēower līchama betera þonne þæt rēaf?
text_bare: Hu nys seo sawl selre þonne mete, and eower lichama betera þonne þæt reaf?

text: Behealdað heofonan fuglas, for þām þe hig ne sāwað, nē hig ne rīpað, nē hig ne gadriað on berne; and ēower heofonlīca Fæder hig fēt.
text_bare: Behealdað heofonan fuglas, for þam þe hig ne sawað, ne hig ne ripað, ne hig ne gadriað on berne; and eower heofonlica Fæder hig fet.

text: Hū ne synt gē sēlran þonne hig?
text_bare: Hu ne synt ge selran þonne hig?

text: Hwylc ēower mæg sōþlīce geþencean þæt hē geēacnige āne elne tō hys anlīcnesse?
text_bare: Hwylc eower mæg soþlice geþencean þæt he geeacnige ane elne to hys anlicnesse?

text: And tō hwī synt gē ymbhȳdige be rēafe?
text_bare: And to hwi synt ge ymbhydige be reafe?

text: Bescēawiað æcyres lilian, hū hig weaxað; ne swincað hig, nē hig ne spinnað.
text_bare: Besceawiað æcyres lilian, hu hig weaxað; ne swincað hig, ne hig ne spinnað.

text: Ic secge ēow sōðlīce þæt furðon Salomon on eallum hys wuldre næs oferwrigen swā swā ān of ðyson.
text_bare: Ic secge eow soðlice þæt furðon Salomon on eallum hys wuldre næs oferwrigen swa swa an of ðyson.

text: Sōþlīce gyf æcyres wēod, þæt ðe tō dæg is and bið tō morgen on ofen āsend, God swā scrȳt, Ēalā gē gehwǣdes gelēafan!
text_bare: Soþlice gyf æcyres weod, þæt ðe to dæg is and bið to morgen on ofen asend, God swa scryt, Eala ge gehwædes geleafan!

text: þām mycle mā hē scrȳt ēow.
text_bare: þam mycle ma he scryt eow.

text: Nellen gē eornustlīce bēon ymbhȳdige, þus cweþende, Hwæt ete wē?
text_bare: Nellen ge eornustlice beon ymbhydige, þus cweþende, Hwæt ete we?

text: oððe, Hwæt drince wē?
text_bare: oððe, Hwæt drince we?

text: oððe, Mid hwām bēo wē oferwrogene?
text_bare: oððe, Mid hwam beo we oferwrogene?

text: Sōþlīce ealle þās þing þēoda sēceað; witodlīce ēower Fæder wāt þæt gē eallra þyssa þinga beþurfon.
text_bare: Soþlice ealle þas þing þeoda seceað; witodlice eower Fæder wat þæt ge eallra þyssa þinga beþurfon.

text: Eornustlīce sēceað ǣrest Godes rīce and hys rihtwīsnesse, and ealle þās þing ēow bēoþ þǣr tō geēacnode.
text_bare: Eornustlice seceað ærest Godes rice and hys rihtwisnesse, and ealle þas þing eow beoþ þær to geeacnode.

text: Ne bēo gē nā hogiende ymb þā morgenlīcan nēode; sōðlīce sē morgenlīca dæg carað ymb hyne sylfne.
text_bare: Ne beo ge na hogiende ymb þa morgenlican neode; soðlice se morgenlica dæg carað ymb hyne sylfne.

text: Ǣghwylc dæg hæfð genōh on hys āgenum ymbhogan.
text_bare: Æghwylc dæg hæfð genoh on hys agenum ymbhogan.

text: Nellen gē dēman, þæt gē ne sȳn fordēmede.
text_bare: Nellen ge deman, þæt ge ne syn fordemede.

text: Witodlīce ðām ylcan dōme þe gē dēmað, ēow byð gedēmed; and on ðām ylcan gemete þe gē metaþ, ēow byþ gemeten.
text_bare: Witodlice ðam ylcan dome þe ge demað, eow byð gedemed; and on ðam ylcan gemete þe ge metaþ, eow byþ gemeten.

text: Tō hwī gesihst þū þæt mot on þīnes brōþor ēagan, and þū ne gesyhst þone bēam on þīnum āgenum ēagan?
text_bare: To hwi gesihst þu þæt mot on þines broþor eagan, and þu ne gesyhst þone beam on þinum agenum eagan?

text: Oþþe hūmeta cwyst þū tō þīnum brēþer, Brōþur, þafa þæt ic ūt ādō þæt mot of þīnum ēagan, þonne sē bēam biþ on þīnum āgenum ēagan?
text_bare: Oþþe humeta cwyst þu to þinum breþer, Broþur, þafa þæt ic ut ado þæt mot of þinum eagan, þonne se beam biþ on þinum agenum eagan?

text: Lā þū līccetere, ādō ǣrest ūt ðone bēam of þīnum āgenum ēagan, and behāwa þonne þæt þū ūt ādō þæt mot of þīnes brōður ēagan.
text_bare: La þu liccetere, ado ærest ut ðone beam of þinum agenum eagan, and behawa þonne þæt þu ut ado þæt mot of þines broður eagan.

text: Nellen gē syllan þæt hālige hundum, nē gē ne wurpen ēowre meregrotu tōforan ēowrum swȳnon, þē lǣs hig mid hyra fōtum hig fortredon, and hig þonne ongēan gewende ēow tōslȳton.
text_bare: Nellen ge syllan þæt halige hundum, ne ge ne wurpen eowre meregrotu toforan eowrum swynon, þe læs hig mid hyra fotum hig fortredon, and hig þonne ongean gewende eow toslyton.

text: Biddaþ, and ēow bið geseald; sēceaþ, and gē hit findaþ; cnuciað, and ēow biþ ontȳned.
text_bare: Biddaþ, and eow bið geseald; seceaþ, and ge hit findaþ; cnuciað, and eow biþ ontyned.

text: Witodlīce ǣlc þǣra þe bit, hē onfēhþ; and sē þe sēcð, hē hyt fint; and þām cnuciendum bið ontȳned.
text_bare: Witodlice ælc þæra þe bit, he onfehþ; and se þe secð, he hyt fint; and þam cnuciendum bið ontyned.

text: Hwylc man is of ēow, gyf his sunu hyne bit hlāfes, sylst þū him stān;
text_bare: Hwylc man is of eow, gyf his sunu hyne bit hlafes, sylst þu him stan;

text: oððe gyf hē bytt fisces, sylst þū him nǣddran?
text_bare: oððe gyf he bytt fisces, sylst þu him næddran?

text: Eornustlīce nū gē þe yfle synt cunnun gōde sylena ēowrum bearnum syllan, mycle mā ēower Fæder þe on heofenum ys syleþ gōd þām þe hyne biddað.
text_bare: Eornustlice nu ge þe yfle synt cunnun gode sylena eowrum bearnum syllan, mycle ma eower Fæder þe on heofenum ys syleþ god þam þe hyne biddað.

text: Eornustlīce ealle þā þing ðe gē wyllen þæt men ēow dōn, dōþ gē him þæt sylfe; þæt ys sōþlīce ǣ and wītegena bebod.
text_bare: Eornustlice ealle þa þing ðe ge wyllen þæt men eow don, doþ ge him þæt sylfe; þæt ys soþlice æ and witegena bebod.

text: Gangað inn þurh þæt nearwe geat; for þon þe þæt geat is swȳþe wīd, and sē weg is swīþe rūm þe tō forspillednesse gelǣt, and swȳþe manega synt þe þurh þone weg farað.
text_bare: Gangað inn þurh þæt nearwe geat; for þon þe þæt geat is swyþe wid, and se weg is swiþe rum þe to forspillednesse gelæt, and swyþe manega synt þe þurh þone weg farað.

text: Ēalā hū neara and hū angsum is þæt geat and sē weg þe tō līfe gelǣdt, and swȳþe fēawa synt þe þone weg findon!
text_bare: Eala hu neara and hu angsum is þæt geat and se weg þe to life gelædt, and swyþe feawa synt þe þone weg findon!

text: Warniað ēow fram lēasum wītegum, þā cumað tō ēow on scēapa gegyrelum, ac hig bēoð innane rēafigende wulfas.
text_bare: Warniað eow fram leasum witegum, þa cumað to eow on sceapa gegyrelum, ac hig beoð innane reafigende wulfas.

text: Fram hyra wæstmun gē hī undergytað.
text_bare: Fram hyra wæstmun ge hi undergytað.

text: Cwyst þū gaderað man wīnberian of þornum, oððe fīcæppla of þyrncinum?
text_bare: Cwyst þu gaderað man winberian of þornum, oððe ficæppla of þyrncinum?

text: Swā ǣlc gōd trēow byrþ gōde wæstmas, and ǣlc yfel trēow byrþ yfele wæstmas.
text_bare: Swa ælc god treow byrþ gode wæstmas, and ælc yfel treow byrþ yfele wæstmas.

text: Ne mæg þæt gōde trēow beran yfle wæstmas, ne þæt yfele trēow gōde wæstmas.
text_bare: Ne mæg þæt gode treow beran yfle wæstmas, ne þæt yfele treow gode wæstmas.

text: Ǣlc trēow þe ne byrð gōdne wæstm sȳ hyt forcorfen, and on fȳr āworpen.
text_bare: Ælc treow þe ne byrð godne wæstm sy hyt forcorfen, and on fyr aworpen.

text: Witodlīce be hyra wæstmum gē hig oncnāwað.
text_bare: Witodlice be hyra wæstmum ge hig oncnawað.

text: Ne gǣð ǣlc þǣra on heofena rīce þe cwyþ tō mē, Drihten, Drihten; ac sē þe wyrcð mīnes Fæder willan þe on heofenum is, sē gǣð on heofena rīce.
text_bare: Ne gæð ælc þæra on heofena rice þe cwyþ to me, Drihten, Drihten; ac se þe wyrcð mines Fæder willan þe on heofenum is, se gæð on heofena rice.

text: Manega cweþað on þām dæge tō mē, Drihten, Drihten, hū ne wītegode wē on þīnum naman, and on þīnum naman wē ūt āwurpon dēoflu, and on þīnum naman wē worhton mycle mihta?
text_bare: Manega cweþað on þam dæge to me, Drihten, Drihten, hu ne witegode we on þinum naman, and on þinum naman we ut awurpon deoflu, and on þinum naman we worhton mycle mihta?

text: Þonne cweðe ic tō him, Þæt ic ēow nǣfre ne cūðe; gewītað fram mē, gē þe worhton unrihtwȳsnesse.
text_bare: Þonne cweðe ic to him, Þæt ic eow næfre ne cuðe; gewitað fram me, ge þe worhton unrihtwysnesse.

text: Eornustlīce ǣlc þǣra þe ðās mīne word gehȳrð, and þā wyrcð, byþ gelīc þām wīsan were sē hys hūs ofer stān getimbrode;
text_bare: Eornustlice ælc þæra þe ðas mine word gehyrð, and þa wyrcð, byþ gelic þam wisan were se hys hus ofer stan getimbrode;

text: þā cōm þǣr rēn and mycele flōd, and þǣr blēowun windas, and āhruron on þæt hūs, and hyt nā ne fēoll; sōðlīce hit wæs ofer stān getimbrod.
text_bare: þa com þær ren and mycele flod, and þær bleowun windas, and ahruron on þæt hus, and hyt na ne feoll; soðlice hit wæs ofer stan getimbrod.

text: And ǣlc þǣra þe gehȳrþ ðās mīne word, and þā ne wyrcð, sē byþ gelīc þām dysigan men þe getimbrode hys hūs ofer sandceosel;
text_bare: And ælc þæra þe gehyrþ ðas mine word, and þa ne wyrcð, se byþ gelic þam dysigan men þe getimbrode hys hus ofer sandceosel;

text: þā rīnde hit, and þǣr cōmun flōd, and blēowun windas, and āhruron on þæt hūs, and þæt hūs fēoll, and hys hryre wæs mycel.
text_bare: þa rinde hit, and þær comun flod, and bleowun windas, and ahruron on þæt hus, and þæt hus feoll, and hys hryre wæs mycel.

text: Þā wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlend þās word geendode, þā wundrode þæt folc his lāre.
text_bare: Þa wæs geworden, þa se Hælend þas word geendode, þa wundrode þæt folc his lare.

text: Sōþlīce hē lǣrde swylce hē anweald hæfde, and nā swā swā hyra bōceras and sundorhālgan.
text_bare: Soþlice he lærde swylce he anweald hæfde, and na swa swa hyra boceras and sundorhalgan.

text: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend of þām munte nyþer āstāh, þā fyligdon him mycle mænio.
text_bare: Soþlice þa se Hælend of þam munte nyþer astah, þa fyligdon him mycle mænio.

text: Þā genēalǣhte ān hrēofla tō him, and hine tō him geēaðmēdde, and þus cwæð, Drihten, gyf þu wylt, þū miht mē geclǣnsian.
text_bare: Þa genealæhte an hreofla to him, and hine to him geeaðmedde, and þus cwæð, Drihten, gyf þu wylt, þu miht me geclænsian.

text: Ðā āstrehte sē Hǣlend hys hand, and hrepode hyne, and þus cwæð, Ic wylle; bēo geclǣnsod.
text_bare: Ða astrehte se Hælend hys hand, and hrepode hyne, and þus cwæð, Ic wylle; beo geclænsod.

text: And hys hrēofla wæs hrædlīce geclǣnsod.
text_bare: And hys hreofla wæs hrædlice geclænsod.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Warna þē þæt þū hyt nǣnegum men ne secge; ac gang, ætēowe þē þām sācerde, and bring hym þā lāc þe Moyses bebēad, on hyra gecȳðnesse.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Warna þe þæt þu hyt nænegum men ne secge; ac gang, æteowe þe þam sacerde, and bring hym þa lac þe Moyses bebead, on hyra gecyðnesse.

text: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend in ēode on Capharnaum, þā genēalǣhte hym ān hundredes ealdor, hyne biddende,
text_bare: Soþlice þa se Hælend in eode on Capharnaum, þa genealæhte hym an hundredes ealdor, hyne biddende,

text: and þus cweðende, Drihten, mīn cnapa līð on mīnum hūse, lama and mid yfle geðrēad.
text_bare: and þus cweðende, Drihten, min cnapa lið on minum huse, lama and mid yfle geðread.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ic cume and hyne gehǣle.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Ic cume and hyne gehæle.

text: Ðā andswarode sē hundredes ealdor and þus cwæð, Drihten, ne eom ic wyrðe þæt þū in gange under mīne þecene; ac cweð þīn ān word, and mīn cnapa biþ gehǣled.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se hundredes ealdor and þus cwæð, Drihten, ne eom ic wyrðe þæt þu in gange under mine þecene; ac cweð þin an word, and min cnapa biþ gehæled.

text: Sōðlīce ic eom man under anwealde gesett, and ic hæbbe þegnas under mē; and ic cweðe tō þysum, Gang, and hē gǣð; and ic cweðe tō ōþrum, Cum, and he cymð; tō mīnum þēowe, Wyrc þis, and hē wyrcð.
text_bare: Soðlice ic eom man under anwealde gesett, and ic hæbbe þegnas under me; and ic cweðe to þysum, Gang, and he gæð; and ic cweðe to oþrum, Cum, and he cymð; to minum þeowe, Wyrc þis, and he wyrcð.

text: Witodlīce þā sē Hǣlend þis gehȳrde, þā wundrode hē, and cwæð tō þām þe hym fyligdon, Sōþ ic secge ēow, ne gemētte ic swā mycelne gelēafan on Israhel.
text_bare: Witodlice þa se Hælend þis gehyrde, þa wundrode he, and cwæð to þam þe hym fyligdon, Soþ ic secge eow, ne gemette ic swa mycelne geleafan on Israhel.

text: Tō sōþum ic secge ēow þæt manige cumað fram ēastdǣle and westdǣle, and wuniað mid Abrahame, Isahace, and Iacobe on heofena rīce.
text_bare: To soþum ic secge eow þæt manige cumað fram eastdæle and westdæle, and wuniað mid Abrahame, Isahace, and Iacobe on heofena rice.

text: Witodlīce þises rīces bearn bēoð āworpene on þā ȳtemestan þȳstro; þǣr bið wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
text_bare: Witodlice þises rices bearn beoð aworpene on þa ytemestan þystro; þær bið wop and toþa gristbitung.

text: And sē Hælend cwæð tō þām hundrydes ealdre, Gā, and gewurþe ðē swā swā þū gelȳfdest.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to þam hundrydes ealdre, Ga, and gewurþe ðe swa swa þu gelyfdest.

text: And sē cnapa wæs gehǣled on þǣre tīde.
text_bare: And se cnapa wæs gehæled on þære tide.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend cōm on Petres hūse, þā geseah hē hys swegre licgende, and hriþgende.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend com on Petres huse, þa geseah he hys swegre licgende, and hriþgende.

text: And hē æthrān hyre hand, and sē fēfor hig forlēt; ðā ārās hēo, and þēnode him.
text_bare: And he æthran hyre hand, and se fefor hig forlet; ða aras heo, and þenode him.

text: Sōþlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, hig brōhton him manege dēofolsēoce; and hē ūt ādrǣfde þā unclǣnan gāstas mid hys worde, and hē ealle gehǣlde þā yfel hæbbendan:
text_bare: Soþlice þa hyt æfen wæs, hig brohton him manege deofolseoce; and he ut adræfde þa unclænan gastas mid hys worde, and he ealle gehælde þa yfel hæbbendan:

text: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Esaiam þone wītegan, þus cweðende, Hē onfēng ūre untrumnessa, and hē ābær ūre ādla.
text_bare: þæt wære gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Esaiam þone witegan, þus cweðende, He onfeng ure untrumnessa, and he abær ure adla.

text: Ðā geseah sē Hǣlend mycle menigeo ymbūtan hyne, þā hēt hē hig faran ofer þone mūþan.
text_bare: Ða geseah se Hælend mycle menigeo ymbutan hyne, þa het he hig faran ofer þone muþan.

text: Ðā genēalǣhte him ān bōcere, and cwæþ, Lārēow, ic fylige þē swā hwæder swā þū færst.
text_bare: Ða genealæhte him an bocere, and cwæþ, Lareow, ic fylige þe swa hwæder swa þu færst.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Foxas habbað holu, and heofenan fuglas nest; sōþlīce mannes Sunu næfð hwǣr hē hys hēafod āhylde.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Foxas habbað holu, and heofenan fuglas nest; soþlice mannes Sunu næfð hwær he hys heafod ahylde.

text: Ðā cwæð tō him ōþer of hys leorningcnihtum, Drihten, ālȳfe mē ǣrest tō farenne and bebyrigean mīnne fæder.
text_bare: Ða cwæð to him oþer of hys leorningcnihtum, Drihten, alyfe me ærest to farenne and bebyrigean minne fæder.

text: Þa cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Fylig mē, and lǣt dēade bebyrigean hyra dēadan.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend to him, Fylig me, and læt deade bebyrigean hyra deadan.

text: And hē āstāh on scyp, and hys leorningcnyhtas hym fyligdon.
text_bare: And he astah on scyp, and hys leorningcnyhtas hym fyligdon.

text: Ðā wearð mycel styrung geworden on þǣre sǣ, swā þæt þæt scyp wearð ofergoten mid ȳþum; witodlīce hē slēp.
text_bare: Ða wearð mycel styrung geworden on þære sæ, swa þæt þæt scyp wearð ofergoten mid yþum; witodlice he slep.

text: And hig genēalǣhton, and hȳ āwehton hyne, þus cweðende, Drihten, hǣle ūs; wē mōton forwurþan.
text_bare: And hig genealæhton, and hy awehton hyne, þus cweðende, Drihten, hæle us; we moton forwurþan.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Tō hwī synt gē forhte, gē lȳtles gelēafan?
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, To hwi synt ge forhte, ge lytles geleafan?

text: Ðā ārās hē, and bebēad þām winde and þǣre sǣ; and þǣr wearð geworden mycel smyltness.
text_bare: Ða aras he, and bebead þam winde and þære sæ; and þær wearð geworden mycel smyltness.

text: Gewisslīce þā men wundrodun and þus cwǣdon, Hwæt is ðēs þæt windas and sǣ him hȳrsumiað?
text_bare: Gewisslice þa men wundrodun and þus cwædon, Hwæt is ðes þæt windas and sæ him hyrsumiað?

text: Þā sē Hǣlend cōm ofer þone mūþan on Geraseniscra rīce, þā urnon him tōgēnes twēgen þe hæfdon dēofolsēocnesse, of byrgenum ūt gangende; þā wǣron swīðe rēþe, swā þæt nān man ne mihte faran þurh þone weg.
text_bare: Þa se Hælend com ofer þone muþan on Geraseniscra rice, þa urnon him togenes twegen þe hæfdon deofolseocnesse, of byrgenum ut gangende; þa wæron swiðe reþe, swa þæt nan man ne mihte faran þurh þone weg.

text: And hig hrȳmdon and cwǣdon, Lā Hǣlend, Godes Sunu, hwæt ys þē and ūs gemǣne?
text_bare: And hig hrymdon and cwædon, La Hælend, Godes Sunu, hwæt ys þe and us gemæne?

text: cōme þū hider ǣr tīde ūs tō þrēagenne?
text_bare: come þu hider ær tide us to þreagenne?

text: Ðǣr wæs sōþlīce unfeorr ān heord manegra swȳna lǣswiende.
text_bare: Ðær wæs soþlice unfeorr an heord manegra swyna læswiende.

text: Þā dēofla sōðlīce hyne bǣdon þus cweþende, Gyf þū ūs ūt ādrīfst, āsende ūs on þās swīna heorde.
text_bare: Þa deofla soðlice hyne bædon þus cweþende, Gyf þu us ut adrifst, asende us on þas swina heorde.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Faraþ.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, Faraþ.

text: And hig þā ūt gangende fērdon on þā swīn, and þǣrrihte fērde eall sēo heord myclum onrǣse niwel on þā sǣ, and hig wurdon dēade on þām wætere.
text_bare: And hig þa ut gangende ferdon on þa swin, and þærrihte ferde eall seo heord myclum onræse niwel on þa sæ, and hig wurdon deade on þam wætere.

text: Ðā hyrdas witodlīce flugon, and comun on þā ceastre, and cȳddon ealle þās þing, and be þām þe ðā dēofulsēocnyssa hæfdon.
text_bare: Ða hyrdas witodlice flugon, and comun on þa ceastre, and cyddon ealle þas þing, and be þam þe ða deofulseocnyssa hæfdon.

text: Ðā ēode eall sēo ceasterwaru tōgēanes þām Hǣlende; and þā þā hig hyne gesāwun, þā bǣdon hig hyne þæt hē fērde fram heora gemǣrum.
text_bare: Ða eode eall seo ceasterwaru togeanes þam Hælende; and þa þa hig hyne gesawun, þa bædon hig hyne þæt he ferde fram heora gemærum.

text: Ðā āstāh hē on scyp, and oferseglode, and cōm on his ceastre.
text_bare: Ða astah he on scyp, and oferseglode, and com on his ceastre.

text: Ðā brōhton hig hym ǣnne laman, on bedde licgende; þā geseah sē Hǣlend hyra gelēafan, and cwæð tō þām laman, Lā bearn, gelȳfe; þē bēoþ þīne synna forgyfene.
text_bare: Ða brohton hig hym ænne laman, on bedde licgende; þa geseah se Hælend hyra geleafan, and cwæð to þam laman, La bearn, gelyfe; þe beoþ þine synna forgyfene.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig sume þā bōceras him betwȳnan, Ðēs spycð bysmorsprǣce.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig sume þa boceras him betwynan, Ðes spycð bysmorspræce.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend geseah hyra geþanc, ðā cwæð hē, Tō hwī þence gē yfel on ēowrum heortum?
text_bare: Þa se Hælend geseah hyra geþanc, ða cwæð he, To hwi þence ge yfel on eowrum heortum?

text: Hwæt is ēaþelīcre tō cweðenne, Þē bēoð forgyfene þīne synna, oððe tō cweþanne, Ārīs, and gā?
text_bare: Hwæt is eaþelicre to cweðenne, Þe beoð forgyfene þine synna, oððe to cweþanne, Aris, and ga?

text: Þæt gē sōþlīce witon þæt mannes Sunu hæfð anweald on eorþan synna tō forgyfenne,—þā cwæð hē tō þām laman,—Ārīs, and nym þīn bedd, and gang on þīn hūs.
text_bare: Þæt ge soþlice witon þæt mannes Sunu hæfð anweald on eorþan synna to forgyfenne,—þa cwæð he to þam laman,—Aris, and nym þin bedd, and gang on þin hus.

text: And hē ārās, and fērde tō hys hūse.
text_bare: And he aras, and ferde to hys huse.

text: Sōðlīce ðā þā sēo mænigeo þis gesāwon, þā ondrēdon hig hym, and wuldrodon God þe sealde swylcne anweald mannum.
text_bare: Soðlice ða þa seo mænigeo þis gesawon, þa ondredon hig hym, and wuldrodon God þe sealde swylcne anweald mannum.

text: Ðā se Hǣlend þanon fērde, hē geseah ǣnne man sittende æt tollsceamule, þæs nama wæs Matheus; and hē cwæð tō him, Fylig mē.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þanon ferde, he geseah ænne man sittende æt tollsceamule, þæs nama wæs Matheus; and he cwæð to him, Fylig me.

text: And hē ārās, and fyligde him.
text_bare: And he aras, and fyligde him.

text: And hyt wæs geworden þā hē sæt innan hūse, þā cōmun manega mānfulle and synfulle and sǣton mid þām Hǣlende and hys leorningcnyhtum.
text_bare: And hyt wæs geworden þa he sæt innan huse, þa comun manega manfulle and synfulle and sæton mid þam Hælende and hys leorningcnyhtum.

text: Ðā þā sundorhālgan þæt gesāwon, þā cwǣdon hig tō hys leorningcnyhtum, Hwī ytt ēower Lārēow mid mānfullum and synfullum?
text_bare: Ða þa sundorhalgan þæt gesawon, þa cwædon hig to hys leorningcnyhtum, Hwi ytt eower Lareow mid manfullum and synfullum?

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð, þis gehȳrende, Nys hālum lǣces nān þearf, ac sēocum.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð, þis gehyrende, Nys halum læces nan þearf, ac seocum.

text: Gāð sōðlīce and leornigeaþ hwæt is, Ic wylle mildheortnesse, næs onsægdnesse; sōþlīce ne cōm ic rihtwīse tō gecīgeanne, ac þa synnfullan.
text_bare: Gað soðlice and leornigeaþ hwæt is, Ic wylle mildheortnesse, næs onsægdnesse; soþlice ne com ic rihtwise to gecigeanne, ac þa synnfullan.

text: Þā genēalǣhton Iohannes leorningcnihtas tō hym, and þuss cwǣdon, Hwī fæste wē and þā sundorhālgan gelōmlīce?
text_bare: Þa genealæhton Iohannes leorningcnihtas to hym, and þuss cwædon, Hwi fæste we and þa sundorhalgan gelomlice?

text: sōþlīce þīne leorningcnihtas ne fæstað?
text_bare: soþlice þine leorningcnihtas ne fæstað?

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Cweþe ge sceolun þæs brȳdguman cnihtas wēpan, þā hwīle þe sē brȳdguma mid hym byþ?
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to him, Cweþe ge sceolun þæs brydguman cnihtas wepan, þa hwile þe se brydguma mid hym byþ?

text: sōðlīce þā dagas cumað þæt sē brydguma byð āfyrred fram him, and þonne on ðām dagum hig fæstað.
text_bare: soðlice þa dagas cumað þæt se brydguma byð afyrred fram him, and þonne on ðam dagum hig fæstað.

text: Ne dēþ witodlīce nān man nīwes clāðes scyp on eald rēaf; hē tōbrycð hys stede on þām rēafe, and sē slite byþ þē wyrsa.
text_bare: Ne deþ witodlice nan man niwes claðes scyp on eald reaf; he tobrycð hys stede on þam reafe, and se slite byþ þe wyrsa.

text: Nē hig ne dōð nīwe wīn on ealde bytta; gyf hī dōð, þā bytta bēoþ tōbrocene, and þæt wīn āgoten, and þā bytta forwurþað.
text_bare: Ne hig ne doð niwe win on ealde bytta; gyf hi doð, þa bytta beoþ tobrocene, and þæt win agoten, and þa bytta forwurþað.

text: Ac hig dōð nīwe wīn on nīwe bytta, and ǣgðer byþ gehealden.
text_bare: Ac hig doð niwe win on niwe bytta, and ægðer byþ gehealden.

text: Ðā hē þās þing tō him spræc, þā genēalǣhte ān ealdor, and geēaðmēdde hyne tō him, þus cweðende, Drihten, mīn dohtor is dēad; ac cum, and sete þīne hand uppan hig, and hēo lyfað.
text_bare: Ða he þas þing to him spræc, þa genealæhte an ealdor, and geeaðmedde hyne to him, þus cweðende, Drihten, min dohtor is dead; ac cum, and sete þine hand uppan hig, and heo lyfað.

text: And sē Hǣlend ārās and fyligde hym, and hys leorningcnihtas.
text_bare: And se Hælend aras and fyligde hym, and hys leorningcnihtas.

text: And þā ān wif þe þolode blōdryne twelf gēar genēalǣhte widæftan, and æthrān hys rēafes fnæd;
text_bare: And þa an wif þe þolode blodryne twelf gear genealæhte widæftan, and æthran hys reafes fnæd;

text: hēo cwæð sōðlīce on hyre mōde, For ān ic bēo hāl, gyf ic hys rēafes æthrīne.
text_bare: heo cwæð soðlice on hyre mode, For an ic beo hal, gyf ic hys reafes æthrine.

text: And sē Hǣlend bewende hyne and hig geseah, and cwæð, Gelȳf, dohtor; þīn gelēafa þē gehǣlde.
text_bare: And se Hælend bewende hyne and hig geseah, and cwæð, Gelyf, dohtor; þin geleafa þe gehælde.

text: And þæt wīf wæs gehǣled on þǣre tīde.
text_bare: And þæt wif wæs gehæled on þære tide.

text: And þā sē Hǣlend cōm intō þæs ealdres healle, and geseah hwistleras, and hlȳdende menigeo,
text_bare: And þa se Hælend com into þæs ealdres healle, and geseah hwistleras, and hlydende menigeo,

text: hē cwæð, Gāð heonun; nys þys mǣden dēad sōðlīce, ac hēo slǣpð.
text_bare: he cwæð, Gað heonun; nys þys mæden dead soðlice, ac heo slæpð.

text: And hig tǣldon hyne.
text_bare: And hig tældon hyne.

text: And þā hē þā menigeo ūt ādrāf, hē geēode in, and nam hyre hand; and þæt mǣden ārās.
text_bare: And þa he þa menigeo ut adraf, he geeode in, and nam hyre hand; and þæt mæden aras.

text: And þēs hlīsa sprang ofer eall þæt land.
text_bare: And þes hlisa sprang ofer eall þæt land.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend þanun fōr, þā fyligdun hym twēgyn blinde, hrȳmynde and cweðende, Lā Dauides sunu, gemiltsa unc.
text_bare: Þa se Hælend þanun for, þa fyligdun hym twegyn blinde, hrymynde and cweðende, La Dauides sunu, gemiltsa unc.

text: Sōðlīce þā hē hām cōm, þā blindan genēalǣhton tō him, and sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Gelȳfe gyt þæt ic inc mæg gehǣlan?
text_bare: Soðlice þa he ham com, þa blindan genealæhton to him, and se Hælend cwæð to him, Gelyfe gyt þæt ic inc mæg gehælan?

text: Hig cwǣdon tō hym, Witodlīce, Drihten.
text_bare: Hig cwædon to hym, Witodlice, Drihten.

text: Ðā æthrān hē hyra ēagena, cweðynde, Sȳ inc æftyr incrun gelēafan.
text_bare: Ða æthran he hyra eagena, cweðynde, Sy inc æftyr incrun geleafan.

text: And hyra ēagan wǣrun ontȳnede.
text_bare: And hyra eagan wærun ontynede.

text: And sē Hǣlynd bebēad him, cweþende, Warniað þæt gē hyt nānum men ne secgeon.
text_bare: And se Hælynd bebead him, cweþende, Warniað þæt ge hyt nanum men ne secgeon.

text: Hig sōðlīce ūt gangynde gewīdmǣrsudun hyne ofer eall þæt land.
text_bare: Hig soðlice ut gangynde gewidmærsudun hyne ofer eall þæt land.

text: Ðā hig wǣron sōðlīce ūt āgāne, hig brōhton him dumbne man, sē wæs dēofulsēoc.
text_bare: Ða hig wæron soðlice ut agane, hig brohton him dumbne man, se wæs deofulseoc.

text: And ūt ādryfenum þām dēofle, sē dumba spræc; and þā menigeo wundredon, cweðende, Nǣfre ætȳwde swylc on Israhela folce.
text_bare: And ut adryfenum þam deofle, se dumba spræc; and þa menigeo wundredon, cweðende, Næfre ætywde swylc on Israhela folce.

text: Sōþlīce þā sundorhālgan cwǣdon, On dēofla ealdre hē drīfð ūt dēoflu.
text_bare: Soþlice þa sundorhalgan cwædon, On deofla ealdre he drifð ut deoflu.

text: And sē Hǣlend ymbfōr ealle burga and ceastra, lǣrende on hyra gesomnungum, and bodiende rīces godspell, and hǣlende ǣlce ādle and ǣlce untrumnesse.
text_bare: And se Hælend ymbfor ealle burga and ceastra, lærende on hyra gesomnungum, and bodiende rices godspell, and hælende ælce adle and ælce untrumnesse.

text: Hē gemiltsude sōðlīce þǣre menigeo, þā hē hī geseah, for þan hig wǣrun gedrehte, and licgende swā swā scēap þe hyrde nabbað.
text_bare: He gemiltsude soðlice þære menigeo, þa he hi geseah, for þan hig wærun gedrehte, and licgende swa swa sceap þe hyrde nabbað.

text: Þā hē sǣde hys leorningcnihtun, Witodlīce micel rip ys, and fēawa wyrhtyna.
text_bare: Þa he sæde hys leorningcnihtun, Witodlice micel rip ys, and feawa wyrhtyna.

text: Biddaþ ðæs ripes hlāford þæt hē sende wyrhtan tō his ripe.
text_bare: Biddaþ ðæs ripes hlaford þæt he sende wyrhtan to his ripe.

text: And tōsomne gecīgydum hys twelf leorningcnihtun, hē sealde him unclǣnra gāsta anweald, þæt hig ādryfun hig ūt, and hǣldun ādle and ǣlce untrumnysse.
text_bare: And tosomne gecigydum hys twelf leorningcnihtun, he sealde him unclænra gasta anweald, þæt hig adryfun hig ut, and hældun adle and ælce untrumnysse.

text: Ðis synt sōðlīce þǣra twelf apostola naman: Sē forma ys Simon þe ys genemned Petrus, and Andreas hys brōðor; Iacobus Zebedei, and Iohannes hys brōður.
text_bare: Ðis synt soðlice þæra twelf apostola naman: Se forma ys Simon þe ys genemned Petrus, and Andreas hys broðor; Iacobus Zebedei, and Iohannes hys broður.

text: Simon Chananeus, and Iudas Scarioth þe hyne belǣwde.
text_bare: Simon Chananeus, and Iudas Scarioth þe hyne belæwde.

text: Ðās twelf sē Hǣlynd sende, him bebēodende and cweþende, Ne fare gē on þēoda weg, and ne gā gē innan Samaritana ceastre;
text_bare: Ðas twelf se Hælynd sende, him bebeodende and cweþende, Ne fare ge on þeoda weg, and ne ga ge innan Samaritana ceastre;

text: ac gāð mā tō þām scēapun þe forwurdun Israhela hīwrǣdene.
text_bare: ac gað ma to þam sceapun þe forwurdun Israhela hiwrædene.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō hys leorningcnihton, Gāð, and bodiaþ, cweþende þæt heofona rīce genēalǣcþ.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæþ to hys leorningcnihton, Gað, and bodiaþ, cweþende þæt heofona rice genealæcþ.

text: Hǣlað untrume, āwecceað dēade, clǣnsiað hrēofle, drīfað ūt dēoflu; gē onfēngun tō gyfe, syllað tō gyfe.
text_bare: Hælað untrume, awecceað deade, clænsiað hreofle, drifað ut deoflu; ge onfengun to gyfe, syllað to gyfe.

text: Næbbe gē gold, nē seolfer, nē feoh on ēowrum bigyrdlum;
text_bare: Næbbe ge gold, ne seolfer, ne feoh on eowrum bigyrdlum;

text: nē codd on wege, nē twā tunecan, nē gescȳ, nē gyrde; sōþlīce sē wyrhta ys wyrþe hys metys.
text_bare: ne codd on wege, ne twa tunecan, ne gescy, ne gyrde; soþlice se wyrhta ys wyrþe hys metys.

text: On swā hwylce burh oððe ceastre swā gē in gāð, āhsiað hwā sī wyrðe on þǣre; and wuniaþ ðǣr, oð gē ūt gān.
text_bare: On swa hwylce burh oððe ceastre swa ge in gað, ahsiað hwa si wyrðe on þære; and wuniaþ ðær, oð ge ut gan.

text: Þonne gē in gān sōþlīce on þæt hūs, grētað hit, cweðende, Sȳ syb þisun hūse.
text_bare: Þonne ge in gan soþlice on þæt hus, gretað hit, cweðende, Sy syb þisun huse.

text: And gyf þæt hūs witodlīce wyrþe byð, ēower syb cymð ofer hyt; gyf hyt sōðlīce wyrþe ne byð, ēowur syb byð tō ēow gecyrred.
text_bare: And gyf þæt hus witodlice wyrþe byð, eower syb cymð ofer hyt; gyf hyt soðlice wyrþe ne byð, eowur syb byð to eow gecyrred.

text: And swā hwā swā ēow ne underfēhð, nē ēowre sprǣca ne gehȳrð, þonne gē ūt gān of ðām hūse oððe of ðǣre ceastre, āsceacaþ þæt dūst of ēowrum fōtum.
text_bare: And swa hwa swa eow ne underfehð, ne eowre spræca ne gehyrð, þonne ge ut gan of ðam huse oððe of ðære ceastre, asceacaþ þæt dust of eowrum fotum.

text: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ācumenlīcre byð Sodoma lande and Gomorra on dōmes dæg, þonne ðǣre ceastre.
text_bare: Soþlice ic eow secge, Acumenlicre byð Sodoma lande and Gomorra on domes dæg, þonne ðære ceastre.

text: Nū ic ēow sende swā scēap gemang wulfas; bēoþ eornustlīce glēawe swā nǣddran, and bylwite swā culfran.
text_bare: Nu ic eow sende swa sceap gemang wulfas; beoþ eornustlice gleawe swa næddran, and bylwite swa culfran.

text: Warniað ēow sōþlīce fram mannum; hig syllaþ ēow sōþlīce on gemōtum, and swingað ēow on hyra gesomnungum.
text_bare: Warniað eow soþlice fram mannum; hig syllaþ eow soþlice on gemotum, and swingað eow on hyra gesomnungum.

text: And gē bēoþ gelǣdde tō dēmun and tō cyningun for mē, tō hyra dōme and þēodun.
text_bare: And ge beoþ gelædde to demun and to cyningun for me, to hyra dome and þeodun.

text: Þonne belǣwaþ hig and syllað ēow, ne þence gē hū oððe hwæt gē sprecun; ēow byð geseald sōþlīce on þǣre tīde hwæt gē sprecun.
text_bare: Þonne belæwaþ hig and syllað eow, ne þence ge hu oððe hwæt ge sprecun; eow byð geseald soþlice on þære tide hwæt ge sprecun.

text: Ne synt gē nā þe þǣr sprecað, ac ēowres Fæder Gāst þe sprycð on ēow.
text_bare: Ne synt ge na þe þær sprecað, ac eowres Fæder Gast þe sprycð on eow.

text: Sōþlīce brōþur sylþ hys brōður tō dēaðe, and fæder hys sunu; and bearn ārīsaþ ongēn māgas, and tō dēaþe hī fordōþ.
text_bare: Soþlice broþur sylþ hys broður to deaðe, and fæder hys sunu; and bearn arisaþ ongen magas, and to deaþe hi fordoþ.

text: And gē bēoþ on hatunge eallum mannum for mīnum naman; soðlīce sē ðe þurhwunaþ oð ende sē byþ hāl.
text_bare: And ge beoþ on hatunge eallum mannum for minum naman; soðlice se ðe þurhwunaþ oð ende se byþ hal.

text: Ðonne hī ēow ēhtaþ on þysse byrig, flēoþ on ōþre; and ðonne hī on þǣre ēow ēhtaþ, flēoþ on þā þryddan.
text_bare: Ðonne hi eow ehtaþ on þysse byrig, fleoþ on oþre; and ðonne hi on þære eow ehtaþ, fleoþ on þa þryddan.

text: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ne befaraþ gē Israhela burga, ǣr þan þe mannes Sunu cume.
text_bare: Soþlice ic eow secge, Ne befaraþ ge Israhela burga, ær þan þe mannes Sunu cume.

text: Nys sē leorningcniht ofer hys lārēow, nē þēow ofer hys hlāford.
text_bare: Nys se leorningcniht ofer hys lareow, ne þeow ofer hys hlaford.

text: Genōh byþ sōþlīce þām leorningcnihte þæt hē sȳ swylce hys lārēow, and þēow swylce hys hlāfurd.
text_bare: Genoh byþ soþlice þam leorningcnihte þæt he sy swylce hys lareow, and þeow swylce hys hlafurd.

text: Gyf hī þæs hīredes fæder Belzebub clypedon, mycle swȳþur hig ēow clypiað.
text_bare: Gyf hi þæs hiredes fæder Belzebub clypedon, mycle swyþur hig eow clypiað.

text: Eornustlīce ne ondrǣde gē hig; nys sōþlīce nān þing dȳhle þæt ne wurðe geswutelod, nē nān dīhle þing þæt ne wurðe geopenod.
text_bare: Eornustlice ne ondræde ge hig; nys soþlice nan þing dyhle þæt ne wurðe geswutelod, ne nan dihle þing þæt ne wurðe geopenod.

text: Ðæt ic ēow secge on þȳstrum, secgað hyt on lēohte; and þæt gē on ēare gehȳrað, bodiaþ uppan hrōfum.
text_bare: Ðæt ic eow secge on þystrum, secgað hyt on leohte; and þæt ge on eare gehyrað, bodiaþ uppan hrofum.

text: And ne ondrǣde gē þā ðe ēowyrne līchaman ofslēaþ; ne magon hig sōþlīce þā sāwle ofslēan; ac ondrǣdað mā þone þe mæg sāwle and līchaman fordōn on helle.
text_bare: And ne ondræde ge þa ðe eowyrne lichaman ofsleaþ; ne magon hig soþlice þa sawle ofslean; ac ondrædað ma þone þe mæg sawle and lichaman fordon on helle.

text: Hū ne becȳpað hig twēgen spearwan tō peninge?
text_bare: Hu ne becypað hig twegen spearwan to peninge?

text: and ān of ðām ne befylð on eorðan būtan ēowrun Fæder.
text_bare: and an of ðam ne befylð on eorðan butan eowrun Fæder.

text: And sōþlīce ealle ēowres hēafdes loccas synt getealde.
text_bare: And soþlice ealle eowres heafdes loccas synt getealde.

text: Ne ondrǣde gē; gē synt sēlran þonne manega spearuan.
text_bare: Ne ondræde ge; ge synt selran þonne manega spearuan.

text: Ǣlcne eornustlīce þe mē cȳþ beforan mannun, ic cȳþe hyne beforan mīnun Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
text_bare: Ælcne eornustlice þe me cyþ beforan mannun, ic cyþe hyne beforan minun Fæder þe on heofenum ys.

text: Sē þe mē wiðsæcð beforan mannun, and ic wiþsace hyne beforan mīnum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
text_bare: Se þe me wiðsæcð beforan mannun, and ic wiþsace hyne beforan minum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.

text: Ne wēne gē þæt ic cōme sybbe on eorþan tō sendanne; ne cōm ic sybbe tō sendanne, ac swurd.
text_bare: Ne wene ge þæt ic come sybbe on eorþan to sendanne; ne com ic sybbe to sendanne, ac swurd.

text: Ic cōm sōþlīce mann āsyndrian ongēn hys fæder, and dohtur ongēn hyre mōdur, and snore ongēn hyre swegre;
text_bare: Ic com soþlice mann asyndrian ongen hys fæder, and dohtur ongen hyre modur, and snore ongen hyre swegre;

text: and mannes fȳnd, hys gehūsan.
text_bare: and mannes fynd, hys gehusan.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hys leorningcnihtum, Sē þe lufaþ fæder oððe mōdor mā þonne mē, nys hē mē wyrþe; and sē ðe lufað sunu oððe dohtor swȳþur þonne mē, nys hē mē wyrþe.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to hys leorningcnihtum, Se þe lufaþ fæder oððe modor ma þonne me, nys he me wyrþe; and se ðe lufað sunu oððe dohtor swyþur þonne me, nys he me wyrþe.

text: And sē þe ne nimþ hys cwylminge, and fyligþ mē, nys hē mē wyrþe.
text_bare: And se þe ne nimþ hys cwylminge, and fyligþ me, nys he me wyrþe.

text: Sē þe gemēt hys sāwle sē forspilþ hig; and sē þe forspilþ hys sāwle for mē, hē gemēt hī.
text_bare: Se þe gemet hys sawle se forspilþ hig; and se þe forspilþ hys sawle for me, he gemet hi.

text: Sē þe ēow underfēhþ, hē underfēhð mē; and sē ðe mē underfēhþ, hē underfēhð þone þe mē sende.
text_bare: Se þe eow underfehþ, he underfehð me; and se ðe me underfehþ, he underfehð þone þe me sende.

text: Sē þe underfēhð wītegan on wītegan naman, hē onfēhþ wītygan mēde; and sē þe underfēhþ rihtwīsne on rihtwīses naman, hē onfēhþ rihtwīses mēde.
text_bare: Se þe underfehð witegan on witegan naman, he onfehþ witygan mede; and se þe underfehþ rihtwisne on rihtwises naman, he onfehþ rihtwises mede.

text: And swā hwylc swā sylþ ānne drinc cealdes wæteres ānum þyssa lȳtylra manna on leorningcnihtes naman, sōþ ic secge ēow, Ne āmyrð hē hys mēde.
text_bare: And swa hwylc swa sylþ anne drinc cealdes wæteres anum þyssa lytylra manna on leorningcnihtes naman, soþ ic secge eow, Ne amyrð he hys mede.

text: And hyt wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlynd þys geendude, hys twelf leorningcnihtum bebēodende, hē fōr þanun þæt hē lǣrde and bodude on hyra burgum.
text_bare: And hyt wæs geworden, þa se Hælynd þys geendude, hys twelf leorningcnihtum bebeodende, he for þanun þæt he lærde and bodude on hyra burgum.

text: Þā Iohannes on bendum gehȳrde Crīstes weorc, þā sende hē tō him twēgen hys leorningcnihta,
text_bare: Þa Iohannes on bendum gehyrde Cristes weorc, þa sende he to him twegen hys leorningcnihta,

text: and cwæð, Eart þū þe tō cumenne eart, oððe wē ōþres sceolon ābīdan?
text_bare: and cwæð, Eart þu þe to cumenne eart, oððe we oþres sceolon abidan?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð tō him, Gāþ, and cȳþaþ Iohanne þā ðing þe gē gehȳrdon and gesawōn:
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarude and cwæð to him, Gaþ, and cyþaþ Iohanne þa ðing þe ge gehyrdon and gesawon:

text: blinde gesēoþ, healte gāð, hrēofe synt āclǣnsude, dēafe gehȳraþ, dēade ārīsað, þearfan bodiað.
text_bare: blinde geseoþ, healte gað, hreofe synt aclænsude, deafe gehyraþ, deade arisað, þearfan bodiað.

text: And ēadig ys sē þe ne swicað on mē.
text_bare: And eadig ys se þe ne swicað on me.

text: Ðā hī ūt ēodon, sōþlīce þā ongan sē Hǣlynd secgan be Iohanne and cwæþ tō þǣre menigeo, Hwī ēode gē ūt on wēsten gesēon winde āwegyd hrēod?
text_bare: Ða hi ut eodon, soþlice þa ongan se Hælynd secgan be Iohanne and cwæþ to þære menigeo, Hwi eode ge ut on westen geseon winde awegyd hreod?

text: Oððe hwī ēode gē ūt gesēon mann hnescum gyrlum gescrȳdne?
text_bare: Oððe hwi eode ge ut geseon mann hnescum gyrlum gescrydne?

text: Nū þā þe synt hnescum gyrlum gescrȳdde synt on cyninga hūsum.
text_bare: Nu þa þe synt hnescum gyrlum gescrydde synt on cyninga husum.

text: Ac hwæt ēode gē ūt wītegan gesēon?
text_bare: Ac hwæt eode ge ut witegan geseon?

text: Ic ēow secge, Ēac māran þonne wītegan.
text_bare: Ic eow secge, Eac maran þonne witegan.

text: Ðēs ys sōþlīce be þām āwryten ys, Nū ic sende mīnne engyl beforan þīne ansȳne, sē gegearwað þīnne weg beforan þē.
text_bare: Ðes ys soþlice be þam awryten ys, Nu ic sende minne engyl beforan þine ansyne, se gegearwað þinne weg beforan þe.

text: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ne ārās betwyx wīfa bearnum māra Iohanne fulwihtere; sōðlīce sē þe lǣssa ys ys on heofena rīce him māra.
text_bare: Soþlice ic eow secge, Ne aras betwyx wifa bearnum mara Iohanne fulwihtere; soðlice se þe læssa ys ys on heofena rice him mara.

text: Sōþlīce fram Iohannes dagum fulwihteres oð þis heofena rīce þolað nēad, and strece nimað þæt.
text_bare: Soþlice fram Iohannes dagum fulwihteres oð þis heofena rice þolað nead, and strece nimað þæt.

text: Sōþlīce ealle wītegan and ǣ wītegudun oð Iohannes.
text_bare: Soþlice ealle witegan and æ witegudun oð Iohannes.

text: And gyf gē wyllað gelȳfan, hē ys Helias þe tō cumenne ys.
text_bare: And gyf ge wyllað gelyfan, he ys Helias þe to cumenne ys.

text: Sē ðe ēaran hæbbe tō gehȳrynne, gehȳre.
text_bare: Se ðe earan hæbbe to gehyrynne, gehyre.

text: Sōþlīce hwām telle ic þās cnēorysse gelīce?
text_bare: Soþlice hwam telle ic þas cneorysse gelice?

text: Hēo ys gelīc sittendum cnapun on foretīge; þā hrȳmað tō hyra efengelīcon,
text_bare: Heo ys gelic sittendum cnapun on foretige; þa hrymað to hyra efengelicon,

text: and cweþað, Wē sungun ēow, and gē ne frīcudun; we cwīþdun, and gē ne wēopun.
text_bare: and cweþað, We sungun eow, and ge ne fricudun; we cwiþdun, and ge ne weopun.

text: Sōþlīce Iohannes cōm nē etende nē drincende, and hī cwǣdun, Hē hæfð dēofulsēocnysse.
text_bare: Soþlice Iohannes com ne etende ne drincende, and hi cwædun, He hæfð deofulseocnysse.

text: Mannes Sunu cōm etende and dryncynde, and hī cweðaþ, Hēr ys ettul mann and wīndrincende, mānfulra and synfulra frēond!
text_bare: Mannes Sunu com etende and dryncynde, and hi cweðaþ, Her ys ettul mann and windrincende, manfulra and synfulra freond!

text: And wīsdōm ys gerihtwīsud fram heora bearnum.
text_bare: And wisdom ys gerihtwisud fram heora bearnum.

text: Ðā ongan hē hyspan þā burga on þām wǣrun gedōne manega hys mægena, for þām þe hī ne dydon dǣdbōte.
text_bare: Ða ongan he hyspan þa burga on þam wærun gedone manega hys mægena, for þam þe hi ne dydon dædbote.

text: Wā þē, Corozaim!
text_bare: Wa þe, Corozaim!

text: wā þē, Bethsaida!
text_bare: wa þe, Bethsaida!

text: for þām gyf on Tyro and Sydone wǣrun gedōne þā mægnu þe gedōne synt on ēow, gefyrn hī dydun dǣdbōte on hǣran and on axan.
text_bare: for þam gyf on Tyro and Sydone wærun gedone þa mægnu þe gedone synt on eow, gefyrn hi dydun dædbote on hæran and on axan.

text: Ðēah ic secge inc, Tyro and Sydone byþ forgifenlīcor on dōmes dæg þonne ēow.
text_bare: Ðeah ic secge inc, Tyro and Sydone byþ forgifenlicor on domes dæg þonne eow.

text: And þū Capharnaum, cwyst þū byst þū ūp āhafen oþ heofen?
text_bare: And þu Capharnaum, cwyst þu byst þu up ahafen oþ heofen?

text: ac þū nyþer færst oþ helle; for þām gyf on Sodomum wǣron gedōne þā mægnu þe gedōne synt on þē, witodlīce hī wunedun oþ þysne dæg.
text_bare: ac þu nyþer færst oþ helle; for þam gyf on Sodomum wæron gedone þa mægnu þe gedone synt on þe, witodlice hi wunedun oþ þysne dæg.
