text: Ðēah hwæþere ic secge ēow þæt Sodumwara lande byð forgyfenlīcre on dōmes dæg þonne þē.
text_bare: Ðeah hwæþere ic secge eow þæt Sodumwara lande byð forgyfenlicre on domes dæg þonne þe.

text: Sē Hǣlynd cwæð andswariende, Ic andytte þē, Drihten heofenes and eorþan, þū þe behȳddyst þās þing fram wīsun and glēawun, and onwruge þā lȳtlingun;
text_bare: Se Hælynd cwæð andswariende, Ic andytte þe, Drihten heofenes and eorþan, þu þe behyddyst þas þing fram wisun and gleawun, and onwruge þa lytlingun;

text: swā, Fæder, for þām hyt wæs swā gecwēme beforan þē.
text_bare: swa, Fæder, for þam hyt wæs swa gecweme beforan þe.

text: Ealle þing mē synt gesealde fram mīnum Fædyr; and nān mann ne can þone Sunu, būtun Fadyr; nē nān mann ne can þone Fædyr, būtun Sunu, and þām þe sē Sunu wyle onwrēon.
text_bare: Ealle þing me synt gesealde fram minum Fædyr; and nan mann ne can þone Sunu, butun Fadyr; ne nan mann ne can þone Fædyr, butun Sunu, and þam þe se Sunu wyle onwreon.

text: Cumaþ tō mē, ealle þe swincað and gesȳmede synt, and ic ēow geblissige.
text_bare: Cumaþ to me, ealle þe swincað and gesymede synt, and ic eow geblissige.

text: Nimaþ mīn geoc ofer ēow, and leorniaþ æt mē; for þām ic eom bilwite and ēadmōd on heortan; and gē gemētað reste ēowrum sāwlum.
text_bare: Nimaþ min geoc ofer eow, and leorniaþ æt me; for þam ic eom bilwite and eadmod on heortan; and ge gemetað reste eowrum sawlum.

text: Sōþlīce mīn geoc ys wynsum, and mīn byrþyn ys lēoht.
text_bare: Soþlice min geoc ys wynsum, and min byrþyn ys leoht.

text: Sē Hǣlynd fōr on restedæge ofyr æcyras; sōþlīce hys leorningcnihtas hingryde, and hig ongunnun pluccian þā ēar, and ǣtan.
text_bare: Se Hælynd for on restedæge ofyr æcyras; soþlice hys leorningcnihtas hingryde, and hig ongunnun pluccian þa ear, and ætan.

text: Sōþlīce þā ðā sundorhālgan þæt gesāwon, hī cwǣdon tō him, Nū þīne leorningcnihtas dōð þæt him ālȳfyd nys restedagun tō dōnne.
text_bare: Soþlice þa ða sundorhalgan þæt gesawon, hi cwædon to him, Nu þine leorningcnihtas doð þæt him alyfyd nys restedagun to donne.

text: And hē cwæþ tō him, Ne rǣdde gē hwæt Dauid dyde, þā hyne hingrede, and þā ðe mid hym wǣrun;
text_bare: And he cwæþ to him, Ne rædde ge hwæt Dauid dyde, þa hyne hingrede, and þa ðe mid hym wærun;

text: hū hē in ēode on Godes hūs, and ǣt þā offringhlāfas þe nǣrun him ālȳfede tō etynne nē þām þe mid him wǣrun, būtun þām sācerdum ānum?
text_bare: hu he in eode on Godes hus, and æt þa offringhlafas þe nærun him alyfede to etynne ne þam þe mid him wærun, butun þam sacerdum anum?

text: Oððe ne rǣdde gē on þǣre ǣ þæt þā sācerdas on restedagum on þām temple gewemmað þone restedæg, and synt būtan leahtre?
text_bare: Oððe ne rædde ge on þære æ þæt þa sacerdas on restedagum on þam temple gewemmað þone restedæg, and synt butan leahtre?

text: Ic secge sōðlīce ēow þæt þēs ys mǣrra þonne þæt templ.
text_bare: Ic secge soðlice eow þæt þes ys mærra þonne þæt templ.

text: Gyf gē sōðlīce wistun hwæt ys, Ic wylle mildheortnesse and nā onsægdnysse, ne genyþrude gē ǣfre unscyldige.
text_bare: Gyf ge soðlice wistun hwæt ys, Ic wylle mildheortnesse and na onsægdnysse, ne genyþrude ge æfre unscyldige.

text: Sōðlīce mannes Sunu ys ēac restedæges hlāfurd.
text_bare: Soðlice mannes Sunu ys eac restedæges hlafurd.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend þanun fōr, hē cōm intō hyra gesomnunge.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þanun for, he com into hyra gesomnunge.

text: Þā wæs þǣr ān man sē hæfde forscruncene hand.
text_bare: Þa wæs þær an man se hæfde forscruncene hand.

text: And hī āhsudon hyne þus cweðende, Ys hyt ālȳfed tō hǣlenne on restedagum?
text_bare: And hi ahsudon hyne þus cweðende, Ys hyt alyfed to hælenne on restedagum?

text: þæt hī wrēhton hyne.
text_bare: þæt hi wrehton hyne.

text: Hē sǣde him sōþlīce, Hwylc man ys of ēow þe hæbbe ān scēap, and gyf þæt āfylþ restedagum on pytt, hū ne nymþ hē þæt and hefþ hyt ūpp?
text_bare: He sæde him soþlice, Hwylc man ys of eow þe hæbbe an sceap, and gyf þæt afylþ restedagum on pytt, hu ne nymþ he þæt and hefþ hyt upp?

text: Witodlīce micle mā mann ys scēape betera!
text_bare: Witodlice micle ma mann ys sceape betera!

text: witodlīce ys ālȳfed on restedagum wel tō dōnne.
text_bare: witodlice ys alyfed on restedagum wel to donne.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō þām menn, Āþene þīne hand.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to þam menn, Aþene þine hand.

text: And hē hī āþenede; and hēo wæs hāl geworden swā sēo ōþer.
text_bare: And he hi aþenede; and heo wæs hal geworden swa seo oþer.

text: Þā sundorhālgan ēodun þā ūt sōþlīce, and worhton geþeaht ongēn hyne hū hī hyne forspildon.
text_bare: Þa sundorhalgan eodun þa ut soþlice, and worhton geþeaht ongen hyne hu hi hyne forspildon.

text: Sē Hǣlend sōþlīce þæt wiste, and fērde þanon, and him fyligdon mycel mænigeo; and hē hǣlde hig ealle;
text_bare: Se Hælend soþlice þæt wiste, and ferde þanon, and him fyligdon mycel mænigeo; and he hælde hig ealle;

text: and bebēad him þæt hig hyt nānum men ne sǣdon:
text_bare: and bebead him þæt hig hyt nanum men ne sædon:

text: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt þe gecweden wæs þurh Isaiam þone wītegan, þus cweþende,
text_bare: þæt wære gefylled þæt þe gecweden wæs þurh Isaiam þone witegan, þus cweþende,

text: Hēr is min cnapa þone ic gecēas, mīn gecorena on þām wel gelīcode mīnre sāwle; ic āsette mīnne Gāst ofer hyne, and dōm hē bodað þēodum.
text_bare: Her is min cnapa þone ic geceas, min gecorena on þam wel gelicode minre sawle; ic asette minne Gast ofer hyne, and dom he bodað þeodum.

text: Ne flīt hē, nē hē ne hrȳmð; nē nān man ne gehȳrþ hys stemne on strǣton.
text_bare: Ne flit he, ne he ne hrymð; ne nan man ne gehyrþ hys stemne on stræton.

text: Tōcwȳsed hrēod hē ne forbrytt, and smēocende flex hē ne ādwǣscþ, ǣr þām þe hē āworpe dōm tō sige.
text_bare: Tocwysed hreod he ne forbrytt, and smeocende flex he ne adwæscþ, ær þam þe he aworpe dom to sige.

text: And on hys naman þēoda gehyhtað.
text_bare: And on hys naman þeoda gehyhtað.

text: Ðā wæs him brōht ān dēofolsēoc man sē wæs blind and dumb; and hē hyne hǣlde, swā þæt hē spæc and geseah.
text_bare: Ða wæs him broht an deofolseoc man se wæs blind and dumb; and he hyne hælde, swa þæt he spæc and geseah.

text: And þā menigeo ealle wundrudon, and cwǣdon, Cweðe wē is þēs Dauides sunu?
text_bare: And þa menigeo ealle wundrudon, and cwædon, Cweðe we is þes Dauides sunu?

text: Sōþlīce þā þā sundorhālgan þis gehȳrdon, þā cwǣdon hig, Ne ādrīfþ ðēs dēoflu ūt, būton þurh Belzebub dēofla ealdre.
text_bare: Soþlice þa þa sundorhalgan þis gehyrdon, þa cwædon hig, Ne adrifþ ðes deoflu ut, buton þurh Belzebub deofla ealdre.

text: Sē Hǣlend sōþlīce wiste hyra geþancas, and cwæð tō him, Ǣlc rīce þe byð twȳrǣde on him sylfum byþ tōworpen; and ǣlc ceaster oððe hūs þe byð wiþerweard ongēn hyt sylf, hyt ne stent.
text_bare: Se Hælend soþlice wiste hyra geþancas, and cwæð to him, Ælc rice þe byð twyræde on him sylfum byþ toworpen; and ælc ceaster oððe hus þe byð wiþerweard ongen hyt sylf, hyt ne stent.

text: And gyf sē deoful ādrīfð ūt þone dēoful, hig bēoþ tōdǣlede; hū mæg þonne his rīce standan?
text_bare: And gyf se deoful adrifð ut þone deoful, hig beoþ todælede; hu mæg þonne his rice standan?

text: And gyf ic þurh Belzebub ādrīfe ūt dēofla, þurh hwæne ādrīfað ēowre bearn?
text_bare: And gyf ic þurh Belzebub adrife ut deofla, þurh hwæne adrifað eowre bearn?

text: for þām hig sylfe bēoð ēowre dēman.
text_bare: for þam hig sylfe beoð eowre deman.

text: Gyf ic sōþlīce on Godes Gāste āwurpe dēoflu, witodlīce on ēow becymð Godes rīce.
text_bare: Gyf ic soþlice on Godes Gaste awurpe deoflu, witodlice on eow becymð Godes rice.

text: Oþþe hū mæg man in gān on stranges hūs, and hys fata hyne berēafian, būton hē gebinde ǣrest þone strangan, and þonne hys hūs berēafige?
text_bare: Oþþe hu mæg man in gan on stranges hus, and hys fata hyne bereafian, buton he gebinde ærest þone strangan, and þonne hys hus bereafige?

text: Sē þe nys mid mē, hē is ongēn mē; and sē þe ne gaderaþ mid mē, hē tōwyrpð.
text_bare: Se þe nys mid me, he is ongen me; and se þe ne gaderaþ mid me, he towyrpð.

text: For þām ic secge ēow, Ǣlc synn and bysmurspǣc byþ forgyfen mannum; sōþlīce þæs Hālgan Gāstes bysmurspǣc ne byð forgyfen.
text_bare: For þam ic secge eow, Ælc synn and bysmurspæc byþ forgyfen mannum; soþlice þæs Halgan Gastes bysmurspæc ne byð forgyfen.

text: And swā hwylc swā cwyð word ongēn mannes Sunu, him byð forgyfen; sē þe sōðlīce cwyþ ongēn Hāligne Gāst, ne byð hyt hym forgyfen, nē on þisse worulde nē on þǣre tōweardan.
text_bare: And swa hwylc swa cwyð word ongen mannes Sunu, him byð forgyfen; se þe soðlice cwyþ ongen Haligne Gast, ne byð hyt hym forgyfen, ne on þisse worulde ne on þære toweardan.

text: Oþþe wyrceað gōd trēow, and hys wæstm gōdne, oððe wyrceað yfel trēow, and hys wæstm yfelne; witodlīce be þām wæstme byð þæt trēow oncnāwen.
text_bare: Oþþe wyrceað god treow, and hys wæstm godne, oððe wyrceað yfel treow, and hys wæstm yfelne; witodlice be þam wæstme byð þæt treow oncnawen.

text: Lā gē nǣddrena cynryn, hū magon gē gōd sprecan, þonne gē synt yfele?
text_bare: La ge næddrena cynryn, hu magon ge god sprecan, þonne ge synt yfele?

text: sōþlīce of pǣre heortan willan sē mūþ spicþ.
text_bare: soþlice of pære heortan willan se muþ spicþ.

text: Gōd mann sōþlīce of gōdum goldhorde bringþ gōd forð; and yfel mann of yfelum goldhorde bringð yfel forð.
text_bare: God mann soþlice of godum goldhorde bringþ god forð; and yfel mann of yfelum goldhorde bringð yfel forð.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt ǣlc īdel word þe menn specað, hī āgyldaþ gescēad be þām on dōmes dæge.
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow þæt ælc idel word þe menn specað, hi agyldaþ gescead be þam on domes dæge.

text: Sōþlīce of þīnum wordum þū byst gerihtwīsod, and of þīnum wordum þū byst genyðerod.
text_bare: Soþlice of þinum wordum þu byst gerihtwisod, and of þinum wordum þu byst genyðerod.

text: Þā andswarodun hym sume þā bōceras and þā sundorhālgan þus cweþende, Lārēow, wē willaþ sum tācn of þē gesēon.
text_bare: Þa andswarodun hym sume þa boceras and þa sundorhalgan þus cweþende, Lareow, we willaþ sum tacn of þe geseon.

text: Hē andswarode hym and cwæð, Yfel cnēorys and forliger sēcð tācn; and hyre ne byð nān tācn geseald, būton Ionas tācn þæs wītegan.
text_bare: He andswarode hym and cwæð, Yfel cneorys and forliger secð tacn; and hyre ne byð nan tacn geseald, buton Ionas tacn þæs witegan.

text: Witodlīce swā swā Ionas wæs on þæs hwæles innoþe þrȳ dāgas and þrēo niht, swā byþ mannes Sunu on eorþan heortan þrȳ dagas and þrēo niht.
text_bare: Witodlice swa swa Ionas wæs on þæs hwæles innoþe þry dagas and þreo niht, swa byþ mannes Sunu on eorþan heortan þry dagas and þreo niht.

text: Niniuetisce weras ārīsað on dōme mid þysse cnēorysse, and hig genyþeriað hig; for þām þe hig dydon dǣdbōte on Ionas bodunge; and þēs ys māra þonne Ionas.
text_bare: Niniuetisce weras arisað on dome mid þysse cneorysse, and hig genyþeriað hig; for þam þe hig dydon dædbote on Ionas bodunge; and þes ys mara þonne Ionas.

text: Sūþdǣles cwēn ārīst on dōme mid þysse cnēorysse, and hēo genyþerað hig; for þām ðe hēo cōm fram landes gemǣrum tō gehȳranne Salomones wīsdōm; and þēs is māra þonne Salomon.
text_bare: Suþdæles cwen arist on dome mid þysse cneorysse, and heo genyþerað hig; for þam ðe heo com fram landes gemærum to gehyranne Salomones wisdom; and þes is mara þonne Salomon.

text: Sōþlīce þonne sē unclǣna gāst ūt færþ fram men, hē gǣð geond drīge stōwa, sēcende rest, and hē ne gemēt.
text_bare: Soþlice þonne se unclæna gast ut færþ fram men, he gæð geond drige stowa, secende rest, and he ne gemet.

text: Þonne cwyþ hē, Ic gecyrre on mīn hūs þanon ic ūt ēode; and cumende hē gemēt hyt ǣmtig, and geclǣnsod mid besmum, and gefrætwod.
text_bare: Þonne cwyþ he, Ic gecyrre on min hus þanon ic ut eode; and cumende he gemet hyt æmtig, and geclænsod mid besmum, and gefrætwod.

text: Ðonne gǣþ hē, and him tō genymþ seofun ōþre gāstas wyrsan þonne hē, and in gangende hig eardigeað þǣr; and þonne wurðaþ þæs mannes ȳtemestan wyrsan þonne þā ǣrran.
text_bare: Ðonne gæþ he, and him to genymþ seofun oþre gastas wyrsan þonne he, and in gangende hig eardigeað þær; and þonne wurðaþ þæs mannes ytemestan wyrsan þonne þa ærran.

text: And swā byð þysse wyrrestan cnēorysse.
text_bare: And swa byð þysse wyrrestan cneorysse.

text: Ðā hē þās þing þā gȳt spæc tō þām mænegum, þā stōd hys mōdor and his gebrōðra þǣr ūte, sēcende spæcon tō him.
text_bare: Ða he þas þing þa gyt spæc to þam mænegum, þa stod hys modor and his gebroðra þær ute, secende spæcon to him.

text: Sōþlīce þā cwæþ sum tō him, Witodlīce þīn mōdur and þīne gebrōþra standaþ hēr ūte, þē sēcende.
text_bare: Soþlice þa cwæþ sum to him, Witodlice þin modur and þine gebroþra standaþ her ute, þe secende.

text: And hē andswarode hym secgendum and cwæð, Hwylc ys mīn mōdur?
text_bare: And he andswarode hym secgendum and cwæð, Hwylc ys min modur?

text: and hwylce synt mīne gebrōþra?
text_bare: and hwylce synt mine gebroþra?

text: And hē āþenede hys hand on his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð,
text_bare: And he aþenede hys hand on his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð,

text: Witodlīce swā hwylc swā wyrcþ mīnes Fæder willan þe on heofenan is, he is mīn brōþur, and mīn swustor, and mōdor.
text_bare: Witodlice swa hwylc swa wyrcþ mines Fæder willan þe on heofenan is, he is min broþur, and min swustor, and modor.

text: On þām dæge þām Hǣlende ūt gangendum of hūse, hē sæt wiþ ðā sǣ.
text_bare: On þam dæge þam Hælende ut gangendum of huse, he sæt wiþ ða sæ.

text: And mycle mænigeo wǣron gesamnode tō hym, swā þæt hē ēode on scyp, and þǣr sæt; and eall sēo mænigeo stōd on þām waroþe.
text_bare: And mycle mænigeo wæron gesamnode to hym, swa þæt he eode on scyp, and þær sæt; and eall seo mænigeo stod on þam waroþe.

text: And hē spræc tō hym fela on bigspellum, cweþende, Sōþlīce ūt ēode sē sǣdere hys sǣd tō sāwenne.
text_bare: And he spræc to hym fela on bigspellum, cweþende, Soþlice ut eode se sædere hys sæd to sawenne.

text: And þā þā hē sēow, sume hig fēollon wiþ weg; and fuglas cōmun, and ǣton þā.
text_bare: And þa þa he seow, sume hig feollon wiþ weg; and fuglas comun, and æton þa.

text: Sōþlīce sume fēollon on stǣnihte, þǣr hyt næfde mycle eorþan; and hrædlīce ūp sprungon, for þām þe hig næfdon þǣre eorþan dȳpan.
text_bare: Soþlice sume feollon on stænihte, þær hyt næfde mycle eorþan; and hrædlice up sprungon, for þam þe hig næfdon þære eorþan dypan.

text: Sōþlīce ūp sprungenre sunnan, hig ādrūwudon; and forscruncon, for þām þe hig næfdon wyrtrum.
text_bare: Soþlice up sprungenre sunnan, hig adruwudon; and forscruncon, for þam þe hig næfdon wyrtrum.

text: Sōþlīce sume fēollon on þornas; and þā þornas wēoxon, and forþrysmudon þā.
text_bare: Soþlice sume feollon on þornas; and þa þornas weoxon, and forþrysmudon þa.

text: Sume sōþlīce fēollon on gōde eorþan, and sealdon wæstm, sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne, sum þrīttigfealdne.
text_bare: Sume soþlice feollon on gode eorþan, and sealdon wæstm, sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne, sum þrittigfealdne.

text: Sē þe hæbbe ēaran tō gehȳrenne, gehȳre.
text_bare: Se þe hæbbe earan to gehyrenne, gehyre.

text: And þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas, and cwǣdon tō hym, For hwig spycst þū tō hym mid bigspellum?
text_bare: And þa genealæhton his leorningcnihtas, and cwædon to hym, For hwig spycst þu to hym mid bigspellum?

text: Ðā andswarode hē hym, For þām þe ēow is geseald tō witanne heofena rīces gerȳnu, and him nys nā geseald.
text_bare: Ða andswarode he hym, For þam þe eow is geseald to witanne heofena rices gerynu, and him nys na geseald.

text: Sōþlīce þām þe hæfþ, him byþ geseald, and hē hæfð; sōþlīce sē þe næfð, and þæt þe hē hæfð him bið ætbrōden.
text_bare: Soþlice þam þe hæfþ, him byþ geseald, and he hæfð; soþlice se þe næfð, and þæt þe he hæfð him bið ætbroden.

text: For ðām ic spece tō him mid bigspellum; for þām þe lōciende hig ne gesēoþ, and gehȳrende hig ne gehȳraþ nē ne ongytaþ:
text_bare: For ðam ic spece to him mid bigspellum; for þam þe lociende hig ne geseoþ, and gehyrende hig ne gehyraþ ne ne ongytaþ:

text: þæt on him sī gefylled Esaias wītegung, Of gehȳrnysse gē gehȳraþ, and gē ne ongytaþ; and lōciende gē gesēoþ, and gē ne gesēoð.
text_bare: þæt on him si gefylled Esaias witegung, Of gehyrnysse ge gehyraþ, and ge ne ongytaþ; and lociende ge geseoþ, and ge ne geseoð.

text: Sōþlīce þises folces heorte is āhyrd, and hig hefelīce mid ēarum gehȳrdon, and hyra ēagan beclȳsdon; þē lǣs hig ǣfre mid ēagum gesēon, and mid ēarum gehȳron, and mid heortan ongyton, and sīn gecyrrede, and ic hig gehǣle.
text_bare: Soþlice þises folces heorte is ahyrd, and hig hefelice mid earum gehyrdon, and hyra eagan beclysdon; þe læs hig æfre mid eagum geseon, and mid earum gehyron, and mid heortan ongyton, and sin gecyrrede, and ic hig gehæle.

text: Sōþlīce ēadige synt ēowre ēagan, for þām þe hig gesēoþ; and ēowre ēaran, for þām þe hig gehȳraþ.
text_bare: Soþlice eadige synt eowre eagan, for þam þe hig geseoþ; and eowre earan, for þam þe hig gehyraþ.

text: Sōþlīce on eornust ic ēow secge þæt manega wītegan and rihtwīse gewilnudon þā þing tō gesēonne þe gē gesēoþ, and hig ne gesāwon; and gehȳran þā þing þe gē gehȳrað, and hig ne gehȳrdon.
text_bare: Soþlice on eornust ic eow secge þæt manega witegan and rihtwise gewilnudon þa þing to geseonne þe ge geseoþ, and hig ne gesawon; and gehyran þa þing þe ge gehyrað, and hig ne gehyrdon.

text: Gehȳre gē sōþlīce þæs sāwendan bigspell.
text_bare: Gehyre ge soþlice þæs sawendan bigspell.

text: Ǣlc þǣra þe Godes word gehȳrð and ne ongyt, þonne cymþ dēoful and berēafað þæt on hys heortan āsawen is; þæt is sē þe wiþ ðone weg āsawen is.
text_bare: Ælc þæra þe Godes word gehyrð and ne ongyt, þonne cymþ deoful and bereafað þæt on hys heortan asawen is; þæt is se þe wiþ ðone weg asawen is.

text: Sōþlīce sē þe ofer þone stān āsawen is, þæt is sē þe þæt Godes word gehȳrð, and hrædlīce þæt mid blisse onfēhþ;
text_bare: Soþlice se þe ofer þone stan asawen is, þæt is se þe þæt Godes word gehyrð, and hrædlice þæt mid blisse onfehþ;

text: sōþlīce hyt næfþ þone wyrtrum on him, ac is hwīlwendlīc; gewordenre gedrēfednesse and ēhtnesse for þām worde, hrædlīce big bēoð geuntrēowsode.
text_bare: soþlice hyt næfþ þone wyrtrum on him, ac is hwilwendlic; gewordenre gedrefednesse and ehtnesse for þam worde, hrædlice big beoð geuntreowsode.

text: Sōþlīce þæt þe āsawen is on þornum, þæt is sē þe þæt word gehȳrþ; and þonne geornfullnes þisse worulde and lēasung þissa woruldwelena forþrysmiaþ þæt word, and hit is būtan wæstme geworden.
text_bare: Soþlice þæt þe asawen is on þornum, þæt is se þe þæt word gehyrþ; and þonne geornfullnes þisse worulde and leasung þissa woruldwelena forþrysmiaþ þæt word, and hit is butan wæstme geworden.

text: Sōþlīce þæt þe āsawen wæs on þæt gōde land, þæt is sē þe þæt word gehȳrþ and ongyt; and þone wæstm bringð, and þonne dēþ sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne, sum þrīttigfealdne.
text_bare: Soþlice þæt þe asawen wæs on þæt gode land, þæt is se þe þæt word gehyrþ and ongyt; and þone wæstm bringð, and þonne deþ sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne, sum þrittigfealdne.

text: Hē rehte him þā ōþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofona rīce is geworden þām men gelīc þe sēow gōd sǣd on his æcyre.
text_bare: He rehte him þa oþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofona rice is geworden þam men gelic þe seow god sæd on his æcyre.

text: Sōþlīce þā þā men slēpon, þā cōm his fēonda sum, and ofersēow hit mid coccele on middan þām hwǣte, and fērde þanon.
text_bare: Soþlice þa þa men slepon, þa com his feonda sum, and oferseow hit mid coccele on middan þam hwæte, and ferde þanon.

text: Sōþlīce þā sēo wyrt wēox, and þone wæstm brōhte, þā ætēowde sē coccel hine.
text_bare: Soþlice þa seo wyrt weox, and þone wæstm brohte, þa æteowde se coccel hine.

text: Þā ēodon þæs hlāfordes þēowas, and cwǣdon, Hlāford, hū ne sēow þū gōd sǣd on þīnum æcere?
text_bare: Þa eodon þæs hlafordes þeowas, and cwædon, Hlaford, hu ne seow þu god sæd on þinum æcere?

text: hwanon hæfde hē coccel?
text_bare: hwanon hæfde he coccel?

text: Þā cwæþ hē, Þæt dyde unhold mann.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ he, Þæt dyde unhold mann.

text: Þā cwǣdon þā þēowas, Wylt þū wē gāð and gadriað hig?
text_bare: Þa cwædon þa þeowas, Wylt þu we gað and gadriað hig?

text: Þā cwæð hē, Nese, þē lǣs gē þone hwǣte āwurtwalion, þonne gē þone coccel gadriað.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Nese, þe læs ge þone hwæte awurtwalion, þonne ge þone coccel gadriað.

text: Lǣtað ǣgþer weaxan oð riptīman; and on þām riptīman ic secge þām rīperum, Gadriaþ ǣrest þone coccel, and bindaþ scēafmǣlum to forbærnenne; and gadriaþ ðone hwǣte intō mīnum berne.
text_bare: Lætað ægþer weaxan oð riptiman; and on þam riptiman ic secge þam riperum, Gadriaþ ærest þone coccel, and bindaþ sceafmælum to forbærnenne; and gadriaþ ðone hwæte into minum berne.

text: Hē rehte him þā gȳt ōþer bigspel þus cweþende, Heofena rīce is geworden gelīc senepes corne þæt sēow sē man on hys æcre.
text_bare: He rehte him þa gyt oþer bigspel þus cweþende, Heofena rice is geworden gelic senepes corne þæt seow se man on hys æcre.

text: Þæt is ealra sǣda lǣst; sōþlīce þonne hit wyxþ, hit is ealra wyrta mǣst, and hit wyrþ trēow, swā þæt heofnan fuhlas cumaþ and eardiaþ on his bōgum.
text_bare: Þæt is ealra sæda læst; soþlice þonne hit wyxþ, hit is ealra wyrta mæst, and hit wyrþ treow, swa þæt heofnan fuhlas cumaþ and eardiaþ on his bogum.

text: Hē spræc tō him ōþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofena rīce is gelīc þām beorman þone þæt wīf onfēng and behȳdde on þrīm gemetum melwes, oð hē wæs eall āhafen.
text_bare: He spræc to him oþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofena rice is gelic þam beorman þone þæt wif onfeng and behydde on þrim gemetum melwes, oð he wæs eall ahafen.

text: Ealle þās þing sē Hǣlend spræc mid bigspellum tō þām weredum, and nān þing ne spræc hē būtan bigspellum:
text_bare: Ealle þas þing se Hælend spræc mid bigspellum to þam weredum, and nan þing ne spræc he butan bigspellum:

text: þæt wǣre gefylled þæs wītegan cwyde, Ic ātȳne mīnne mūþ mid bigspellum; ic bodige dīgelnesse fram middaneardes gesetednesse.
text_bare: þæt wære gefylled þæs witegan cwyde, Ic atyne minne muþ mid bigspellum; ic bodige digelnesse fram middaneardes gesetednesse.

text: Hē forlēt þā ðā mænegeo, and cōm tō his inne; and þā genēalǣhton tō him his leorningcnihtas, and cwǣdon, Ārece ūs þæt bigspell þæs hwǣtes and þæs coccles.
text_bare: He forlet þa ða mænegeo, and com to his inne; and þa genealæhton to him his leorningcnihtas, and cwædon, Arece us þæt bigspell þæs hwætes and þæs coccles.

text: Þā andswarude hē him, Sē þe sēow þæt gōde sǣd sē is mannes Sunu.
text_bare: Þa andswarude he him, Se þe seow þæt gode sæd se is mannes Sunu.

text: Sōþlīce sē æcyr is þēs middangeard; þæt gōde sǣd, þæt synt þæs heofonlīcan rices bearn; sē coccel synt sōþlīce þā mānfullan bearn.
text_bare: Soþlice se æcyr is þes middangeard; þæt gode sæd, þæt synt þæs heofonlican rices bearn; se coccel synt soþlice þa manfullan bearn.

text: Sē unholda man sē þe þone coccel sēow, þæt is dēoful; sōðlīce þæt rip is worulde endung; þā rīperas synt englas.
text_bare: Se unholda man se þe þone coccel seow, þæt is deoful; soðlice þæt rip is worulde endung; þa riperas synt englas.

text: Eornustlīce swā swā sē coccel byþ gegaderud and mid fȳre forbærned, swā byð on worulde endunge.
text_bare: Eornustlice swa swa se coccel byþ gegaderud and mid fyre forbærned, swa byð on worulde endunge.

text: Mannes Sunu sent his englas, and hī gadriað of his rīce ealle gedrēfednesse, and þā þe unrihtwīsnesse wyrceað,
text_bare: Mannes Sunu sent his englas, and hi gadriað of his rice ealle gedrefednesse, and þa þe unrihtwisnesse wyrceað,

text: and āsendað hig on fȳres ofen; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
text_bare: and asendað hig on fyres ofen; þær byþ wop and toþa gristbitung.

text: Þonne scīnað ðā rihtwīsan swā swā sunne on hyra Fæder rice.
text_bare: Þonne scinað ða rihtwisan swa swa sunne on hyra Fæder rice.

text: Gehȳre, sē ðe ēaran to gehȳranne hæfð.
text_bare: Gehyre, se ðe earan to gehyranne hæfð.

text: Heofona rīce is gelīc gehȳddum goldhorde on þām æcere; þone behȳt sē man þe hyne fint; and for his blysse gǣð and sylþ eall þæt hē āh, and gebigþ þone æcer.
text_bare: Heofona rice is gelic gehyddum goldhorde on þam æcere; þone behyt se man þe hyne fint; and for his blysse gæð and sylþ eall þæt he ah, and gebigþ þone æcer.

text: Eft is heofena rīce gelīc þām mangere þe sōhte þæt gōde meregrot;
text_bare: Eft is heofena rice gelic þam mangere þe sohte þæt gode meregrot;

text: þā hē funde þæt ān dēorwyrðe meregrot, þā ēode hē and sealde eall þæt hē āhte, and bohte þæt meregrot.
text_bare: þa he funde þæt an deorwyrðe meregrot, þa eode he and sealde eall þæt he ahte, and bohte þæt meregrot.

text: Eft is heofena rīce gelīc āsendum nette on þā sǣ, and of ǣlcum fisccynne gadrigendum;
text_bare: Eft is heofena rice gelic asendum nette on þa sæ, and of ælcum fisccynne gadrigendum;

text: þā hī þā þæt nett ūpp ātugon, and sǣton be þām strande, þā gecuron hig þā gōdan on hyra fatu; þā yflan hig āwurpon ūt.
text_bare: þa hi þa þæt nett upp atugon, and sæton be þam strande, þa gecuron hig þa godan on hyra fatu; þa yflan hig awurpon ut.

text: Swā byþ on þisse worulde endunge; þā englas farað and āsyndriað þā yfelan of þǣra gōdra midlene,
text_bare: Swa byþ on þisse worulde endunge; þa englas farað and asyndriað þa yfelan of þæra godra midlene,

text: and āworpað hig on þæs fȳres ofen; þǣr byð wōþ and tōða grīstbitung.
text_bare: and aworpað hig on þæs fyres ofen; þær byð woþ and toða gristbitung.

text: Ongyte gē ealle þās þing?
text_bare: Ongyte ge ealle þas þing?

text: Þā cwǣdon hig, Witodlīce wē hit ongytað.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hig, Witodlice we hit ongytað.

text: Þā sǣde hē him, For þām is ǣlc gelǣred bōcere on heofenan rīce gelīc þām hīredes ealdre þe forð bringð of his goldhorde nīwe þing and ealde.
text_bare: Þa sæde he him, For þam is ælc gelæred bocere on heofenan rice gelic þam hiredes ealdre þe forð bringð of his goldhorde niwe þing and ealde.

text: And hit wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlend geendode þās bigspel, þā fērde hē þanone.
text_bare: And hit wæs geworden, þa se Hælend geendode þas bigspel, þa ferde he þanone.

text: And þā hē cōm tō his earde, hē lǣrde hig on hyra gesamnungum, swā þæt hig wundredon and cwǣdon, Hwanon ys þysum þēs wisdōm and þis mægen?
text_bare: And þa he com to his earde, he lærde hig on hyra gesamnungum, swa þæt hig wundredon and cwædon, Hwanon ys þysum þes wisdom and þis mægen?

text: Witodlīce þēs ys smiþes sunu; hū ne hātte hys mōdor Maria, and hys brōþru Iacob, and Ioseph, and Simon, and Iudas?
text_bare: Witodlice þes ys smiþes sunu; hu ne hatte hys modor Maria, and hys broþru Iacob, and Ioseph, and Simon, and Iudas?

text: And hū ne synt ealle hys swustra mid ūs?
text_bare: And hu ne synt ealle hys swustra mid us?

text: Hwanon synt þisum ealle þās þing?
text_bare: Hwanon synt þisum ealle þas þing?

text: And hig wǣron geuntrȳwsode on him.
text_bare: And hig wæron geuntrywsode on him.

text: Ðā sōþlīce sǣde sē Hǣlend hym, Nys nān wītega būtan wurþscype, būton on hys earde and on hys hūse.
text_bare: Ða soþlice sæde se Hælend hym, Nys nan witega butan wurþscype, buton on hys earde and on hys huse.

text: And hē ne worhte þǣr manega mægena, for hyra ungelēafulnysse.
text_bare: And he ne worhte þær manega mægena, for hyra ungeleafulnysse.

text: On þǣre tīde gehȳrde Herodes sē fēorðan dǣles rīca þæs Hǣlendes hlīsan.
text_bare: On þære tide gehyrde Herodes se feorðan dæles rica þæs Hælendes hlisan.

text: And þā sǣde hē his cnihtum, Þēs is Iohannes sē fulluhtere þe ic behēafdode; hē ārās of dēaþe; and for þan synd þās wundru gefremode on him.
text_bare: And þa sæde he his cnihtum, Þes is Iohannes se fulluhtere þe ic beheafdode; he aras of deaþe; and for þan synd þas wundru gefremode on him.

text: Sōðlīce Herodes nam Iohannem, and geband hyne, and sette on cwertern for þām wife Herodiaden, Philippes hys brōþer.
text_bare: Soðlice Herodes nam Iohannem, and geband hyne, and sette on cwertern for þam wife Herodiaden, Philippes hys broþer.

text: Iohannes him sǣde, Nys þē ālȳfed hī tō wīfe tō hæbbenne.
text_bare: Iohannes him sæde, Nys þe alyfed hi to wife to hæbbenne.

text: And þā hē hyne ofslēan wolde, hē ādrēd him þæt folc, for þām þe hig hæfdon hyne for ǣnne wītegan.
text_bare: And þa he hyne ofslean wolde, he adred him þæt folc, for þam þe hig hæfdon hyne for ænne witegan.

text: Ðā on Herodes gebyrddæge tumbude þǣre Herodiadiscean dohtur beforan him; and hit līcode Herode.
text_bare: Ða on Herodes gebyrddæge tumbude þære Herodiadiscean dohtur beforan him; and hit licode Herode.

text: Þā behēt hē mid āþe hyre tō syllenne swā hwæt swā hēo hyne bǣde.
text_bare: Þa behet he mid aþe hyre to syllenne swa hwæt swa heo hyne bæde.

text: Ðā cwæð hēo, fram hyre mēder gemyngod, Syle mē on ānum disce Iohannes hēafod þæs fulluhteres.
text_bare: Ða cwæð heo, fram hyre meder gemyngod, Syle me on anum disce Iohannes heafod þæs fulluhteres.

text: Ðā wæs sē cyning geunrēt for þām āðe, and for þām þe him sǣton mid.
text_bare: Ða wæs se cyning geunret for þam aðe, and for þam þe him sæton mid.

text: And hē āsende þā, and behēafdode Iohannem on þām cwerterne.
text_bare: And he asende þa, and beheafdode Iohannem on þam cwerterne.

text: And man brōhte þā his hēafod on ānum disce, and sealde þām mǣdene, and þæt mǣden hyre mēder.
text_bare: And man brohte þa his heafod on anum disce, and sealde þam mædene, and þæt mæden hyre meder.

text: And þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas, and nāmon hys līchaman, and bebyrgdon hyne, and cōmon and cȳddon hyt þām Hǣlende.
text_bare: And þa genealæhton his leorningcnihtas, and namon hys lichaman, and bebyrgdon hyne, and comon and cyddon hyt þam Hælende.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend þæt gehȳrde, þā fērde hē þanon onsundron on ānum scype; and þā þā gangendan mænigeo þæt gehȳrdon, hig fyligdon him of þām burgum.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þæt gehyrde, þa ferde he þanon onsundron on anum scype; and þa þa gangendan mænigeo þæt gehyrdon, hig fyligdon him of þam burgum.

text: And þā hē þanon fērde, hē geseh mycele mænigu; and hē him gemiltsode, and gehǣlde þā untruman.
text_bare: And þa he þanon ferde, he geseh mycele mænigu; and he him gemiltsode, and gehælde þa untruman.

text: Sōðlīce þā hyt wæs ǣfen geworden, him tō genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him tō cwǣdon, Ðēos stōw ys wēste, and tīma is forð āgān; forlǣt þās mænegeo þæt hī faron intō þās burga and him mete bicgean.
text_bare: Soðlice þa hyt wæs æfen geworden, him to genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him to cwædon, Ðeos stow ys weste, and tima is forð agan; forlæt þas mænegeo þæt hi faron into þas burga and him mete bicgean.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Nabbað hī nēode to farenne; sylle gē him etan.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend to him, Nabbað hi neode to farenne; sylle ge him etan.

text: Þā andswarodun hig, Wē nabbað hēr būtun fīf hlāfas and twēgen fixas.
text_bare: Þa andswarodun hig, We nabbað her butun fif hlafas and twegen fixas.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Bringaþ mē hider þā.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Bringaþ me hider þa.

text: And þā hē hēt þā menegu ofer þæt gærs hī sittan; and hē nam þā fīf hlāfas and twēgen fixas, and beseah on þone heofon, and blētsiende bræc þā hlāfas, and sealde his leorningcnihtum, and hī þām folce.
text_bare: And þa he het þa menegu ofer þæt gærs hi sittan; and he nam þa fif hlafas and twegen fixas, and beseah on þone heofon, and bletsiende bræc þa hlafas, and sealde his leorningcnihtum, and hi þam folce.

text: And hī ǣton ealle and wǣron gefyllede; and hī nāmon þā lāfa, twelf wylian fulle þǣra gebrytsena.
text_bare: And hi æton ealle and wæron gefyllede; and hi namon þa lafa, twelf wylian fulle þæra gebrytsena.

text: Sōþlīce þǣra etendra getæl wæs fīf þūsenda wera, būtan wīfum and cildum.
text_bare: Soþlice þæra etendra getæl wæs fif þusenda wera, butan wifum and cildum.

text: And þā sōna hēt sē Hǣlend his leorningcnihtas on scyp āstīgan, and tōforan him faran ofer þone mūþan, oð þæt hē þā menegu forlēte.
text_bare: And þa sona het se Hælend his leorningcnihtas on scyp astigan, and toforan him faran ofer þone muþan, oð þæt he þa menegu forlete.

text: And þā hē hig forlǣten hæfde, hē ēode on þone munt, and hyne þǣr āna gebæd; sōþlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, hē wæs āna þǣr.
text_bare: And þa he hig forlæten hæfde, he eode on þone munt, and hyne þær ana gebæd; soþlice þa hyt æfen wæs, he wæs ana þær.

text: Witodlīce wæs þæt scyp of þām ȳþum tōtorfod; for þām þe hyt wæs strang wind.
text_bare: Witodlice wæs þæt scyp of þam yþum totorfod; for þam þe hyt wæs strang wind.

text: Þā cōm sē Hǣlend embe þone fēorþan hancrēd tō him, ofer þā sǣ gangende.
text_bare: Þa com se Hælend embe þone feorþan hancred to him, ofer þa sæ gangende.

text: Ðā hī gesāwon þæt, hī wurdon þā gedrēfede, and for þām ege clypodon and cwǣdon þus, Sōþlīce hyt ys scīnlāc.
text_bare: Ða hi gesawon þæt, hi wurdon þa gedrefede, and for þam ege clypodon and cwædon þus, Soþlice hyt ys scinlac.

text: Ðā spræc sē Hǣlend and cwæþ, Habbaþ gelēafan; ic hyt eom; nellen gē ēow ondrǣdan.
text_bare: Ða spræc se Hælend and cwæþ, Habbaþ geleafan; ic hyt eom; nellen ge eow ondrædan.

text: Ðā andswarode him Petrus and cwæð, Drihten, gyf þū hyt eart, hāt mē cuman tō þē ofer þās wæteru.
text_bare: Ða andswarode him Petrus and cwæð, Drihten, gyf þu hyt eart, hat me cuman to þe ofer þas wæteru.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Cum tō mē.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Cum to me.

text: Ðā ēode Petrus of þām scype ofer þæt wæter þæt hē tō þām Hǣlende cōme.
text_bare: Ða eode Petrus of þam scype ofer þæt wæter þæt he to þam Hælende come.

text: Þā hē geseh þone strangan wind, hē him ondrēd; ðā hē wearð gedofen, hē cwæð, Drihten, gedō mē hālne.
text_bare: Þa he geseh þone strangan wind, he him ondred; ða he wearð gedofen, he cwæð, Drihten, gedo me halne.

text: And þā hrædlīce hē gefēng hyne, and þus cwæð, Lā lȳtles gelēafan, hwī twȳnedest þū?
text_bare: And þa hrædlice he gefeng hyne, and þus cwæð, La lytles geleafan, hwi twynedest þu?

text: And þā hī wǣron on þām scype, geswāc sē wind.
text_bare: And þa hi wæron on þam scype, geswac se wind.

text: Sōþlīce þā þe on þām scype wǣron cōmon, and tō him gebǣdon, and þus cwǣdon, Sōþlīce þū eart Godes Sunu.
text_bare: Soþlice þa þe on þam scype wæron comon, and to him gebædon, and þus cwædon, Soþlice þu eart Godes Sunu.

text: And þā hig ofer segelodon, hī cōmon on þæt land Genesareth.
text_bare: And þa hig ofer segelodon, hi comon on þæt land Genesareth.

text: And þā þæt folc hyne gecnēow, hī sendon geond eall þæt land, and brōhton tō him ealle untrume;
text_bare: And þa þæt folc hyne gecneow, hi sendon geond eall þæt land, and brohton to him ealle untrume;

text: and hyne bǣdon þæt hig huruþinga his rēafes fnæd æthrinon; and swā hwylce his æthrinon wurdon hāle.
text_bare: and hyne bædon þæt hig huruþinga his reafes fnæd æthrinon; and swa hwylce his æthrinon wurdon hale.

text: Ðā cōmon tō him fram Hierusalem þā bōceras and Fariseisce, and cwǣdon,
text_bare: Ða comon to him fram Hierusalem þa boceras and Fariseisce, and cwædon,

text: Hwī forgȳmað þīne leorningcnihtas ūre yldrena lage?
text_bare: Hwi forgymað þine leorningcnihtas ure yldrena lage?

text: ne þwēað hī hyra handa, þonne hig mete þicgeað.
text_bare: ne þweað hi hyra handa, þonne hig mete þicgeað.

text: Ðā andsworode hē him, And hwī forgȳme gē Godes bebod for ēowre lage?
text_bare: Ða andsworode he him, And hwi forgyme ge Godes bebod for eowre lage?

text: Witodlīce God cwæþ, Wurþa þīnne fæder and mōdor; and, Sē þe wyrgð hys fæder and mōdor, swelte sē dēaþe.
text_bare: Witodlice God cwæþ, Wurþa þinne fæder and modor; and, Se þe wyrgð hys fæder and modor, swelte se deaþe.

text: Sōþlīce gē cweðaþ, Swā hwylc swā segð hys fæder and mēder, Swā hwylc lāc swā of mē is fremaþ þē;
text_bare: Soþlice ge cweðaþ, Swa hwylc swa segð hys fæder and meder, Swa hwylc lac swa of me is fremaþ þe;

text: and ne wurðiaþ fæder and mōdor.
text_bare: and ne wurðiaþ fæder and modor.

text: And gē for nāht dydon Godes bebod for ēowre lage.
text_bare: And ge for naht dydon Godes bebod for eowre lage.

text: La līcceteras, wel be ēow wītegode Isaias sē wītega, þā hē cwæð,
text_bare: La licceteras, wel be eow witegode Isaias se witega, þa he cwæð,

text: Þis folc mē mid welerum wurþað, and hyra heorte ys feorr fram mē;
text_bare: Þis folc me mid welerum wurþað, and hyra heorte ys feorr fram me;

text: būtan intingan hig mē wurþiaþ, and lǣrað manna lāra.
text_bare: butan intingan hig me wurþiaþ, and lærað manna lara.

text: And hē þā, ðām menegum tōgædere geclypedum, þus cwæð, Gehȳrað and ongytaþ:
text_bare: And he þa, ðam menegum togædere geclypedum, þus cwæð, Gehyrað and ongytaþ:

text: ne besmīt þone mann þæt on hys mūþ gǣþ; ac hyne besmīt þæt of hys mūþe gǣþ.
text_bare: ne besmit þone mann þæt on hys muþ gæþ; ac hyne besmit þæt of hys muþe gæþ.

text: Þā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and cwǣdon, Wāst þū þæt þā Fariseiscean synt gedrēfede, þisum worde gehȳredum?
text_bare: Þa genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas, and cwædon, Wast þu þæt þa Fariseiscean synt gedrefede, þisum worde gehyredum?

text: Þā andswarode hē him, Ǣlc plantung þe mīn heofenlīca Fæder ne plantode byþ āwyrtwalod.
text_bare: Þa andswarode he him, Ælc plantung þe min heofenlica Fæder ne plantode byþ awyrtwalod.

text: Lǣtað hī; hig synt blinde and blindra lāttēowas.
text_bare: Lætað hi; hig synt blinde and blindra latteowas.

text: Sē blinda gyf hē blindne lǣt, hig feallað bēgen on ǣnne pytt.
text_bare: Se blinda gyf he blindne læt, hig feallað begen on ænne pytt.

text: Ðā andswarode him Petrus, Ārece ūs þis bigspell.
text_bare: Ða andswarode him Petrus, Arece us þis bigspell.

text: Ðā andswarode hē him, And synt gē gȳt būtan andgyte?
text_bare: Ða andswarode he him, And synt ge gyt butan andgyte?

text: Ne ongyte gē þæt eall þæt on þone mūþ gǣþ gǣþ on þā wambe, and byþ on forþgang āsend?
text_bare: Ne ongyte ge þæt eall þæt on þone muþ gæþ gæþ on þa wambe, and byþ on forþgang asend?

text: Sōþlīce þā þing þe of þām mūðe gāþ cumað of þǣre heortan, and þā smītaþ þone mann.
text_bare: Soþlice þa þing þe of þam muðe gaþ cumað of þære heortan, and þa smitaþ þone mann.

text: Of þǣre heortan cumaþ yfle geþancas, mannslyhtas, unrihthǣmedu, forligru, stale, lēase gewitnyssa, tāllīce word:
text_bare: Of þære heortan cumaþ yfle geþancas, mannslyhtas, unrihthæmedu, forligru, stale, lease gewitnyssa, tallice word:

text: þis synt þā ðing þe þone mann besmītað; ne besmīt þone mann, þēah hē unþwogenum handum ete.
text_bare: þis synt þa ðing þe þone mann besmitað; ne besmit þone mann, þeah he unþwogenum handum ete.

text: And þā fērde sē Hǣlend þanon on Tyrisce and Sydonisce endas.
text_bare: And þa ferde se Hælend þanon on Tyrisce and Sydonisce endas.

text: And efne þā of þām Chananeiscum gemǣrum clypode sum wīf and cwæð, Drihten, Dauides sunu, gemiltsa mē; mīn dohtor ys yfle mid dēofle gedreht.
text_bare: And efne þa of þam Chananeiscum gemærum clypode sum wif and cwæð, Drihten, Dauides sunu, gemiltsa me; min dohtor ys yfle mid deofle gedreht.

text: Þā ne geandswarode hē hyre.
text_bare: Þa ne geandswarode he hyre.

text: Þā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him tō cwǣdon, Forlǣt hig; for þām hēo clypað æfter ūs.
text_bare: Þa genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him to cwædon, Forlæt hig; for þam heo clypað æfter us.

text: Ðā andswarode hē, Ne eom ic āsend, būton tō þām scēapum þe forwurdon of Israhela hūse.
text_bare: Ða andswarode he, Ne eom ic asend, buton to þam sceapum þe forwurdon of Israhela huse.

text: Ðā cōm hēo, and hig tō him gebæd and þus cwæð, Drihten, gefylst mē.
text_bare: Ða com heo, and hig to him gebæd and þus cwæð, Drihten, gefylst me.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Nys hit nā gōd þæt man nime bearna hlāf and hundum wurpe.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Nys hit na god þæt man nime bearna hlaf and hundum wurpe.

text: Þā cwæþ hēo, Drihten, þæt ys sōð; witodlīce þā hwelpas etað of þām crumum þe of hyra hlāforda bēodum feallaþ.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ heo, Drihten, þæt ys soð; witodlice þa hwelpas etað of þam crumum þe of hyra hlaforda beodum feallaþ.

text: Þā andswarode Drihten hyre, Ēalā þū wīf, mycel ys þīn gelēafa; gewurþe þē eal swā þū wylle.
text_bare: Þa andswarode Drihten hyre, Eala þu wif, mycel ys þin geleafa; gewurþe þe eal swa þu wylle.

text: And þā of þǣre tīde wæs hyre dohtor hāl geworden.
text_bare: And þa of þære tide wæs hyre dohtor hal geworden.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend þanon fērde, eft hē cōm wiþ ðā Galileiscean sǣ; and āstāh on þone munt, and þǣr sæt.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þanon ferde, eft he com wiþ ða Galileiscean sæ; and astah on þone munt, and þær sæt.

text: Þā genēalǣhton him tō mycele menegu, mid him hæbbende manega healte, and blinde, and wanhāle, and manega ōþre, and ālēdon tō hys fōtum; and hē gehǣlde þā:
text_bare: Þa genealæhton him to mycele menegu, mid him hæbbende manega healte, and blinde, and wanhale, and manega oþre, and aledon to hys fotum; and he gehælde þa:

text: swā þæt þā mænegu wundredon, gesēonde dumbe specende, healte gangende, blinde gesēonde; and hig mǣrsodon Israhela God.
text_bare: swa þæt þa mænegu wundredon, geseonde dumbe specende, healte gangende, blinde geseonde; and hig mærsodon Israhela God.

text: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, tōgædere geclypedum his leorningcnihtum, Ðisse menegu ic gemiltsige, for þām hig þrȳ dagas mid mē wunodon, and hig nabbað hwæt hig eton; and ic hig nelle fæstende forlǣtan, þē lǣs hig on wege getēorian.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ se Hælend, togædere geclypedum his leorningcnihtum, Ðisse menegu ic gemiltsige, for þam hig þry dagas mid me wunodon, and hig nabbað hwæt hig eton; and ic hig nelle fæstende forlætan, þe læs hig on wege geteorian.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hys leorningcnihtas, Hwār nime wē swa fela hlāfa on þīs wēstene, þæt wē gefyllan swā mycele mænegu?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hys leorningcnihtas, Hwar nime we swa fela hlafa on þis westene, þæt we gefyllan swa mycele mænegu?

text: Þā cwæð hē, Hū fela hlāfa hæbbe gē?
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Hu fela hlafa hæbbe ge?

text: Þā cwǣdon hig, Seofon, and fēawa fixa.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hig, Seofon, and feawa fixa.

text: And hē bebēad þā þæt sēo menegu sǣte ofer þǣre eorþan;
text_bare: And he bebead þa þæt seo menegu sæte ofer þære eorþan;

text: and hē nam þā þā seofon hlāfas and þā fixas, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and hig sealdon þām folce.
text_bare: and he nam þa þa seofon hlafas and þa fixas, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and hig sealdon þam folce.

text: And hig ǣton ealle and wǣron gefyllede; and þæt tō lāfe wæs of þām gebrote hig nāmon, seofon wilian fulle.
text_bare: And hig æton ealle and wæron gefyllede; and þæt to lafe wæs of þam gebrote hig namon, seofon wilian fulle.

text: Witodlīce þā þe þǣr ǣton wǣron fēower þūsend manna, būtan cildum and wīfum.
text_bare: Witodlice þa þe þær æton wæron feower þusend manna, butan cildum and wifum.

text: And hē forlēt þā þā menegu, and ēode on scyp, and cōm on þā endas Magedan.
text_bare: And he forlet þa þa menegu, and eode on scyp, and com on þa endas Magedan.

text: And þā genēalǣhton him tō Farisei and Saducei, and hyne costodon and bǣdon þæt hē him sum tācen of heofone ætȳwde.
text_bare: And þa genealæhton him to Farisei and Saducei, and hyne costodon and bædon þæt he him sum tacen of heofone ætywde.

text: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, On ǣfen gē cweðaþ, Tō morgen hyt byþ smylte weder; þēs heofon ys rēad.
text_bare: Þa andswarode he him and cwæð, On æfen ge cweðaþ, To morgen hyt byþ smylte weder; þes heofon ys read.

text: And on morgen gē cweþað, Tō dæg hyt byþ hrēoh weder; þēos lyft scīnð unwederlīce.
text_bare: And on morgen ge cweþað, To dæg hyt byþ hreoh weder; þeos lyft scinð unwederlice.

text: Nū cunne gē tōcnāwan heofones hīw; witodlīce gē ne magon witan þǣra tīda tācnu.
text_bare: Nu cunne ge tocnawan heofones hiw; witodlice ge ne magon witan þæra tida tacnu.

text: Sēo yfele cnēoryss and unrihthǣmende tācen sēcþ; and hyre ne byð geseald būton Ionas tācen þæs wītegan.
text_bare: Seo yfele cneoryss and unrihthæmende tacen secþ; and hyre ne byð geseald buton Ionas tacen þæs witegan.

text: And him forlǣtenum, hē fērde.
text_bare: And him forlætenum, he ferde.

text: And þā his leorningcnihtas cōmon ofer þone mūþan, hig forgēton þæt hig hlāfas nāmon.
text_bare: And þa his leorningcnihtas comon ofer þone muþan, hig forgeton þæt hig hlafas namon.

text: And þā sǣde hē, Gȳmað and warniað fram beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum.
text_bare: And þa sæde he, Gymað and warniað fram beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum.

text: Þā ðōhton hig betwux him and cwǣdon, Ne nāmon wē hlāfas mid ūs.
text_bare: Þa ðohton hig betwux him and cwædon, Ne namon we hlafas mid us.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend wiste hyra geþancas, hē cwæþ tō him, Hwæt þence gē betwux ēow, lȳtles gelēafan, þæt gē hlāfas nabbað?
text_bare: Þa se Hælend wiste hyra geþancas, he cwæþ to him, Hwæt þence ge betwux eow, lytles geleafan, þæt ge hlafas nabbað?

text: Ne understande gē gȳt, nē gē ne geþenceað þǣra fīf hlāfa and fīf þūsend manna, and hū fela wyligena gē nāmon?
text_bare: Ne understande ge gyt, ne ge ne geþenceað þæra fif hlafa and fif þusend manna, and hu fela wyligena ge namon?

text: Nē þǣra seofon hlāfa and fēower þūsend manna, and hū fela wyligena gē nāman?
text_bare: Ne þæra seofon hlafa and feower þusend manna, and hu fela wyligena ge naman?

text: Hwī ne ongyte gē gȳt þæt ic ne sǣde be hlāfe, Warniað fram ðām beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum?
text_bare: Hwi ne ongyte ge gyt þæt ic ne sæde be hlafe, Warniað fram ðam beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum?

text: Þā ongēton hig þæt hē ne sǣde, Warniað fram hlāfa beorman, ac fram lāre Fariseorum and Saduceorum.
text_bare: Þa ongeton hig þæt he ne sæde, Warniað fram hlafa beorman, ac fram lare Fariseorum and Saduceorum.

text: Witodlīce þā cōm sē Hǣlend on þā dǣles Cesareæ Philippi, and āhsode hys leorningcnihtas, Hwæne secgeað menn þæt sȳ mannes Sunu?
text_bare: Witodlice þa com se Hælend on þa dæles Cesareæ Philippi, and ahsode hys leorningcnihtas, Hwæne secgeað menn þæt sy mannes Sunu?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Sume, Iohannem þone fulluhtere; sume, Heliam; sume, Hieremiam, oðþe ān þǣra wītegyna.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Sume, Iohannem þone fulluhtere; sume, Heliam; sume, Hieremiam, oðþe an þæra witegyna.

text: Ðā sǣde hē, Hwæt secge gē þæt ic sī?
text_bare: Ða sæde he, Hwæt secge ge þæt ic si?

text: Ðā andswarode him Petrus, Ðū eart þæs lyfigendes Godes Sunu.
text_bare: Ða andswarode him Petrus, Ðu eart þæs lyfigendes Godes Sunu.

text: Þā andswarode him sē Hǣlend, Ēadig eart þū, Simon, culfran bearn; for þām hit þē ne onwrēah flǣsc nē blōd, ac mīn Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
text_bare: Þa andswarode him se Hælend, Eadig eart þu, Simon, culfran bearn; for þam hit þe ne onwreah flæsc ne blod, ac min Fæder þe on heofenum ys.

text: And ic secge þē þæt þū eart Petrus, and ofer þisne stān ic timbrige mīne cyricean; and helle gatu ne magon ongēn þā.
text_bare: And ic secge þe þæt þu eart Petrus, and ofer þisne stan ic timbrige mine cyricean; and helle gatu ne magon ongen þa.

text: And þē ic sylle heofona rīces cǣgia: and swā hwæt swā þū ofer eorþan gebindst, þæt byþ on heofonum gebunden; and swā hwæt swā þū unbindst ofer eorþan, þæt byð unbunden on heofonum.
text_bare: And þe ic sylle heofona rices cægia: and swa hwæt swa þu ofer eorþan gebindst, þæt byþ on heofonum gebunden; and swa hwæt swa þu unbindst ofer eorþan, þæt byð unbunden on heofonum.

text: Þā bebēad sē Hǣlend hys leorningcnihtum þæt hig nānum menn ne sǣdon þæt hē wǣre Hǣlend Crīst.
text_bare: Þa bebead se Hælend hys leorningcnihtum þæt hig nanum menn ne sædon þæt he wære Hælend Crist.

text: Syððan hē ongan swutelian hys leorningcnihtum þæt hē wolde faran tō Hierusalem, and fela þinga þolian fram yldrum, and bōcerum, and ealdormannum þǣra sācerda, and bēon ofslegen, and þȳ þryddan dæge ārīsan.
text_bare: Syððan he ongan swutelian hys leorningcnihtum þæt he wolde faran to Hierusalem, and fela þinga þolian fram yldrum, and bocerum, and ealdormannum þæra sacerda, and beon ofslegen, and þy þryddan dæge arisan.

text: And þā genam Petrus hyne onsundron, and cwæð tō him, Drihten, ne gewurþe þæt.
text_bare: And þa genam Petrus hyne onsundron, and cwæð to him, Drihten, ne gewurþe þæt.

text: Þā beseah hē hyne, and cwæð tō Petre, Gang bæftan mē, Satanas; wiþerrǣde þū eart mē, for þām þū nāst þā þing þe synd Godes, ac þā þe synt manna.
text_bare: Þa beseah he hyne, and cwæð to Petre, Gang bæftan me, Satanas; wiþerræde þu eart me, for þam þu nast þa þing þe synd Godes, ac þa þe synt manna.

text: Þā sǣde sē Hǣlend hys leorningcnihtum, Gyf hwā wylle fyligean mē, wiþsace hyne sylfne, and nyme hys rōde, and mē fylige.
text_bare: Þa sæde se Hælend hys leorningcnihtum, Gyf hwa wylle fyligean me, wiþsace hyne sylfne, and nyme hys rode, and me fylige.

text: Sōþlīce sē þe wyle hys sāwle hāle gedōn, hē hig forspilþ; and sē þe wyle hig for mē forspyllan sē hig fint.
text_bare: Soþlice se þe wyle hys sawle hale gedon, he hig forspilþ; and se þe wyle hig for me forspyllan se hig fint.

text: Hwæt fremað ǣnegum menn, þēah hē ealne middaneard gestrȳne, gyf hē hys sāwle forwyrd þolað?
text_bare: Hwæt fremað ænegum menn, þeah he ealne middaneard gestryne, gyf he hys sawle forwyrd þolað?

text: Oððe hwylc gewrixl sylþ sē mann for hys sāwle?
text_bare: Oððe hwylc gewrixl sylþ se mann for hys sawle?

text: Witodlīce mannes Sunu ys tō cumenne on hys Fæder wuldre mid hys englum; and þonne āgylt ǣghwylcum be hys āgenum weorce.
text_bare: Witodlice mannes Sunu ys to cumenne on hys Fæder wuldre mid hys englum; and þonne agylt æghwylcum be hys agenum weorce.

text: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Sume synt hēr dende þe dēaþ ne onbyrigeað, ǣr hig gesēon mannes Sunu cumende on hys Fæder rīce.
text_bare: Soðlice ic secge eow, Sume synt her dende þe deaþ ne onbyrigeað, ær hig geseon mannes Sunu cumende on hys Fæder rice.

text: And æfter six dagum nam sē Hǣlend Petrum, and Iacobum, and Iohannem hys brōþor, and lǣdde hig onsundron on ǣnne hēahne munt.
text_bare: And æfter six dagum nam se Hælend Petrum, and Iacobum, and Iohannem hys broþor, and lædde hig onsundron on ænne heahne munt.

text: And hē wæs gehīwod beforan him; and his ansȳn scēan swā swā sunne, and hys rēaf wǣron swā hwīte swā snāw.
text_bare: And he wæs gehiwod beforan him; and his ansyn scean swa swa sunne, and hys reaf wæron swa hwite swa snaw.

text: And efne þā ætȳwde Moyses and Helias mid him sprecende.
text_bare: And efne þa ætywde Moyses and Helias mid him sprecende.

text: Þā cwæð Petrus tō him, Drihten, gōd ys ūs hēr tō bēonne; gyf þū wylt, uton wyrcean hēr þrēo eardungstōwa, þē āne, Moyse āne, and Helie āne.
text_bare: Þa cwæð Petrus to him, Drihten, god ys us her to beonne; gyf þu wylt, uton wyrcean her þreo eardungstowa, þe ane, Moyse ane, and Helie ane.

text: Him þā gȳt sprecendum, and sōþlīce þā beorht wolcn hig oferscēan; and þā efne cōm stefn of þām wolcne and cwæþ, Hēr ys mīn lēofa Sunu on þām mē wel gelīcaþ; gehȳrað hyne.
text_bare: Him þa gyt sprecendum, and soþlice þa beorht wolcn hig oferscean; and þa efne com stefn of þam wolcne and cwæþ, Her ys min leofa Sunu on þam me wel gelicaþ; gehyrað hyne.

text: And þā hig þis gehȳrdon hys leorningcnihtas, hig fēollon on hyra ansȳne, and hym swȳþe ādrēdon.
text_bare: And þa hig þis gehyrdon hys leorningcnihtas, hig feollon on hyra ansyne, and hym swyþe adredon.

text: Hē genēalǣhte þā and hig æthrān, and him tō cwæþ, Ārīsað, and ne ondrǣdaþ ēow.
text_bare: He genealæhte þa and hig æthran, and him to cwæþ, Arisað, and ne ondrædaþ eow.

text: Ðā hig hyra ēagan ūpp hōfon, ne gesāwon hig nǣnne būton þone Hǣlend sylfne.
text_bare: Ða hig hyra eagan upp hofon, ne gesawon hig nænne buton þone Hælend sylfne.

text: And þā hig of ðām munte ēodon, sē Hǣlend hym bebēad and þus cwæþ, Nānum menn ne secgean gē þis, ǣr mannes Sunu of dēaþe ārīse.
text_bare: And þa hig of ðam munte eodon, se Hælend hym bebead and þus cwæþ, Nanum menn ne secgean ge þis, ær mannes Sunu of deaþe arise.

text: And þā āxodon hys leorningcnihtas hyne, Hwæt secgeað þā bōceras þæt gebyrige ǣrest cuman Heliam?
text_bare: And þa axodon hys leorningcnihtas hyne, Hwæt secgeað þa boceras þæt gebyrige ærest cuman Heliam?

text: Ðā andswarode hē hym, Witodlīce Helias ys tōweard, and hē geednīwað ealle þing.
text_bare: Ða andswarode he hym, Witodlice Helias ys toweard, and he geedniwað ealle þing.

text: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge þæt Helias cōm, and hig hyne ne gecnēowon; ac hig dydon ymbe hyne swā hwæt swā hig woldon.
text_bare: Soþlice ic eow secge þæt Helias com, and hig hyne ne gecneowon; ac hig dydon ymbe hyne swa hwæt swa hig woldon.

text: And swā ys mannes Sunu ēac fram him tō þrowigenne.
text_bare: And swa ys mannes Sunu eac fram him to þrowigenne.

text: Ðā ongēton hys leorningcnihtas þæt hē hyt sǣde be Iohanne þām fulluhtere.
text_bare: Ða ongeton hys leorningcnihtas þæt he hyt sæde be Iohanne þam fulluhtere.

text: And þā hē cōm tō þǣre menegu, him tō genēalǣhte sum mann, gebīgedum cnēowum tōforan him, and cwæþ,
text_bare: And þa he com to þære menegu, him to genealæhte sum mann, gebigedum cneowum toforan him, and cwæþ,

text: Drihten, gemiltsa mīnum suna, for þām þe hē ys fyllesēoc, and yfel þolað; oft hē fylþ on fȳr, and gelōmlīce on wæter.
text_bare: Drihten, gemiltsa minum suna, for þam þe he ys fylleseoc, and yfel þolað; oft he fylþ on fyr, and gelomlice on wæter.

text: And ic brōhte hyne tō þīnum leorningcnihtum, and hig ne mihton hyne gehǣlan.
text_bare: And ic brohte hyne to þinum leorningcnihtum, and hig ne mihton hyne gehælan.

text: Ðā andswarode hē him, Ēalā gē ungelēaffulle and þwȳre cnēores, hū lange bēo ic mid ēow?
text_bare: Ða andswarode he him, Eala ge ungeleaffulle and þwyre cneores, hu lange beo ic mid eow?

text: hū lange forbere ic eow?
text_bare: hu lange forbere ic eow?

text: bringað hyne tō mē hider.
text_bare: bringað hyne to me hider.

text: And þā þrēade sē Hǣlend hyne, and sē dēofol hyne forlēt; and sē cnapa wæs of þǣre tīde gehǣled.
text_bare: And þa þreade se Hælend hyne, and se deofol hyne forlet; and se cnapa wæs of þære tide gehæled.

text: Ðā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas him tō, and him tō cwǣdon dīglīce, Hwī ne mihte wē hyne ūt ādrīfan?
text_bare: Ða genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas him to, and him to cwædon diglice, Hwi ne mihte we hyne ut adrifan?

text: Þā cwæð hē for hyra ungelēafulnesse, Sōþlīce on eornost ic ēow secge, Gyf gē hæfdon gelēafan swā senepes corn, and gē cwǣdon tō þissum munte, Far heonone, þonne fērde hē; and ēow ne byð ǣnig þing unmihtelīc.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he for hyra ungeleafulnesse, Soþlice on eornost ic eow secge, Gyf ge hæfdon geleafan swa senepes corn, and ge cwædon to þissum munte, Far heonone, þonne ferde he; and eow ne byð ænig þing unmihtelic.

text: Sōþlīce þis cynn ne byþ ūt ādryfen, būton þurh gebed and fæsten.
text_bare: Soþlice þis cynn ne byþ ut adryfen, buton þurh gebed and fæsten.

text: Ðā hig wunedon on Galilea, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Mannes Sunu ys tō syllenne on manna handa;
text_bare: Ða hig wunedon on Galilea, þa cwæð se Hælend, Mannes Sunu ys to syllenne on manna handa;

text: and hig ofslēað hyne, and hē ārīst on þām þriddan dæge.
text_bare: and hig ofsleað hyne, and he arist on þam þriddan dæge.

text: Ðā wurdon hig þearle geunrōtsode.
text_bare: Ða wurdon hig þearle geunrotsode.

text: And þā hē cōm tō Cafarnaum, þā genēalǣhton tō Petre þā þe gafol nāmon, and þus cwǣdon, Ēower lārēow ne gylt hē gafol?
text_bare: And þa he com to Cafarnaum, þa genealæhton to Petre þa þe gafol namon, and þus cwædon, Eower lareow ne gylt he gafol?

text: Þā cwæð hē, Gyse, hē dēð.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Gyse, he deð.

text: And þā hē cōm intō þām hūse, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Hwæt þincð þē, Symon?
text_bare: And þa he com into þam huse, þa cwæð se Hælend, Hwæt þincð þe, Symon?

text: æt hwām nimað cyningas gafol oððe toll?
text_bare: æt hwam nimað cyningas gafol oððe toll?

text: of hyra bearnum, hwæðer ðe of fremedum?
text_bare: of hyra bearnum, hwæðer ðe of fremedum?

text: Ðā cwæþ hē, Of fremedum.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he, Of fremedum.

text: Þā cwæð hē, Eornostlīce þā bearn synt frīge.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Eornostlice þa bearn synt frige.

text: Þēah hwæþere þæt wē hī ne geunrōtsigeon, gang tō þǣre sǣ, and wurp þīnne angel ūt, and nim þone ǣrestan fisc, and hys mūþ geopena; þū fintst ǣnne wecg on him; nim þone, and syle for mē and for þē.
text_bare: Þeah hwæþere þæt we hi ne geunrotsigeon, gang to þære sæ, and wurp þinne angel ut, and nim þone ærestan fisc, and hys muþ geopena; þu fintst ænne wecg on him; nim þone, and syle for me and for þe.

text: On þǣre tīde genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas tō þām Hǣlende, and cwǣdon, Hwa wēnst þū ys yldra on heofena rīce?
text_bare: On þære tide genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas to þam Hælende, and cwædon, Hwa wenst þu ys yldra on heofena rice?

text: And ðā clypode sē Hǣlend ǣnne lȳtling, and gesette on hyra midlen,
text_bare: And ða clypode se Hælend ænne lytling, and gesette on hyra midlen,

text: and cwæþ, Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Būton gē bēon gecyrrede, and gewordene swā swā lȳtlingas, ne gā gē on heofena rīce.
text_bare: and cwæþ, Soðlice ic secge eow, Buton ge beon gecyrrede, and gewordene swa swa lytlingas, ne ga ge on heofena rice.

text: Swā hwylc swā hyne geēaþmēt swā þēs lȳtling, sē ys māra on heofena rīce.
text_bare: Swa hwylc swa hyne geeaþmet swa þes lytling, se ys mara on heofena rice.

text: And swā hwylc swā ānne þilīcne lȳtling on mīnum naman onfēhþ, sē onfēhþ mē.
text_bare: And swa hwylc swa anne þilicne lytling on minum naman onfehþ, se onfehþ me.

text: Sōþlīce sē þe beswīcð ǣnne of ðyssum lȳtlingum þe on mē gelȳfað, betere him ys þæt ān cwyrnstān sī tō hys swȳran gecnytt, and sī besenced on sǣs grund.
text_bare: Soþlice se þe beswicð ænne of ðyssum lytlingum þe on me gelyfað, betere him ys þæt an cwyrnstan si to hys swyran gecnytt, and si besenced on sæs grund.

text: Wā þysum middangearde þurh swicdōmas!
text_bare: Wa þysum middangearde þurh swicdomas!

text: Nēod ys þæt swycdōmas cumon; þēah hwæðere wā þām menn þe swycdōm þurh hyne cymð!
text_bare: Neod ys þæt swycdomas cumon; þeah hwæðere wa þam menn þe swycdom þurh hyne cymð!

text: Gyf þīn hand oððe þīn fōt þē swicað, āceorf hyne of, and āwurp fram þē; betere þē ys þæt þū gā wanhāl oþþe healt tō līfe, þonne þū hæbbe twā handa and twēgen fēt and sȳ on ēce fȳr āsend.
text_bare: Gyf þin hand oððe þin fot þe swicað, aceorf hyne of, and awurp fram þe; betere þe ys þæt þu ga wanhal oþþe healt to life, þonne þu hæbbe twa handa and twegen fet and sy on ece fyr asend.

text: And gyf þīn ēage þē swicað, āhola hyt ūt, and āwurp hyt fram þē; betere þē ys mid ānum ēagan on līfe tō gānne, þonne þū sī mid twām āsend on helle fȳr.
text_bare: And gyf þin eage þe swicað, ahola hyt ut, and awurp hyt fram þe; betere þe ys mid anum eagan on life to ganne, þonne þu si mid twam asend on helle fyr.

text: Warniað þæt gē ne oferhogian ǣnne of þysum lȳtlingum þe gelȳfað on mē.
text_bare: Warniað þæt ge ne oferhogian ænne of þysum lytlingum þe gelyfað on me.

text: Sōðlīce mannes Sunu cōm tō gehǣlenne þæt forwearð.
text_bare: Soðlice mannes Sunu com to gehælenne þæt forwearð.

text: Hwæt ys ēow geþūht?
text_bare: Hwæt ys eow geþuht?

text: gyf hwylc mann hæfð hund scēapa, and him losað ān of þām, hū ne forlǣt hē þā nigon and hundnigontig on þām muntum, and gǣð and sēcþ þæt ān þe forwearð?
text_bare: gyf hwylc mann hæfð hund sceapa, and him losað an of þam, hu ne forlæt he þa nigon and hundnigontig on þam muntum, and gæð and secþ þæt an þe forwearð?

text: And gyf hyt gelimpþ þæt hē hyt fint, sōðlīce ic ēow secge þæt hē swȳdor geblissaþ for þām ānum, þonne ofer þā nigon and hundnigontig þe nā ne losedon.
text_bare: And gyf hyt gelimpþ þæt he hyt fint, soðlice ic eow secge þæt he swydor geblissaþ for þam anum, þonne ofer þa nigon and hundnigontig þe na ne losedon.

text: Swā nys willa beforan ēowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys, þæt ān forwurþe of þisum lȳtlingum.
text_bare: Swa nys willa beforan eowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys, þæt an forwurþe of þisum lytlingum.

text: Sōþlīce gyf þīn brōþor syngað wið þē, gā and stȳr him betwux þē and him sylfum; gyf hē þē gehȳrð, þū gestaþelast þīnne brōþor.
text_bare: Soþlice gyf þin broþor syngað wið þe, ga and styr him betwux þe and him sylfum; gyf he þe gehyrð, þu gestaþelast þinne broþor.

text: Gyf hē þē ne gehȳrþ, nim þonne gȳt ǣnne oððe twēgen tō þē, þæt ǣlc word stande on twēgra oððe þrēora gewittnesse.
text_bare: Gyf he þe ne gehyrþ, nim þonne gyt ænne oððe twegen to þe, þæt ælc word stande on twegra oððe þreora gewittnesse.

text: Gyf hē hig ne gehȳrþ, sege hyt gefērrǣddene; gyf hē hig ne gehȳrð, sī hē þē swā swā hǣþen and mānfull.
text_bare: Gyf he hig ne gehyrþ, sege hyt geferræddene; gyf he hig ne gehyrð, si he þe swa swa hæþen and manfull.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Swā hwylce swā gē gebindað ofer eorþan, þā bēoþ gebundene on heofonum; and swā hwylce swā gē ofer eorþan unbindaþ, þā bēoþ on heofonum unbundene.
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow, Swa hwylce swa ge gebindað ofer eorþan, þa beoþ gebundene on heofonum; and swa hwylce swa ge ofer eorþan unbindaþ, þa beoþ on heofonum unbundene.

text: Eft ic ēow secge, Gyf twēgen of ēow geþwǣriað ofer eorþan be ǣlcum þinge þe hig biddað, hit gewurð him of mīnum Fæder þe on heofonum ys.
text_bare: Eft ic eow secge, Gyf twegen of eow geþwæriað ofer eorþan be ælcum þinge þe hig biddað, hit gewurð him of minum Fæder þe on heofonum ys.

text: Ðǣr twēgen oððe þrȳ synt on mīnum naman gegaderode, þǣr ic eom on hyra midlene.
text_bare: Ðær twegen oððe þry synt on minum naman gegaderode, þær ic eom on hyra midlene.

text: Ðā genēalǣhte Petrus tō him, and cwæð, Drihten, gyf mīn brōþor syngaþ wið mē, mōt ic him forgyfan oð seofon sīþas?
text_bare: Ða genealæhte Petrus to him, and cwæð, Drihten, gyf min broþor syngaþ wið me, mot ic him forgyfan oð seofon siþas?

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Ne secge ic þē, Oð seofon sīþas; ac, Oð seofon hundseofontigon sīþon.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Ne secge ic þe, Oð seofon siþas; ac, Oð seofon hundseofontigon siþon.

text: For þām ys heofena rīce anlīc þām cyninge þe hys þēowas gerādegode.
text_bare: For þam ys heofena rice anlic þam cyninge þe hys þeowas geradegode.

text: And þā hē þæt gerād sette, him wæs ān brōht sē him sceolde tȳn þūsend punda.
text_bare: And þa he þæt gerad sette, him wæs an broht se him sceolde tyn þusend punda.

text: And þā hē næfde hwanon hē hyt āgulde, hyne hēt hys Hlāford gesyllan, and hys wīf, and hys cild, and eall þæt hē āhte.
text_bare: And þa he næfde hwanon he hyt agulde, hyne het hys Hlaford gesyllan, and hys wif, and hys cild, and eall þæt he ahte.

text: Þā āstrehte sē þēow hyne, and cwæð, Hlāford, gehafa geþyld on mē, and ic hyt þē eall āgylde.
text_bare: Þa astrehte se þeow hyne, and cwæð, Hlaford, gehafa geþyld on me, and ic hyt þe eall agylde.

text: Þā gemiltsode sē hlāford him, and forgeaf him þone gylt.
text_bare: Þa gemiltsode se hlaford him, and forgeaf him þone gylt.

text: Þā sē þēowa ūt ēode, hē gemētte hys efenþēowan sē him sceolde ān hund penega; and hē nam hyne þā and forþrysmede hyne, and cwæð, Āgyf þæt þū mē scealt.
text_bare: Þa se þeowa ut eode, he gemette hys efenþeowan se him sceolde an hund penega; and he nam hyne þa and forþrysmede hyne, and cwæð, Agyf þæt þu me scealt.

text: And þā āstrehte hys efenþēowa hyne, and bæd hyne and þus cwæð, Geþyldega, and ic hyt þē eall āgyfe.
text_bare: And þa astrehte hys efenþeowa hyne, and bæd hyne and þus cwæð, Geþyldega, and ic hyt þe eall agyfe.

text: Hē ðā nolde; ac fērde and wearp hyne on cweartern, oð ðæt hē him eall āgēfe.
text_bare: He ða nolde; ac ferde and wearp hyne on cweartern, oð ðæt he him eall agefe.

text: Ðā gesāwon hys efenþēowas þæt, ðā wurdon hig swȳðe geunrōtsode, and cōmon and sǣdon hyra hlāforde ealle þā dǣde.
text_bare: Ða gesawon hys efenþeowas þæt, ða wurdon hig swyðe geunrotsode, and comon and sædon hyra hlaforde ealle þa dæde.

text: Ðā clypode hys hlāford hyne, and cwæþ tō him, Ēalā þū lȳþra þēowa, eallne þīnne gylt ic ðē forgeaf, for þām þe ðū mē bǣde;
text_bare: Ða clypode hys hlaford hyne, and cwæþ to him, Eala þu lyþra þeowa, eallne þinne gylt ic ðe forgeaf, for þam þe ðu me bæde;

text: hū ne gebyrede þē gemiltsian þīnum efenðēowan, swā swā ic þē gemiltsode?
text_bare: hu ne gebyrede þe gemiltsian þinum efenðeowan, swa swa ic þe gemiltsode?

text: Ðā wæs sē hlāford yrre, and sealde hyne þām wītnerum, oð þæt hē eall āgulde.
text_bare: Ða wæs se hlaford yrre, and sealde hyne þam witnerum, oð þæt he eall agulde.

text: Swā dēþ mīn sē heofonlīca Fæder, gyf gē of ēowrum heortum ēowrum brōðrum ne forgyfaþ.
text_bare: Swa deþ min se heofonlica Fæder, gyf ge of eowrum heortum eowrum broðrum ne forgyfaþ.

text: And þā sē Hǣlend geendode þās sprǣca, hē fērde fram Galilea and cōm on Iudeisce endas begeondan Iordanen.
text_bare: And þa se Hælend geendode þas spræca, he ferde fram Galilea and com on Iudeisce endas begeondan Iordanen.

text: And hym fyligdon mycele mænegu, and hē hig gehǣlde þǣr.
text_bare: And hym fyligdon mycele mænegu, and he hig gehælde þær.

text: Ðā genēalǣhton him to Farisei, hyne costnigende, and cwǣdon, Is ālȳfed ǣnegum menn hys wīf tō forlǣtenne for ǣnegum þinge?
text_bare: Ða genealæhton him to Farisei, hyne costnigende, and cwædon, Is alyfed ænegum menn hys wif to forlætenne for ænegum þinge?

text: Ðā andswarode hē him, Ne rǣdde gē, Sē þe on fruman worhte, hē worhte wǣpmann and wīfmann,
text_bare: Ða andswarode he him, Ne rædde ge, Se þe on fruman worhte, he worhte wæpmann and wifmann,

text: and cwæþ, For þām sē mann forlǣtt fæder and mōdor, and hyne tō his wīfe geþēot; and bēoð twēgen on ānum flǣsce?
text_bare: and cwæþ, For þam se mann forlætt fæder and modor, and hyne to his wife geþeot; and beoð twegen on anum flæsce?

text: Witodlīce ne synt hig twēgen, ac ān flǣsc.
text_bare: Witodlice ne synt hig twegen, ac an flæsc.

text: Ne getwǣme nān mann þā ðe God gesomnode.
text_bare: Ne getwæme nan mann þa ðe God gesomnode.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Hwī hēt Moyses syllan hīwgedāles bōc, and hig forlǣton?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Hwi het Moyses syllan hiwgedales boc, and hig forlæton?

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Moyses for ēower heortan heardnesse lȳfde ēow ēower wīf tō forlǣtenne; sōðlīce næs hyt on frymðe swā.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Moyses for eower heortan heardnesse lyfde eow eower wif to forlætenne; soðlice næs hyt on frymðe swa.

text: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Swā hwā swā forlǣtt hys wīf, būton for forligere, and ōþer fetað, sē unrihthǣmð; and sē ðe forlǣtene æfter him nymð sē unrihthǣmð.
text_bare: Soþlice ic secge eow, Swa hwa swa forlætt hys wif, buton for forligere, and oþer fetað, se unrihthæmð; and se ðe forlætene æfter him nymð se unrihthæmð.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hys leorningcnihtas, Gyf hyt swā ys þām menn mid hys wīfe, ne fremað nānum menn tō wīfienne.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hys leorningcnihtas, Gyf hyt swa ys þam menn mid hys wife, ne fremað nanum menn to wifienne.

text: Ðā cwæþ hē, Ne underfōð ealle menn þis word, ac þām þe hyt geseald ys.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he, Ne underfoð ealle menn þis word, ac þam þe hyt geseald ys.

text: Sōþlīce synd belistnode þe of hyra mōdor innoþum cumað; and eft synd belistnode þā men þe man belistenað; and eft synd belistnode þe hig sylfe belistnodon for heofena rīce.
text_bare: Soþlice synd belistnode þe of hyra modor innoþum cumað; and eft synd belistnode þa men þe man belistenað; and eft synd belistnode þe hig sylfe belistnodon for heofena rice.

text: Undernyme, sē þe undernyman mæge.
text_bare: Undernyme, se þe undernyman mæge.

text: Þā wǣron him gebrōhte lȳtlingas tō þæt hē hys hand on hig āsette and hig geblētsode; þā þrēadon hys leorningcnihtas hig.
text_bare: Þa wæron him gebrohte lytlingas to þæt he hys hand on hig asette and hig gebletsode; þa þreadon hys leorningcnihtas hig.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lǣtað þā lȳtlingas, and nelle gē hig forbēodan cuman tō me; swylcra ys heofena rīce.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Lætað þa lytlingas, and nelle ge hig forbeodan cuman to me; swylcra ys heofena rice.

text: And þā hē him hys handa on āsette, þā fērde hē þanon.
text_bare: And þa he him hys handa on asette, þa ferde he þanon.

text: And þā genēalǣhte him ān mann tō, and cwæþ, Lā gōda Lārēow, hwæt gōdes dō ic þæt ic ēce līf hæbbe?
text_bare: And þa genealæhte him an mann to, and cwæþ, La goda Lareow, hwæt godes do ic þæt ic ece lif hæbbe?

text: Ðā cwæþ hē, Hwæt āxast þū mē be gōde; ān God ys gōd; sōþlīce gyf þū wylt on līf becuman, heald þā beboda.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he, Hwæt axast þu me be gode; an God ys god; soþlice gyf þu wylt on lif becuman, heald þa beboda.

text: Ðā cwæþ hē, Hwylce?
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he, Hwylce?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Ne dō þū mannslyht; Ne dō þū unrihthǣmed; Ne stel þū; Ne sege þū lēase gewittnysse;
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Ne do þu mannslyht; Ne do þu unrihthæmed; Ne stel þu; Ne sege þu lease gewittnysse;

text: Wurða þīnne fæder and mōdor; and, Lufa þīnne nēhstan swā þē sylfne.
text_bare: Wurða þinne fæder and modor; and, Lufa þinne nehstan swa þe sylfne.

text: Þā cwæð sē geonga, Eall þiss ic gehēold; hwæt ys mē gȳt wana?
text_bare: Þa cwæð se geonga, Eall þiss ic geheold; hwæt ys me gyt wana?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Gyf þū wylt bēon fullfremed, gā and becȳp eall þæt þū āhst, and syle hyt þearfum, and þonne hæfst þū goldhord on heofone; and cum and folga mē.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Gyf þu wylt beon fullfremed, ga and becyp eall þæt þu ahst, and syle hyt þearfum, and þonne hæfst þu goldhord on heofone; and cum and folga me.

text: Ðā sē geonga mann gehȳrde þis word, þā ēode hē aweg unrōt; sōþlīce hē hæfde mycele ǣhta.
text_bare: Ða se geonga mann gehyrde þis word, þa eode he aweg unrot; soþlice he hæfde mycele æhta.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hys leorningcnihtum, Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Þæt earfoðlīce sē welega gǣð on Godes rīce.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend cwæð to hys leorningcnihtum, Soþlice ic eow secge, Þæt earfoðlice se welega gæð on Godes rice.

text: And eft ic ēow secge, Þæt eaðelīcre byð þām olfende tō gānne þurh nǣdle ēage, þonne sē welega on heofona rīce gā.
text_bare: And eft ic eow secge, Þæt eaðelicre byð þam olfende to ganne þurh nædle eage, þonne se welega on heofona rice ga.

text: Ðā hys leorningcnihtas þis gehȳrdon, hig wundrodun and cwǣdon, Hwā mæg þis gehealdan?
text_bare: Ða hys leorningcnihtas þis gehyrdon, hig wundrodun and cwædon, Hwa mæg þis gehealdan?

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Unēaþelīc þæt ys mid mannum; ac ealle þing synt mid Gode ēaþelīce.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Uneaþelic þæt ys mid mannum; ac ealle þing synt mid Gode eaþelice.

text: Ðā andswarode Petrus and cwæð, Nū wē forlēton ealle þing, and folgodon þē; hwæt byð ūs tō mēde?
text_bare: Ða andswarode Petrus and cwæð, Nu we forleton ealle þing, and folgodon þe; hwæt byð us to mede?

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Sōþ ic ēow secge þæt gē þe mē folgodon, on edcenninge þonne mannes Sunu sitt on hys mægenþrymme, þæt gē sittað ofer twelf setl, dēmende twelf mǣgða Israhel.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Soþ ic eow secge þæt ge þe me folgodon, on edcenninge þonne mannes Sunu sitt on hys mægenþrymme, þæt ge sittað ofer twelf setl, demende twelf mægða Israhel.

text: And ǣlc þe forlǣt for mīnum naman hys hūs, oððe hys gebrōþru, oððe swustra, oþþe fæder, oþþe mōdor, oððe wīf, oþþe bearn, oððe land, be hundfealdon hē onfēhþ lēan, and hæfð ēce līf.
text_bare: And ælc þe forlæt for minum naman hys hus, oððe hys gebroþru, oððe swustra, oþþe fæder, oþþe modor, oððe wif, oþþe bearn, oððe land, be hundfealdon he onfehþ lean, and hæfð ece lif.

text: Sōþlīce manega fyrmeste bēoð ȳtemeste, and ȳtemeste fyrmeste.
text_bare: Soþlice manega fyrmeste beoð ytemeste, and ytemeste fyrmeste.

text: Sōþlīce heofona rīce ys gelīc þām hīredes ealdre þe on ǣrne mergen ūt ēode āhȳrian wyrhtan on hys wīngeard.
text_bare: Soþlice heofona rice ys gelic þam hiredes ealdre þe on ærne mergen ut eode ahyrian wyrhtan on hys wingeard.

text: Gewordenre gecwydrǣdene þām wyrhtum þæt hē sealde ǣlcon ǣnne penig wiþ hys dæges worce, hē āsende hig on hys wīngeard.
text_bare: Gewordenre gecwydrædene þam wyrhtum þæt he sealde ælcon ænne penig wiþ hys dæges worce, he asende hig on hys wingeard.

text: And þā hē ūt ēode embe underntīde, hē geseah ōþre on strǣte īdele standan.
text_bare: And þa he ut eode embe underntide, he geseah oþre on stræte idele standan.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, gā gē on mīnne wīngeard, and ic sylle ēow þæt riht byþ; and hig þā fērdon.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, ga ge on minne wingeard, and ic sylle eow þæt riht byþ; and hig þa ferdon.

text: Eft hē ūt ēode embe þā sixtan and þā nigoþan tīde, and dyde þām swā gelīce.
text_bare: Eft he ut eode embe þa sixtan and þa nigoþan tide, and dyde þam swa gelice.

text: Þā embe þā endlyftan tīde hē ūt ēode, and funde ōþre standende; and þā sǣde hē, Hwī stande gē hēr eallne dæg īdele?
text_bare: Þa embe þa endlyftan tide he ut eode, and funde oþre standende; and þa sæde he, Hwi stande ge her eallne dæg idele?

text: Þā cwǣdon hig, For þām þe ūs nān mann ne hȳrode.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hig, For þam þe us nan mann ne hyrode.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, And gā gē on mīnne wīngeard.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, And ga ge on minne wingeard.

text: Sōþlīce þā hyt wæs æfen geworden, þā sǣde sē wīngeardes hlāford hys gerēfan, Clypa þā wyrhtan, and āgyf him heora mēde; āgynn fram þām ȳtemestan oþ þone fyrmestan.
text_bare: Soþlice þa hyt wæs æfen geworden, þa sæde se wingeardes hlaford hys gerefan, Clypa þa wyrhtan, and agyf him heora mede; agynn fram þam ytemestan oþ þone fyrmestan.

text: Eornostlīce þā ðā gecōmon þe embe þā endlyftan tīde cōmon, þā onfēngon hig ǣlc his pening.
text_bare: Eornostlice þa ða gecomon þe embe þa endlyftan tide comon, þa onfengon hig ælc his pening.

text: And þā þe þǣr ǣrest cōmon wēndon þæt hig sceoldon māre onfōn; þā onfēngon hig syndrige penegas.
text_bare: And þa þe þær ærest comon wendon þæt hig sceoldon mare onfon; þa onfengon hig syndrige penegas.

text: Ðā ongunnon hig murcnian ongēn þone hīredes ealdor,
text_bare: Ða ongunnon hig murcnian ongen þone hiredes ealdor,

text: and þus cwǣdon, Þās ȳtemestan worhton āne tīde, and þū dydest hig gelīce ūs þe bǣron byrþena on þises dæges hǣtan.
text_bare: and þus cwædon, Þas ytemestan worhton ane tide, and þu dydest hig gelice us þe bæron byrþena on þises dæges hætan.

text: Ðā cwæð hē andswarigende hyra ānum, Ēalā þū frēond, ne dō ic þē nǣnne tēonan; hū ne cōme þū tō mē tō wyrceanne wið ānum penige?
text_bare: Ða cwæð he andswarigende hyra anum, Eala þu freond, ne do ic þe nænne teonan; hu ne come þu to me to wyrceanne wið anum penige?

text: Nim þæt þīn ys, and gā; ic wylle þysum ȳtemestan syllan eal swā mycel swā þē.
text_bare: Nim þæt þin ys, and ga; ic wylle þysum ytemestan syllan eal swa mycel swa þe.

text: Oþþe ne mōt ic dōn þæt ic wylle?
text_bare: Oþþe ne mot ic don þæt ic wylle?

text: hwæþer þe þīn ēage mānful ys, for þām þe ic gōd eom?
text_bare: hwæþer þe þin eage manful ys, for þam þe ic god eom?

text: Swā bēoð þā fyrmestan ȳtemeste, and þā ȳtemestan fyrmeste; sōþlīce manega synt geclypede, and fēawa gecorene.
text_bare: Swa beoð þa fyrmestan ytemeste, and þa ytemestan fyrmeste; soþlice manega synt geclypede, and feawa gecorene.

text: Ðā fērde sē Hǣlend tō Hierusalem, and nam hys leorningcnihtas onsundron, and þus cwæð,
text_bare: Ða ferde se Hælend to Hierusalem, and nam hys leorningcnihtas onsundron, and þus cwæð,

text: Nū wē farað tō Hierusalem; and mannes Sunu byþ geseald þǣra sācerda ealdrum and bōcerum, and hig genyþeriað hyne tō dēaþe,
text_bare: Nu we farað to Hierusalem; and mannes Sunu byþ geseald þæra sacerda ealdrum and bocerum, and hig genyþeriað hyne to deaþe,

text: þēodum tō bysmrigenne, and tō swingenne, and to āhōnne; and þām þryddan dæge hē ārīst.
text_bare: þeodum to bysmrigenne, and to swingenne, and to ahonne; and þam þryddan dæge he arist.

text: Ðā cōm tō him Zebedeis bearna mōdor mid hyre bearnum, hig geēadmēdende and sum þing fram him biddende.
text_bare: Ða com to him Zebedeis bearna modor mid hyre bearnum, hig geeadmedende and sum þing fram him biddende.

text: Þā cwæð hē, Hwæt wylt tū?
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Hwæt wylt tu?

text: Ðā cwæð hēo, Sege þæt þās mīne twēgen suna sittan, ān on þīne swīþran healfe and ān on þīne wynstran, on þīnum rīce.
text_bare: Ða cwæð heo, Sege þæt þas mine twegen suna sittan, an on þine swiþran healfe and an on þine wynstran, on þinum rice.

text: Ðā andswarode him sē Hǣlend, Gyt nyton hwæt gyt biddaþ.
text_bare: Ða andswarode him se Hælend, Gyt nyton hwæt gyt biddaþ.

text: Mage gyt drincan þone calic ðe ic tō drincenne hæbbe?
text_bare: Mage gyt drincan þone calic ðe ic to drincenne hæbbe?

text: Þā cwǣdon hig, Wyt magon.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hig, Wyt magon.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Witodlīce gyt mīnne calic drincaþ; tō sittanne on mīne swīþran healfe, oððe on wynstran, nys mē inc tō syllanne, ac þām þe hyt fram mīnum Fæder gegearwod ys.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Witodlice gyt minne calic drincaþ; to sittanne on mine swiþran healfe, oððe on wynstran, nys me inc to syllanne, ac þam þe hyt fram minum Fæder gegearwod ys.

text: And þā ðā tȳn leorningcnihtas gebulgon wiþ ðā twēgen gebrōðru.
text_bare: And þa ða tyn leorningcnihtas gebulgon wiþ ða twegen gebroðru.

text: Þā clypode sē Hǣlend hig tō him, and cwæð, Wite gē þæt ealdormenn wealdað hyra þēoda, and þā ðe synt yldran habbað anweald on him.
text_bare: Þa clypode se Hælend hig to him, and cwæð, Wite ge þæt ealdormenn wealdað hyra þeoda, and þa ðe synt yldran habbað anweald on him.

text: Ne byþ swā betweox ēow; ac swā hwylc swā wyle betweox ēow bēon yldra, sȳ hē ēower þēn;
text_bare: Ne byþ swa betweox eow; ac swa hwylc swa wyle betweox eow beon yldra, sy he eower þen;

text: and sē þe wyle betweox ēow bēon fyrmest, sȳ hē ēower þēow:
text_bare: and se þe wyle betweox eow beon fyrmest, sy he eower þeow:

text: swā mannes Sunu ne cōm þæt him man þēnode, ac þæt hē þēnode, and sealde his sāwle līf tō ālȳsednesse for manegum.
text_bare: swa mannes Sunu ne com þæt him man þenode, ac þæt he þenode, and sealde his sawle lif to alysednesse for manegum.

text: Gē wilniað tō geþēonne on gehwǣdum þinge, and bēon gewanod on þām mǣstan þinge.
text_bare: Ge wilniað to geþeonne on gehwædum þinge, and beon gewanod on þam mæstan þinge.

text: Witodlīce þonne gē tō gerēorde gelaþode bēoð, ne sitte gē on þām fyrmestan setlum, þē læs þe ārwurðra wer æfter þē cume, and sē hūsbōnda hāte þē ārīsan and rȳman þām ōðron, and þū bēo gescynd; gyf þū sitst on gerēorde on þām ȳtemestan setle, and æfter þē cymþ ōþer gebēor, and sē laþigenda cweþe tō þe, Site innor, lēof, þonne byþ ðē ārwurðlīcor þonne þē man ūttor scufe.
text_bare: Witodlice þonne ge to gereorde gelaþode beoð, ne sitte ge on þam fyrmestan setlum, þe læs þe arwurðra wer æfter þe cume, and se husbonda hate þe arisan and ryman þam oðron, and þu beo gescynd; gyf þu sitst on gereorde on þam ytemestan setle, and æfter þe cymþ oþer gebeor, and se laþigenda cweþe to þe, Site innor, leof, þonne byþ ðe arwurðlicor þonne þe man uttor scufe.

text: And þā hig fērdon fram Hiericho, him fyligde mycel menegu.
text_bare: And þa hig ferdon fram Hiericho, him fyligde mycel menegu.

text: And þā sǣton twēgen blinde wiþ ðone weg, and gehȳrdon þæt sē Hǣlend fērde; and þā clypodon hig tō him and cwǣdon, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.
text_bare: And þa sæton twegen blinde wiþ ðone weg, and gehyrdon þæt se Hælend ferde; and þa clypodon hig to him and cwædon, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.

text: Ðā bēad sēo menegu him þæt hig suwodon; þā clypodon hig þæs ðē mā, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.
text_bare: Ða bead seo menegu him þæt hig suwodon; þa clypodon hig þæs ðe ma, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.

text: Þā stōd sē Hǣlend, and clypode hig tō him, and cwæð, Hwæt wylle gyt þæt ic inc dō?
text_bare: Þa stod se Hælend, and clypode hig to him, and cwæð, Hwæt wylle gyt þæt ic inc do?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Drihten, þæt uncre ēagan sīn geopenode.
