text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Drihten, þæt uncre eagan sin geopenode.

text: Ðā gemiltsode hē him, and hyra ēagan æthrān; and hig sōna gesāwon, and fyligdon him.
text_bare: Ða gemiltsode he him, and hyra eagan æthran; and hig sona gesawon, and fyligdon him.

text: And þā hē genēalǣhte Hierusalem, and cōm tō Bethfage, tō Oliuetes dūne, þā sende hē hys twēgen leorningcnihtas,
text_bare: And þa he genealæhte Hierusalem, and com to Bethfage, to Oliuetes dune, þa sende he hys twegen leorningcnihtas,

text: And sǣde him, Farað on þæt castel þæt foran ongēn ēow ys, and þonne sōna finde gyt āne assene getiggede and hyre folan mid hyre; untīgeað hig, and lǣdað to mē.
text_bare: And sæde him, Farað on þæt castel þæt foran ongen eow ys, and þonne sona finde gyt ane assene getiggede and hyre folan mid hyre; untigeað hig, and lædað to me.

text: And gyf hwā ēow ǣnig þing tō cwyð, secgeað þæt Drihten hæfð þyses nēode; and þonne forlǣt hē ēow hrædlīce.
text_bare: And gyf hwa eow ænig þing to cwyð, secgeað þæt Drihten hæfð þyses neode; and þonne forlæt he eow hrædlice.

text: Eall þis wæs geworden þæt wǣre gefylled þæt þurh Esaiam þone wītegan gecweden wæs,
text_bare: Eall þis wæs geworden þæt wære gefylled þæt þurh Esaiam þone witegan gecweden wæs,

text: Secgeað hēahnesse dehter, Nū þīn Cyning þē cymð tō, gedæfte, and rīt uppan tamre assene, and hyre folan.
text_bare: Secgeað heahnesse dehter, Nu þin Cyning þe cymð to, gedæfte, and rit uppan tamre assene, and hyre folan.

text: Þā fērdon hys leorningcnihtas and dydon swā hē him bebēad,
text_bare: Þa ferdon hys leorningcnihtas and dydon swa he him bebead,

text: and lǣddon þā assene tō him and hyre folan, and lēdon hyra rēaf uppan hig, and setton hyne anuppan.
text_bare: and læddon þa assene to him and hyre folan, and ledon hyra reaf uppan hig, and setton hyne anuppan.

text: Witodlīce þæt folc strehton hyra rēaf on þone weg; sume hēowun þǣra trēowa bōgas, and strewodun on þone weg.
text_bare: Witodlice þæt folc strehton hyra reaf on þone weg; sume heowun þæra treowa bogas, and strewodun on þone weg.

text: Þæt folc þæt þār beforan fērde and þæt þār æfter fērde clypodon and cwǣdon, Hāl sȳ þū, Dauides sunu; sȳ geblētsod sē þe cōm on Drihtenes naman; sȳ him hǣl on hēhnessum!
text_bare: Þæt folc þæt þar beforan ferde and þæt þar æfter ferde clypodon and cwædon, Hal sy þu, Dauides sunu; sy gebletsod se þe com on Drihtenes naman; sy him hæl on hehnessum!

text: Ðā hē fērde tō Ierusalem, þā wearð eall sēo burhwaru onstyred, and cwǣdon, Hwæt is þēs?
text_bare: Ða he ferde to Ierusalem, þa wearð eall seo burhwaru onstyred, and cwædon, Hwæt is þes?

text: Þā cwæð þæt folc, Þis ys sē Hǣlend, wītega, of Nazareth on Galilea.
text_bare: Þa cwæð þæt folc, Þis ys se Hælend, witega, of Nazareth on Galilea.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend intō þām temple ēode, hē ādrāf ūt ealle þā þe cēapodun innan þām temple, and þāra mynetera sceamelas and hyra setlu þāra þe culfran sealdon hē tōbræc;
text_bare: Þa se Hælend into þam temple eode, he adraf ut ealle þa þe ceapodun innan þam temple, and þara mynetera sceamelas and hyra setlu þara þe culfran sealdon he tobræc;

text: and cwæþ tō him, Hyt ys āwriten, Mīn hūs ys gebedhūs; witodlīce gē worhtun þæt tō þēofa cote.
text_bare: and cwæþ to him, Hyt ys awriten, Min hus ys gebedhus; witodlice ge worhtun þæt to þeofa cote.

text: Ðā ēodan tō him þā blindan and þā healtan; and hē hī gehǣlde.
text_bare: Ða eodan to him þa blindan and þa healtan; and he hi gehælde.

text: Witodlīce þā ðāra sācerda ealdras and þā bōceras gesāwun þā wundru þe sē Hǣlend worhte, and gehȳrdon hū þā cild clypodun on þām temple and cwǣdon, Sȳ Dauides sunu hāl!
text_bare: Witodlice þa ðara sacerda ealdras and þa boceras gesawun þa wundru þe se Hælend worhte, and gehyrdon hu þa cild clypodun on þam temple and cwædon, Sy Dauides sunu hal!

text: ðā wǣron hig yrre,
text_bare: ða wæron hig yrre,

text: and cwǣdun, Gehȳrst þū hwæt þās cweðaþ?
text_bare: and cwædun, Gehyrst þu hwæt þas cweðaþ?

text: Þā cwæð hē, Witodlīce; ne rǣddon gē nǣfre, Þū fulfremedest lof of cilda and of sūcendra mūþe?
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Witodlice; ne ræddon ge næfre, Þu fulfremedest lof of cilda and of sucendra muþe?

text: And hē forlēt hī þā, and fērde of þǣre byrig tō Bethania, and lǣrde hī þār be Godes rīce.
text_bare: And he forlet hi þa, and ferde of þære byrig to Bethania, and lærde hi þar be Godes rice.

text: On morgen þā hē eft tō þǣre byrig fōr, þā hingrede hyne.
text_bare: On morgen þa he eft to þære byrig for, þa hingrede hyne.

text: And hē geseh ān fīctrēow wið þone weg; þā ēode hē tō him, and ne funde on him būton þā lēaf āne; ðā cwæð hē, Ne wurþe nǣfre wæstm of þē ācenned.
text_bare: And he geseh an fictreow wið þone weg; þa eode he to him, and ne funde on him buton þa leaf ane; ða cwæð he, Ne wurþe næfre wæstm of þe acenned.

text: Ðā sōna forscranc þæt fīctrēow.
text_bare: Ða sona forscranc þæt fictreow.

text: And his leorningcnihtas wundrodon and cwǣdon, Lōca, nū hū hrædlīce þæt fīctrēow forscranc!
text_bare: And his leorningcnihtas wundrodon and cwædon, Loca, nu hu hrædlice þæt fictreow forscranc!

text: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Gyf gē habbað gelēafan and ne twȳniað, ne dō gē nā þæt ān be þām fīctrēowe, ac ēac þēh gē cweþan tō þisum munte, Āhefe þē ūpp and feall innan þā sǣ,
text_bare: Þa andswarode he him and cwæð, Soþ ic eow secge, Gyf ge habbað geleafan and ne twyniað, ne do ge na þæt an be þam fictreowe, ac eac þeh ge cweþan to þisum munte, Ahefe þe upp and feall innan þa sæ,

text: and ealles þæs þe gē biddaþ gē bēoð tīþa, gyf gē gelȳfað.
text_bare: and ealles þæs þe ge biddaþ ge beoð tiþa, gyf ge gelyfað.

text: Ðā hē cōm intō þām temple, þā cōmon þāra sācerda ealdras him tō, and cwǣdon, On hwylcre mihte wyrcsð þū þās þing?
text_bare: Ða he com into þam temple, þa comon þara sacerda ealdras him to, and cwædon, On hwylcre mihte wyrcsð þu þas þing?

text: and hwā sealde þē þisne anweald?
text_bare: and hwa sealde þe þisne anweald?

text: Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, And ic āhsige ēow ānre sprǣce; gyf gē mē þā sprǣce secgeað, þonne secge ic ēow on hwylcum anwealde ic þās þing wyrce.
text_bare: Þa andswarode se Hælend him and cwæð, And ic ahsige eow anre spræce; gyf ge me þa spræce secgeað, þonne secge ic eow on hwylcum anwealde ic þas þing wyrce.

text: Hwæðer wæs Iohannes fulluht?
text_bare: Hwæðer wæs Iohannes fulluht?

text: þe of heofonum, þe of mannum?
text_bare: þe of heofonum, þe of mannum?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig betwux him, Gyf wē secgaþ, Of heofone, þonne cwyð hē, For hwām ne gelȳfde ge him?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig betwux him, Gyf we secgaþ, Of heofone, þonne cwyð he, For hwam ne gelyfde ge him?

text: Gyf wē secgað, Of mannum, wē ondrǣdað þis folc; ealle hig hæfdon Iohannem for ānne wītegan.
text_bare: Gyf we secgað, Of mannum, we ondrædað þis folc; ealle hig hæfdon Iohannem for anne witegan.

text: Ðā andswaredon hig and cwǣdon, Wē nyton.
text_bare: Ða andswaredon hig and cwædon, We nyton.

text: Þā cwæð hē, Nē ic ēow ne secge of hwylcum anwealde ic þās þing wyrce.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Ne ic eow ne secge of hwylcum anwealde ic þas þing wyrce.

text: Hū þincð ēow?
text_bare: Hu þincð eow?

text: Ān mann hæfde twēgen suna; þā cwæð hē tō þām yldran suna, Gā and wyrce tō dæg on mīnum wīngearde.
text_bare: An mann hæfde twegen suna; þa cwæð he to þam yldran suna, Ga and wyrce to dæg on minum wingearde.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Ic nelle; ēode þēh syðþan tō þām wingearde.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Ic nelle; eode þeh syðþan to þam wingearde.

text: Þā cwæð hē eal swā tō þām ōðrum.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he eal swa to þam oðrum.

text: Ðā andswarode sē him and cwæð, Hlāford ic gā; and ne ēode swā þēah.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se him and cwæð, Hlaford ic ga; and ne eode swa þeah.

text: Hwæðer þāra twēgra dyde þæs fæder willan?
text_bare: Hwæðer þara twegra dyde þæs fæder willan?

text: Þā cwǣdon hig, Sē æftera.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hig, Se æftera.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Sōð ic ēow secge þæt mānfulle and myltystran gāð beforan ēow on Godes rīce.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend to him, Soð ic eow secge þæt manfulle and myltystran gað beforan eow on Godes rice.

text: Iohannes cōm on rihtwīsnesse wege, and gē ne gelȳfdon him; witodlīce mānfulle and myltystran gelȳfdon; and gē gesāwon, and ne dydon syðþan nāne dǣdbōte þæt gē gelȳfdon on him.
text_bare: Iohannes com on rihtwisnesse wege, and ge ne gelyfdon him; witodlice manfulle and myltystran gelyfdon; and ge gesawon, and ne dydon syðþan nane dædbote þæt ge gelyfdon on him.

text: Gehȳrað nū ōþer bigspel: Sum hīredes ealdor wæs sē plantode wingeard, and betȳnde hyne, and sette þǣr on wīnwringan, and getimbrode ānne stȳpel, and gesette þone mid eorþtylion; and fērde on elþēodignysse.
text_bare: Gehyrað nu oþer bigspel: Sum hiredes ealdor wæs se plantode wingeard, and betynde hyne, and sette þær on winwringan, and getimbrode anne stypel, and gesette þone mid eorþtylion; and ferde on elþeodignysse.

text: Þā ðāra wæstma tīd genēalǣhte, þā sende hē hys þēowas tō þām eorðtylion þæt hig onfēngon his wæstmas.
text_bare: Þa ðara wæstma tid genealæhte, þa sende he hys þeowas to þam eorðtylion þæt hig onfengon his wæstmas.

text: Ðā nāmon hig hys þēowas, and swungon sumne, sumne hig ofslōgun, sumne hig oftorfodun.
text_bare: Ða namon hig hys þeowas, and swungon sumne, sumne hig ofslogun, sumne hig oftorfodun.

text: Ðā sende hē eft ōðre þēowas sēlran þonne þā ǣrran wǣron; ðā dydon hig þām gelīce.
text_bare: Ða sende he eft oðre þeowas selran þonne þa ærran wæron; ða dydon hig þam gelice.

text: Æt nēhstan hē sende hys sunu him tō, and cwæð, Hig forwandiað þæt hig ne dōn mīnum suna swā.
text_bare: Æt nehstan he sende hys sunu him to, and cwæð, Hig forwandiað þæt hig ne don minum suna swa.

text: Witodlīce þā ðā tylian þone sunu gesāwun, þā cwǣdon hig betwyx him, Ðēs ys yrfenuma; uton gān and ofslēan hyne, and habban ūs hys ǣhta.
text_bare: Witodlice þa ða tylian þone sunu gesawun, þa cwædon hig betwyx him, Ðes ys yrfenuma; uton gan and ofslean hyne, and habban us hys æhta.

text: Ðā nāmon hig and ofslōgon hyne, and āwurpon wiðūtan þone wīngeard.
text_bare: Ða namon hig and ofslogon hyne, and awurpon wiðutan þone wingeard.

text: Hwæt dēþ ðēs wīngeardes hlāford þām eorþtylion, þonne hē cymð?
text_bare: Hwæt deþ ðes wingeardes hlaford þam eorþtylion, þonne he cymð?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Hē fordēð þā yfelan mid yfele, and gesett hys wingeard myd ōþrum tilion þe him hys wæstm hyra tīdon āgyfon.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, He fordeð þa yfelan mid yfele, and gesett hys wingeard myd oþrum tilion þe him hys wæstm hyra tidon agyfon.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlynd, Ne rǣdde gē nǣfre on gewritum, Sē stān þe ðā timbriendan āwurpon ys geworden tō þǣre hyrnan hēafde; ðys ys fram Drihtne gewordyn, and hyt ys wundorlīc on ūrum ēagum.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælynd, Ne rædde ge næfre on gewritum, Se stan þe ða timbriendan awurpon ys geworden to þære hyrnan heafde; ðys ys fram Drihtne gewordyn, and hyt ys wundorlic on urum eagum.

text: For þām ic secge ēow þæt ēow byð ætbrōden Godes rīce, and byð geseald þǣre þēode þe hys earnað.
text_bare: For þam ic secge eow þæt eow byð ætbroden Godes rice, and byð geseald þære þeode þe hys earnað.

text: And sē þe fylþ uppan þysne stān, hē byð tobrȳsed; and hē tōbrȳsð þone ðe hē onuppan fylð.
text_bare: And se þe fylþ uppan þysne stan, he byð tobrysed; and he tobrysð þone ðe he onuppan fylð.

text: Þā þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā Pharisei hys bigspel gehȳrdon, þā ongēton hig þæt hē hit sǣde be him.
text_bare: Þa þæra sacerda ealdras and þa Pharisei hys bigspel gehyrdon, þa ongeton hig þæt he hit sæde be him.

text: Hī sōhton hyne, and ondrēdon þæt folc, for þām þe hī hæfdon hyne for ǣnne wītegan.
text_bare: Hi sohton hyne, and ondredon þæt folc, for þam þe hi hæfdon hyne for ænne witegan.

text: Ðā sǣde hē hym eft ōðer bigspel and þus cwæð,
text_bare: Ða sæde he hym eft oðer bigspel and þus cwæð,

text: Heofona rīce ys gelīc geworden þām cyninge þe macude hys suna gyfta,
text_bare: Heofona rice ys gelic geworden þam cyninge þe macude hys suna gyfta,

text: and sende his þēowas and clypode þā gelaðodan tō þām gyftum; þā noldon hī cuman.
text_bare: and sende his þeowas and clypode þa gelaðodan to þam gyftum; þa noldon hi cuman.

text: Ðā sende hē eft ōðere þēowas, and sǣde þām gelaþedon, Nū ic gegearwode mīne feorme; mīne fearras and mīne fugelas synt ofslegene, and ealle mīne þing synt gearwe; cumað tō þām gyftum.
text_bare: Ða sende he eft oðere þeowas, and sæde þam gelaþedon, Nu ic gegearwode mine feorme; mine fearras and mine fugelas synt ofslegene, and ealle mine þing synt gearwe; cumað to þam gyftum.

text: Ðā forgȳmdon hig þæt, and fērdun, sum tō his tūne, sum tō hys mangunge.
text_bare: Ða forgymdon hig þæt, and ferdun, sum to his tune, sum to hys mangunge.

text: And þā ōþre nāmon hys þēowas, and mid tēonan geswencton, and ofslōgon.
text_bare: And þa oþre namon hys þeowas, and mid teonan geswencton, and ofslogon.

text: Ðā sē cyning þæt gehȳrde, þā wæs hē yrre; and sende hys here tō, and fordyde þā manslagan, and hyra burh forbærnde.
text_bare: Ða se cyning þæt gehyrde, þa wæs he yrre; and sende hys here to, and fordyde þa manslagan, and hyra burh forbærnde.

text: Þā cwæð hē tō hys þēowum, Witodlīce þās gyfta synt gearwe, ac þā ðe gelaþode wǣron ne synt wyrþe.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he to hys þeowum, Witodlice þas gyfta synt gearwe, ac þa ðe gelaþode wæron ne synt wyrþe.

text: Gāð nū witodlīce to wega gelǣtum, and clypiað to þisum gyftum swā hwylce swā gē gemēton.
text_bare: Gað nu witodlice to wega gelætum, and clypiað to þisum gyftum swa hwylce swa ge gemeton.

text: Ðā ēodon þā þēowas ūt on þā wegas, and gegaderedon ealle ðā þe hig gemētton, gōde and yfele; þā wǣrun þā gyfthūs mid sīttyndum mannum gefyllede.
text_bare: Ða eodon þa þeowas ut on þa wegas, and gegaderedon ealle ða þe hig gemetton, gode and yfele; þa wærun þa gyfthus mid sittyndum mannum gefyllede.

text: Ðā ēode sē cyning in þæt hē wolde gesēon þā ðe þǣr sǣton, þā geseah hē þǣr ǣnne mann þe næs mid gyftlīcum rēafe gescrȳd;
text_bare: Ða eode se cyning in þæt he wolde geseon þa ðe þær sæton, þa geseah he þær ænne mann þe næs mid gyftlicum reafe gescryd;

text: þā cwæð hē, Lā frēond, hūmeta ēodest þū in, and næfdest gyftlīc rēaf?
text_bare: þa cwæð he, La freond, humeta eodest þu in, and næfdest gyftlic reaf?

text: Ðā gesuwode hē.
text_bare: Ða gesuwode he.

text: And sē cyning cwæþ tō hys þēnon, Gebindað hys handa and hys fēt, and wurpaþ hyne on þā ūttran þȳstro; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
text_bare: And se cyning cwæþ to hys þenon, Gebindað hys handa and hys fet, and wurpaþ hyne on þa uttran þystro; þær byþ wop and toþa gristbitung.

text: Witodlīce manega synt gelaþode, and fēawa gecorene.
text_bare: Witodlice manega synt gelaþode, and feawa gecorene.

text: Ðā ongunnon þā Pharisei rǣdan þæt hig woldon þone Hǣlend on hys sprǣce befōn.
text_bare: Ða ongunnon þa Pharisei rædan þæt hig woldon þone Hælend on hys spræce befon.

text: Þā sendon hī him hyra leorningcnihtas tō mid þām Herodianiscum, and þus cwǣdon, Lārēow, wē witon þæt þū eart sōðfæst, and þū lǣrst Godes weg mid sōðfæstnysse, and ðū ne wandest for nānon menn, nē þū ne bescēawast nānes mannes hād.
text_bare: Þa sendon hi him hyra leorningcnihtas to mid þam Herodianiscum, and þus cwædon, Lareow, we witon þæt þu eart soðfæst, and þu lærst Godes weg mid soðfæstnysse, and ðu ne wandest for nanon menn, ne þu ne besceawast nanes mannes had.

text: Sege ūs, Hwæt þincð þē?
text_bare: Sege us, Hwæt þincð þe?

text: ys hyt ālȳfed þæt man Cāsere gaful sylle, þe na?
text_bare: ys hyt alyfed þæt man Casere gaful sylle, þe na?

text: Þā sē Hǣlend hyra fācn gehȳrde, þā cwæð hē, Lā līcceteras, hwī fandige gē mīn?
text_bare: Þa se Hælend hyra facn gehyrde, þa cwæð he, La licceteras, hwi fandige ge min?

text: Ætȳwað mē þæs gafoles mynyt.
text_bare: Ætywað me þæs gafoles mynyt.

text: Ðā brōhton hī him ānne pening.
text_bare: Ða brohton hi him anne pening.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Hwæs anlīcnys ys þis and ðis ofergewrit?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Hwæs anlicnys ys þis and ðis ofergewrit?

text: Hig cwǣdon, Þæs Cāsyres.
text_bare: Hig cwædon, Þæs Casyres.

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Āgyfað þām Cāsere þā þing þe ðæs Cāsyres synt, and Gode þā ðing þe Godes synt.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Agyfað þam Casere þa þing þe ðæs Casyres synt, and Gode þa ðing þe Godes synt.

text: Þā hig þæt gehȳrdon, þā wundrodon hig, and forlēton hyne, and fērdon on weg.
text_bare: Þa hig þæt gehyrdon, þa wundrodon hig, and forleton hyne, and ferdon on weg.

text: On þām dæge cōmon tō him Saducei, þā secgeað þæt nān ǣryst ne sȳ, and hig āxodon hyne,
text_bare: On þam dæge comon to him Saducei, þa secgeað þæt nan æryst ne sy, and hig axodon hyne,

text: and cwǣdon, Lāreow, Moyses sǣde gif hwā dēad syg, and bearn næbbe, þæt his brōðor nyme hys wīf, and strȳne him bearn.
text_bare: and cwædon, Lareow, Moyses sæde gif hwa dead syg, and bearn næbbe, þæt his broðor nyme hys wif, and stryne him bearn.

text: Witodlīce mid ūs wǣrun seofun gebrōþru; and sē forma fette wīf, and forð fērde, and lǣfde hys brēþer his wīf būtan bearne;
text_bare: Witodlice mid us wærun seofun gebroþru; and se forma fette wif, and forð ferde, and læfde hys breþer his wif butan bearne;

text: and sē ōðer eal swā, and sē þrydda, oþ ðone seofoþan.
text_bare: and se oðer eal swa, and se þrydda, oþ ðone seofoþan.

text: Þā æt sīþemestan forþ fērde þæt wīf.
text_bare: Þa æt siþemestan forþ ferde þæt wif.

text: Hwylces þǣra seofona byð þæt wīf on þām ǣriste?
text_bare: Hwylces þæra seofona byð þæt wif on þam æriste?

text: ealle hig hæfdon hig.
text_bare: ealle hig hæfdon hig.

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend hym and cwæð, Gē dweliað, and ne cunnon hālige gewritu, nē Godes mægen.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend hym and cwæð, Ge dweliað, and ne cunnon halige gewritu, ne Godes mægen.

text: Witodlīce ne wīfiað hig, nē hig ne ceorliað on þām ǣryste, ac hig synt swylce Godes englas on heofone.
text_bare: Witodlice ne wifiað hig, ne hig ne ceorliað on þam æryste, ac hig synt swylce Godes englas on heofone.

text: Ne rǣdde gē be dēadra manna ǣryste þæt ēow fram Gode gesǣd wæs,
text_bare: Ne rædde ge be deadra manna æryste þæt eow fram Gode gesæd wæs,

text: Nys God nā dēadra, ac lybbyndra.
text_bare: Nys God na deadra, ac lybbyndra.

text: Þā þæt folc þæt gehȳrde, þā wundrudon hig hys lāre.
text_bare: Þa þæt folc þæt gehyrde, þa wundrudon hig hys lare.

text: Þā þā Phariseiscean gehȳrdon þæt hē hēt þā Saduceiscan stylle bēon, þā ēodon hig tōgædere.
text_bare: Þa þa Phariseiscean gehyrdon þæt he het þa Saduceiscan stylle beon, þa eodon hig togædere.

text: And ān þe wæs þǣre ǣ lārēow āxode hyne, and fandode hys, þus cweðende,
text_bare: And an þe wæs þære æ lareow axode hyne, and fandode hys, þus cweðende,

text: Lā Lārēow, hwæt ys þæt mǣste bebod on þǣre ǣ?
text_bare: La Lareow, hwæt ys þæt mæste bebod on þære æ?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lufa Drihten þīnne God on ealre þīnre heortan, and on ealre þīnre sāwle, and on eallum þīnum mōde.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Lufa Drihten þinne God on ealre þinre heortan, and on ealre þinre sawle, and on eallum þinum mode.

text: Þis ys þæt mǣste and þæt fyrmyste bebod.
text_bare: Þis ys þæt mæste and þæt fyrmyste bebod.

text: Ōþyr ys þysum gelīc, Lufa þīnne nēhstan swā swā þē sylfne.
text_bare: Oþyr ys þysum gelic, Lufa þinne nehstan swa swa þe sylfne.

text: On þysum twām bebodum byþ gefylled eall sēo ǣ.
text_bare: On þysum twam bebodum byþ gefylled eall seo æ.

text: Þā þā Phariseiscan gegaderude wǣrun, þā cwæð sē Hǣlynd,
text_bare: Þa þa Phariseiscan gegaderude wærun, þa cwæð se Hælynd,

text: Hwæt þincð ēow be Crīste?
text_bare: Hwæt þincð eow be Criste?

text: hwæs sunu ys hē?
text_bare: hwæs sunu ys he?

text: Hig cwǣdun, Dauides.
text_bare: Hig cwædun, Dauides.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Hwī clypað Dauid hyne on Gāste Drihtyn, and cwyð,
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Hwi clypað Dauid hyne on Gaste Drihtyn, and cwyð,

text: Drihten cwæð tō mīnum Drihtne, Site on mīne swȳþran healfe, oð þæt ic gesette þīne fȳnd þē tō fōtscamole.
text_bare: Drihten cwæð to minum Drihtne, Site on mine swyþran healfe, oð þæt ic gesette þine fynd þe to fotscamole.

text: Gyf Dauid hyne on Gāste Dryhten clypað, hū ys hē hys sunu?
text_bare: Gyf Dauid hyne on Gaste Dryhten clypað, hu ys he hys sunu?

text: Ðā ne mihton hig him nān word andswarian, nē nān ne dorste of ðām dæge hyne nān þing māre āxigean.
text_bare: Ða ne mihton hig him nan word andswarian, ne nan ne dorste of ðam dæge hyne nan þing mare axigean.

text: Þā spræc sē Hǣlynd to þām folce and tō hys leorningcnyhton,
text_bare: Þa spræc se Hælynd to þam folce and to hys leorningcnyhton,

text: and cwæð, Bōceras and Pharisei sǣtun ofer Moyses lārēowsetl:
text_bare: and cwæð, Boceras and Pharisei sætun ofer Moyses lareowsetl:

text: healdaþ and wyrceað swā hwæt swā hig secgeaþ; and ne dō gē nā æfter heora worcum: hig secgeað, and ne dōð.
text_bare: healdaþ and wyrceað swa hwæt swa hig secgeaþ; and ne do ge na æfter heora worcum: hig secgeað, and ne doð.

text: Hig bindað hefige byrþyna þe man āberan ne mæg, and lecgeað þā uppan manna exla; and nellað hig þā mid heora fingre æthrīnan.
text_bare: Hig bindað hefige byrþyna þe man aberan ne mæg, and lecgeað þa uppan manna exla; and nellað hig þa mid heora fingre æthrinan.

text: Ealle heora worc hig dōð þæt menn hī gesēon; hig tōbrǣdaþ hyra healsbēc, and mǣrsiað heora rēafa fnadu;
text_bare: Ealle heora worc hig doð þæt menn hi geseon; hig tobrædaþ hyra healsbec, and mærsiað heora reafa fnadu;

text: hig lufigeað þā fyrmystan setl on gebēorscypum, and þā fyrmystan lārēowsetl on gesomnungum,
text_bare: hig lufigeað þa fyrmystan setl on gebeorscypum, and þa fyrmystan lareowsetl on gesomnungum,

text: and þæt hig man grēte on strǣtum, and þæt menn hig lārēowas nemnon.
text_bare: and þæt hig man grete on strætum, and þæt menn hig lareowas nemnon.

text: Ne gyrne gē þæt ēow man lārēowas nemne; ān ys ēower lārēow; gē synt ealle gebrōþru.
text_bare: Ne gyrne ge þæt eow man lareowas nemne; an ys eower lareow; ge synt ealle gebroþru.

text: And ne nemne gē ēow fædyr ofer eorþan; ān ys ēower Fædyr, sē þe on heofonum ys.
text_bare: And ne nemne ge eow fædyr ofer eorþan; an ys eower Fædyr, se þe on heofonum ys.

text: Nē ēow man ne nemne lārēowas; for þām ān, Crīst, is ēower Lārēow.
text_bare: Ne eow man ne nemne lareowas; for þam an, Crist, is eower Lareow.

text: Sē þe ēower yltst sȳ, bēo sē ēower þēn.
text_bare: Se þe eower yltst sy, beo se eower þen.

text: Witodlīce sē þe hyne ūpp āhefð se byþ genyþerud; and sē þe hyne sylfne geēaðmēt sē byð ūpp āhafyn.
text_bare: Witodlice se þe hyne upp ahefð se byþ genyþerud; and se þe hyne sylfne geeaðmet se byð upp ahafyn.

text: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, bocyras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: for þām gē belūcað heofona rice beforan mannum; nē gē in ne gāþ, nē gē ne geþafiað þæt ōðre in gān.
text_bare: for þam ge belucað heofona rice beforan mannum; ne ge in ne gaþ, ne ge ne geþafiað þæt oðre in gan.

text: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, bocyras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: for þām gē befarað sǣ and eorþan þæt gē dōn ānne elþēodigne; and þonne hē gewordyn byð, gē gedōð hyne helle bearn twȳfealdlīcor þonne ēow.
text_bare: for þam ge befarað sæ and eorþan þæt ge don anne elþeodigne; and þonne he gewordyn byð, ge gedoð hyne helle bearn twyfealdlicor þonne eow.

text: Wā ēow blindan lāttēowas!
text_bare: Wa eow blindan latteowas!

text: gē secgeað swā hwylc swā swereþ on temple, þæt hē ys nāht; swā hwā swā swereð on þæs temples golde, sē ys scyldig.
text_bare: ge secgeað swa hwylc swa swereþ on temple, þæt he ys naht; swa hwa swa swereð on þæs temples golde, se ys scyldig.

text: Ēalā gē dysegan and blindan!
text_bare: Eala ge dysegan and blindan!

text: hwæþer ys māre, ðe þæt gold, þe þæt templ ðe þæt gold gehālgað?
text_bare: hwæþer ys mare, ðe þæt gold, þe þæt templ ðe þæt gold gehalgað?

text: And swā hwā swā swereþ on þām wēofode, þæt ys nāht; swā hwylc swā swereþ on þǣre offrunge þe ofer þæt wēofud ys, sē ys gyltig.
text_bare: And swa hwa swa swereþ on þam weofode, þæt ys naht; swa hwylc swa swereþ on þære offrunge þe ofer þæt weofud ys, se ys gyltig.

text: Ēalā gē blindan!
text_bare: Eala ge blindan!

text: hwæþer ys māre, þe offrung, þe þæt wēofud þe gehālgað þā offrunge?
text_bare: hwæþer ys mare, þe offrung, þe þæt weofud þe gehalgað þa offrunge?

text: Witodlīce sē þe swereþ on wēofude, hē swereð on him and on eallum þām þe him ofer synt.
text_bare: Witodlice se þe swereþ on weofude, he swereð on him and on eallum þam þe him ofer synt.

text: {{nop} .
text_bare: {{nop} .

text: And sē þe swereð on temple, hē swereð on him and on þām þe him on eardiað.
text_bare: And se þe swereð on temple, he swereð on him and on þam þe him on eardiað.

text: And sē ðe swerað on heofonan, hē sweryð on Godes þrymsetle and on þām þe ofer þæt sitt.
text_bare: And se ðe swerað on heofonan, he sweryð on Godes þrymsetle and on þam þe ofer þæt sitt.

text: Wā ēow, bōceras and Pharisei, liccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, boceras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: gē þe tēoðiað mintan, and dile, and cymen, and gē forlēton þā þing þe synt hefegran þǣre ǣ, dōm, and mildheortnysse, and gelēafan; þās þing hyt gebyrede þæt gē dydon, and þā ōðre ne forlētun.
text_bare: ge þe teoðiað mintan, and dile, and cymen, and ge forleton þa þing þe synt hefegran þære æ, dom, and mildheortnysse, and geleafan; þas þing hyt gebyrede þæt ge dydon, and þa oðre ne forletun.

text: Lā blindan lāttēowas, gē drehnigeað þone gnætt aweg, and drincað þone olfynd.
text_bare: La blindan latteowas, ge drehnigeað þone gnætt aweg, and drincað þone olfynd.

text: Wā ēow, bōceras and Pharisei, līccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, boceras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: for þām gē clǣnsiað þæt wiðūtan ys caliceas and dixas, and gē synt innan fulle rēaflāces and unclǣnnysse.
text_bare: for þam ge clænsiað þæt wiðutan ys caliceas and dixas, and ge synt innan fulle reaflaces and unclænnysse.

text: Ēalā þū blinda Phariseus, clǣnsa ǣryst þæt wiðinnan ys calicys and discys, þæt hyt sī clǣne þæt wiðūtan ys.
text_bare: Eala þu blinda Phariseus, clænsa æryst þæt wiðinnan ys calicys and discys, þæt hyt si clæne þæt wiðutan ys.

text: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, bocyras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: for þām gē synt gelīce hwītum byrgenum, þā þinceað mannum ūtan wlitige, and hig synt innan fulle dēadra bāna and ealre fȳlþe.
text_bare: for þam ge synt gelice hwitum byrgenum, þa þinceað mannum utan wlitige, and hig synt innan fulle deadra bana and ealre fylþe.

text: And swā gē ætȳwað mannum ūtan rihtwīse, innan gē sunt fulle līccettunge and unrihtwīsnesse.
text_bare: And swa ge ætywað mannum utan rihtwise, innan ge sunt fulle liccettunge and unrihtwisnesse.

text: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras!
text_bare: Wa eow, bocyras and Pharisei, liccetteras!

text: gē þe timbriað wītegena byrgene, and glengað rihtwīsra gemyndstōwa,
text_bare: ge þe timbriað witegena byrgene, and glengað rihtwisra gemyndstowa,

text: and gē cweþað, Gyf wē wǣrun on ūre fædera dagum, nǣre wē heora gefēran on þǣra wītegena blōdes gyte.
text_bare: and ge cweþað, Gyf we wærun on ure fædera dagum, nære we heora geferan on þæra witegena blodes gyte.

text: Witodlīce gē synt ēow sylfum to gewittnysse þæt gē synt þǣra bearn ðe ofslōgon þā wītegan.
text_bare: Witodlice ge synt eow sylfum to gewittnysse þæt ge synt þæra bearn ðe ofslogon þa witegan.

text: And gefylle gē þæt gemet ēowra fædera.
text_bare: And gefylle ge þæt gemet eowra fædera.

text: Ēalā gē nǣddran and nǣddrena cynn, hū flēo gē fram helle dōme?
text_bare: Eala ge næddran and næddrena cynn, hu fleo ge fram helle dome?

text: Ic sende tō ēow wītegan and wīse bōcyras; and gē hig ofslēað, and hōð, and swingað on ēowrum gesomnungum, and gē hig ēhtað of byrig on byrig:
text_bare: Ic sende to eow witegan and wise bocyras; and ge hig ofsleað, and hoð, and swingað on eowrum gesomnungum, and ge hig ehtað of byrig on byrig:

text: þæt ofer ēow cume ǣlc rihtwīs blōd þe wæs āgoten ofer eorþan, fram Abelys blōde þæs rihtwīsan oð Zacharias blōd, Barachias suna, þone gē ofslōgon betwyx þām temple and þām wēofode.
text_bare: þæt ofer eow cume ælc rihtwis blod þe wæs agoten ofer eorþan, fram Abelys blode þæs rihtwisan oð Zacharias blod, Barachias suna, þone ge ofslogon betwyx þam temple and þam weofode.

text: Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ealle þās þing cumaþ ofer þās cnēorisse.
text_bare: Soþ ic eow secge, Ealle þas þing cumaþ ofer þas cneorisse.

text: Ēalā Ierusalem, ēalā Ierusalem, þū þe wītegan ofslihst, and mid stānum oftorfast þā ðe tō þē āsende synt!
text_bare: Eala Ierusalem, eala Ierusalem, þu þe witegan ofslihst, and mid stanum oftorfast þa ðe to þe asende synt!

text: swīðe oft ic wolde þīne bearn gegaderigan, swā sēo henn hyre cīcenu under hyre fyþeru gegaderað, and þū noldest!
text_bare: swiðe oft ic wolde þine bearn gegaderigan, swa seo henn hyre cicenu under hyre fyþeru gegaderað, and þu noldest!

text: Witodlīce nū byþ ēower hūs ēow wēste forlǣten.
text_bare: Witodlice nu byþ eower hus eow weste forlæten.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne gesēoþ gē mē heonon forð, ǣr þām þe gē secgeon, Sȳ geblētsod sē þe cōm on Drihtnes naman.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Ne geseoþ ge me heonon forð, ær þam þe ge secgeon, Sy gebletsod se þe com on Drihtnes naman.

text: And þā sē Hǣlend ūt ēode of þām temple; him tō gēnēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas þæt hī him ætȳwdon þæs temples getimbrunge.
text_bare: And þa se Hælend ut eode of þam temple; him to genealæhton hys leorningcnihtas þæt hi him ætywdon þæs temples getimbrunge.

text: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Gesēoþ gē eall þis?
text_bare: Þa andswarode he him and cwæð, Geseoþ ge eall þis?

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne bið hēr lǣfed stān uppan stāne þe ne bēo tōworpen.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Ne bið her læfed stan uppan stane þe ne beo toworpen.

text: Ðā hē sæt uppan Oliuetes dūne, þā comun hys leorningcnihtas dīhlīce, and cwǣdon, Sege ūs hwænne þās ðing gewurþun?
text_bare: Ða he sæt uppan Oliuetes dune, þa comun hys leorningcnihtas dihlice, and cwædon, Sege us hwænne þas ðing gewurþun?

text: and hwilc tācn sī þīnes tōcymys, and worulde geendunge?
text_bare: and hwilc tacn si þines tocymys, and worulde geendunge?

text: Ðā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Warniað þæt ēow nān man ne beswīce.
text_bare: Ða andswarode he him and cwæð, Warniað þæt eow nan man ne beswice.

text: Manega cumaþ on mīnum naman, and cweðaþ, Ic eom Crīst; and beswīcaþ manega.
text_bare: Manega cumaþ on minum naman, and cweðaþ, Ic eom Crist; and beswicaþ manega.

text: Witodlīce gē gehȳrað gefeoht and gefeohta hlīsan; warnigeað þæt gē ne bēon gedrēfede; ðās þing sceolun gewurþan, ac nys þonne gȳt sē ende.
text_bare: Witodlice ge gehyrað gefeoht and gefeohta hlisan; warnigeað þæt ge ne beon gedrefede; ðas þing sceolun gewurþan, ac nys þonne gyt se ende.

text: Þēod winð ongēn þēode, and rīce ongēn rīce; and manncwealmas bēoð, and hungras wīde geond land, and eorþan styrunga.
text_bare: Þeod winð ongen þeode, and rice ongen rice; and manncwealmas beoð, and hungras wide geond land, and eorþan styrunga.

text: Ealle þās þing synt þǣra sāra anginnu.
text_bare: Ealle þas þing synt þæra sara anginnu.

text: Ðonne syllað hī ēow on gedrēfednysse, and ofslēað ēow; and ealle menn ēow hatigeað for mīnum naman.
text_bare: Ðonne syllað hi eow on gedrefednysse, and ofsleað eow; and ealle menn eow hatigeað for minum naman.

text: And þonne bēoð manega ungetrȳwsode, and belǣwað betwyx him, and hatigað him betwȳnan.
text_bare: And þonne beoð manega ungetrywsode, and belæwað betwyx him, and hatigað him betwynan.

text: And manega lēase wītegan cumað, and beswīcað manega.
text_bare: And manega lease witegan cumað, and beswicað manega.

text: And for þām þe unryhtwīsnys rīxað, manegra lufu ācōlaþ.
text_bare: And for þam þe unryhtwisnys rixað, manegra lufu acolaþ.

text: Witodlīce sē þe þurhwunað oð ende sē byþ hāl.
text_bare: Witodlice se þe þurhwunað oð ende se byþ hal.

text: And þis godspel byþ bodod ofer ealle eorþan on gewittnysse eallum þēodum; and þonne cymð sēo geendung.
text_bare: And þis godspel byþ bodod ofer ealle eorþan on gewittnysse eallum þeodum; and þonne cymð seo geendung.

text: Ðonne gē gesēoð þā onsceonunge þǣre tōworpennysse þe sē wītega gecwæð, Daniel, þā hē stōd on hāligre stōwe,—ongyte sē ðe hit rǣt,—
text_bare: Ðonne ge geseoð þa onsceonunge þære toworpennysse þe se witega gecwæð, Daniel, þa he stod on haligre stowe,—ongyte se ðe hit ræt,—

text: Flēon þonne tō muntum, þā þe on Iudea lande synt.
text_bare: Fleon þonne to muntum, þa þe on Iudea lande synt.

text: And sē þe ys uppan hys hūse, ne gā hē nyþyr þæt hē ǣnig þing on his hūse fecce.
text_bare: And se þe ys uppan hys huse, ne ga he nyþyr þæt he ænig þing on his huse fecce.

text: And sē þe is on æcyre, ne cyrre hē þæt he hys tunecan nyme.
text_bare: And se þe is on æcyre, ne cyrre he þæt he hys tunecan nyme.

text: Wā ēacniendum and fēdendum on þām dagum!
text_bare: Wa eacniendum and fedendum on þam dagum!

text: Biddað þæt ēower flēam on wintra oððe on restedæge ne gewurþe.
text_bare: Biddað þæt eower fleam on wintra oððe on restedæge ne gewurþe.

text: Witodlīce þonne byð swā mycel gedeorf, swā næs of middangeardes fruman oþ þis, nē nū ne gewurð.
text_bare: Witodlice þonne byð swa mycel gedeorf, swa næs of middangeardes fruman oþ þis, ne nu ne gewurð.

text: And būton þā dagas gescyrte wǣrun, nǣre nān mann hāl gewordyn; ac for þām gecorenum þe hē gecēas þā dagas bēoð gescyrte.
text_bare: And buton þa dagas gescyrte wærun, nære nan mann hal gewordyn; ac for þam gecorenum þe he geceas þa dagas beoð gescyrte.

text: Ðonne gyf ēow hwā segð, Nū Crīst ys hēr, oþþe ðǣr; ne gelȳfe gē him.
text_bare: Ðonne gyf eow hwa segð, Nu Crist ys her, oþþe ðær; ne gelyfe ge him.

text: Þonne cumað lēase Crīstas and lēase wītegan, and dōð mycle tācn and forebēacn, þæt ðā bēoþ on gedwolan gelǣdde, gyf hyt bēon mæg, þe gecorene wǣrun.
text_bare: Þonne cumað lease Cristas and lease witegan, and doð mycle tacn and forebeacn, þæt ða beoþ on gedwolan gelædde, gyf hyt beon mæg, þe gecorene wærun.

text: Witodlīce ic hyt ēow foresǣde.
text_bare: Witodlice ic hyt eow foresæde.

text: Gyf hig ēow secgeað, Hēr hē ys on wēstene; ne fare gē ūt: gyf hig secgeað, Hēr hē is on þurhfērun; ne gelȳfe gē.
text_bare: Gyf hig eow secgeað, Her he ys on westene; ne fare ge ut: gyf hig secgeað, Her he is on þurhferun; ne gelyfe ge.

text: Witodlīce swā swā līgyt færð fram ēastdǣle and ætȳwð oþ westdǣl, swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
text_bare: Witodlice swa swa ligyt færð fram eastdæle and ætywð oþ westdæl, swa byð mannes Suna tocyme.

text: Swā hwǣr swā hold byþ, þæder bēoð earnas gegaderude.
text_bare: Swa hwær swa hold byþ, þæder beoð earnas gegaderude.

text: Sōna æfter þǣra daga gedrēfydnesse, sēo sunne byð forsworcen, and sē mōna hys lēoht ne sylð, and steorran feallaþ of þǣre heofenan, and þǣre heofenan mægenu bēoþ āstyrede:
text_bare: Sona æfter þæra daga gedrefydnesse, seo sunne byð forsworcen, and se mona hys leoht ne sylð, and steorran feallaþ of þære heofenan, and þære heofenan mægenu beoþ astyrede:

text: and þonne ætȳwð mannes Suna tācn on heofonan; and þonne wēpað ealle eorþan mǣgþa, and gesēoð mannes Sunu cumende on heofonan, genipum mid myclum mægene and mægenþrymme.
text_bare: and þonne ætywð mannes Suna tacn on heofonan; and þonne wepað ealle eorþan mægþa, and geseoð mannes Sunu cumende on heofonan, genipum mid myclum mægene and mægenþrymme.

text: And hē āsent hys englas mid bȳman and mycelre stefne, and hī gegaderigað hys gecorenan of fēower middaneardes endum, of heofona hēahnyssum oð hyra gemǣru.
text_bare: And he asent hys englas mid byman and mycelre stefne, and hi gegaderigað hys gecorenan of feower middaneardes endum, of heofona heahnyssum oð hyra gemæru.

text: Leornigeað bigspell be þām fīctrēowe: þonne hys twig byþ hnesce, and lēaf ācennede, gē witun þæt sumor ys gehende;
text_bare: Leornigeað bigspell be þam fictreowe: þonne hys twig byþ hnesce, and leaf acennede, ge witun þæt sumor ys gehende;

text: and wite gē swā, þonne gē þās þing gesēoð, þæt hē ys on durum gehende.
text_bare: and wite ge swa, þonne ge þas þing geseoð, þæt he ys on durum gehende.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow þæt ðēos cnēorys ne gewīt, ǣr þām þe ealle þās þing gewurðon.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow þæt ðeos cneorys ne gewit, ær þam þe ealle þas þing gewurðon.

text: Heofone and eorþe gewītað; witodlīce mīne word ne gewītað.
text_bare: Heofone and eorþe gewitað; witodlice mine word ne gewitað.

text: Nāt nān mann be þām dæge nē be þǣre tīde, nē furðun englas, būton Fæder āna.
text_bare: Nat nan mann be þam dæge ne be þære tide, ne furðun englas, buton Fæder ana.

text: Witodlīce swā swā on Noes dagum wæs, swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
text_bare: Witodlice swa swa on Noes dagum wæs, swa byð mannes Suna tocyme.

text: Swā hī wǣrun on þām dagum ǣr þām flōde, etende, and drincynde, and wīfigende, and gyfta syllende, oð þone dæg þe Noe on þā earce eode,
text_bare: Swa hi wærun on þam dagum ær þam flode, etende, and drincynde, and wifigende, and gyfta syllende, oð þone dæg þe Noe on þa earce eode,

text: and hī nyston ǣr þæt flōd cōm, and nam hig ealle; swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
text_bare: and hi nyston ær þæt flod com, and nam hig ealle; swa byð mannes Suna tocyme.

text: Ðonne bēoð twēgen on æcyre; ān byð genumen, and ōðer byþ lǣfyd.
text_bare: Ðonne beoð twegen on æcyre; an byð genumen, and oðer byþ læfyd.

text: Twā bēoð æt cwyrne grindende; ān byð genumen, and ōðer byþ lǣfed.
text_bare: Twa beoð æt cwyrne grindende; an byð genumen, and oðer byþ læfed.

text: Twēgen bēoþ on bedde; ān byð genumen, and ōþer byð lǣfed.
text_bare: Twegen beoþ on bedde; an byð genumen, and oþer byð læfed.

text: Wacigeað witodlīce, for þām þe gē nyton on hwylcyre tīde ēower Hlāford cuman wyle.
text_bare: Wacigeað witodlice, for þam þe ge nyton on hwylcyre tide eower Hlaford cuman wyle.

text: Witað þæt gyf sē hīredes ealdor wiste on hwylcere tīde sē þēof tōwerd wǣre, witodlīce hē wolde wacigean, and nolde geþafigan þæt man hys hūs underdulfe.
text_bare: Witað þæt gyf se hiredes ealdor wiste on hwylcere tide se þeof towerd wære, witodlice he wolde wacigean, and nolde geþafigan þæt man hys hus underdulfe.

text: And for þām bēo gē gearwe; for þām ðe mannes Sunu wyle cuman on þǣre tīde þe gē nyton.
text_bare: And for þam beo ge gearwe; for þam ðe mannes Sunu wyle cuman on þære tide þe ge nyton.

text: Wēnst þū hwā sȳ getrȳwe and glēaw þēow, þone geset hys hlāfurd ofer his hīred þæt hē him on tīde mete sylle?
text_bare: Wenst þu hwa sy getrywe and gleaw þeow, þone geset hys hlafurd ofer his hired þæt he him on tide mete sylle?

text: Ēadig ys sē þēow þe hys hlāfurd hyne gemēt þus dōndne, þonne hē cymð.
text_bare: Eadig ys se þeow þe hys hlafurd hyne gemet þus dondne, þonne he cymð.

text: Sōþ ic ēow secge þæt ofer eall þæt hē āh hē hyne gesett.
text_bare: Soþ ic eow secge þæt ofer eall þæt he ah he hyne gesett.

text: Gyf sē yfela þēowa ðencþ on hys heortan and cwyþ, Mīn hlāfurd uferað hys cyme;
text_bare: Gyf se yfela þeowa ðencþ on hys heortan and cwyþ, Min hlafurd uferað hys cyme;

text: and āgynð bēatan hys efenþēowas, and yt and drincþ mid druncenum;
text_bare: and agynð beatan hys efenþeowas, and yt and drincþ mid druncenum;

text: þonne cymþ ðæs wēales hlāford on þām dæge ðe hē nā ne wēnþ, and on ðǣre tīde þe hē nāt,
text_bare: þonne cymþ ðæs weales hlaford on þam dæge ðe he na ne wenþ, and on ðære tide þe he nat,

text: and tōdǣlþ hyne, and āsett hys dǣl mid līccetterum; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
text_bare: and todælþ hyne, and asett hys dæl mid liccetterum; þær byþ wop and toþa gristbitung.

text: Þonne byþ heofena rīce gelīc þām tȳn fǣmnum þe ðā lēohtfatu nāmon, and fērdon ongēn þone brȳdguman and þā brȳde.
text_bare: Þonne byþ heofena rice gelic þam tyn fæmnum þe ða leohtfatu namon, and ferdon ongen þone brydguman and þa bryde.

text: Hyra fīf wǣron dysige, and fīf glēawe.
text_bare: Hyra fif wæron dysige, and fif gleawe.

text: Ac þā fīf dysegan nāmon lēohtfatu, and ne nāmon nānne ele mid hym;
text_bare: Ac þa fif dysegan namon leohtfatu, and ne namon nanne ele mid hym;

text: ðā glēawan nāmon ele on hyra fatum mid þām lēohtfatum.
text_bare: ða gleawan namon ele on hyra fatum mid þam leohtfatum.

text: Ðā sē brȳdguma ylde, þā hnappudon hig ealle and slēpun.
text_bare: Ða se brydguma ylde, þa hnappudon hig ealle and slepun.

text: Witodlīce tō middyre nihte man hrȳmde and cwæþ, Nū sē brȳdguma cymð; farað him tōgēnys.
text_bare: Witodlice to middyre nihte man hrymde and cwæþ, Nu se brydguma cymð; farað him togenys.

text: Þā āryson ealle þā fǣmnan, and glengdon heora lēohtfatu.
text_bare: Þa aryson ealle þa fæmnan, and glengdon heora leohtfatu.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā dysegan tō þām wīsum, Syllaþ ūs of ēowrum ele; for þām ūre lēohtfatu synt ācwencte.
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa dysegan to þam wisum, Syllaþ us of eowrum ele; for þam ure leohtfatu synt acwencte.

text: Ðā andswarudun þā glēawan and cwǣdun, Nese, þē lǣs þe wē and gē nabbon genōh; gāþ tō þām cȳpendum, and bycgað ēow ele.
text_bare: Ða andswarudun þa gleawan and cwædun, Nese, þe læs þe we and ge nabbon genoh; gaþ to þam cypendum, and bycgað eow ele.

text: Witodlīce þā hig fērdun and woldon bycgean, þā cōm sē brȳdguma; and þā ðe gearwe wǣrun ēodun in mid him tō þām gyftum; and sēo duru wæs belocyn.
text_bare: Witodlice þa hig ferdun and woldon bycgean, þa com se brydguma; and þa ðe gearwe wærun eodun in mid him to þam gyftum; and seo duru wæs belocyn.

text: Ðā æt nēhstan cōmon þā ōðre fǣmnan, and cwǣdun, Dryhtyn, Dryhtyn, lǣt ūs in.
text_bare: Ða æt nehstan comon þa oðre fæmnan, and cwædun, Dryhtyn, Dryhtyn, læt us in.

text: Ðā andswarode hē heom and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, ne cann ic ēow.
text_bare: Ða andswarode he heom and cwæð, Soþ ic eow secge, ne cann ic eow.

text: Witodlīce waciað, for þam ðe gē nyton nē þone dæg nē þā tīde.
text_bare: Witodlice waciað, for þam ðe ge nyton ne þone dæg ne þa tide.

text: Sum mann fērde on elþēodignesse, and clypode hys þēowas, and betǣhte hym hys ǣhta.
text_bare: Sum mann ferde on elþeodignesse, and clypode hys þeowas, and betæhte hym hys æhta.

text: And ānum hē sealde fīf pund, sumum twā, sumum ān; ǣghwylcum be hys āgenum mægene; and fērde sōna.
text_bare: And anum he sealde fif pund, sumum twa, sumum an; æghwylcum be hys agenum mægene; and ferde sona.

text: Ðā fērde sē þe ðā fīf pund underfēng, and gestrȳnde ōþre fīfe.
text_bare: Ða ferde se þe ða fif pund underfeng, and gestrynde oþre fife.

text: And eal swā sē ðe þā twā underfēng gestrȳnde ōðre twā.
text_bare: And eal swa se ðe þa twa underfeng gestrynde oðre twa.

text: Witodlīce sē þe þæt ān underfēng fērde and bedēalf hyt on eorðan, and behȳdde hys hlāfurdes feoh.
text_bare: Witodlice se þe þæt an underfeng ferde and bedealf hyt on eorðan, and behydde hys hlafurdes feoh.

text: Witodlīce æfter miclum fyrste cōm þǣra þēowa hlāfurd, and dyhte hym gerād.
text_bare: Witodlice æfter miclum fyrste com þæra þeowa hlafurd, and dyhte hym gerad.

text: Ðā cōm sē þe ðā fīf pund underfēng, and brōhte ōþre fīfe, and cwæð, Hlāfurd, fīf pund þū sealdest mē; nū ic gestrȳnde ōðre fīfe.
text_bare: Ða com se þe ða fif pund underfeng, and brohte oþre fife, and cwæð, Hlafurd, fif pund þu sealdest me; nu ic gestrynde oðre fife.

text: Ðā cwæþ hys hlāford tō hym, Bēo blīþe, þū gōda þēow and getrȳwa; for þām ðe þū wǣre getrȳwe ofer lȳtle þing, ic gesette þē ofer mycle; gā intō þīnes hlāfordes blisse.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ hys hlaford to hym, Beo bliþe, þu goda þeow and getrywa; for þam ðe þu wære getrywe ofer lytle þing, ic gesette þe ofer mycle; ga into þines hlafordes blisse.

text: Þā cōm sē þe þā twā pund underfēng, and cwæð, Hlāford, twā pund þū mē sealdest; nū ic hæbbe gestrȳnyd ōðre twā.
text_bare: Þa com se þe þa twa pund underfeng, and cwæð, Hlaford, twa pund þu me sealdest; nu ic hæbbe gestrynyd oðre twa.

text: Ðā cwæð hys hlāford tō hym, Geblissa, þū gōda þēowa and getrȳwa; for þām ðe þū wǣre getrȳwe ofer fēawa, ofer fela ic ðē gesette; gā on þīnes hlāfordes gefēan.
text_bare: Ða cwæð hys hlaford to hym, Geblissa, þu goda þeowa and getrywa; for þam ðe þu wære getrywe ofer feawa, ofer fela ic ðe gesette; ga on þines hlafordes gefean.

text: Ðā cōm sē þe þæt ān pund underfēng, and cwæð, Hlāford, ic wāt þæt ðū eart heard mann; þū rīpst þǣr ðū ne sēowe, and gaderast þǣr ðū ne sprengdest:
text_bare: Ða com se þe þæt an pund underfeng, and cwæð, Hlaford, ic wat þæt ðu eart heard mann; þu ripst þær ðu ne seowe, and gaderast þær ðu ne sprengdest:

text: and ic fērde ofdrǣd, and behȳdde þīn pund on eorþan; hēr þū hæfst þæt ðīn ys.
text_bare: and ic ferde ofdræd, and behydde þin pund on eorþan; her þu hæfst þæt ðin ys.

text: Ðā andswarode hys hlāford him and cwæþ, Þū yfela ðēow and slāwa, ðū wistest þæt ic rȳpe þǣr ic ne sāwe, and ic gaderige þǣr ic ne strēdde;
text_bare: Ða andswarode hys hlaford him and cwæþ, Þu yfela ðeow and slawa, ðu wistest þæt ic rype þær ic ne sawe, and ic gaderige þær ic ne stredde;

text: hyt gebyrede þæt þū befæstest mīn feoh mynyterum; and ic nāme, þænne ic cōme, þæt mīn ys mid þām gafole.
text_bare: hyt gebyrede þæt þu befæstest min feoh mynyterum; and ic name, þænne ic come, þæt min ys mid þam gafole.

text: Ānymaþ þæt pund æt hym, and syllað þām þe mē ðā tȳn pund brōhte.
text_bare: Anymaþ þæt pund æt hym, and syllað þam þe me ða tyn pund brohte.

text: Witodlīce ǣlcon þǣra þe hæfð man sylþ, and hē hæfð genōh; ðām þe næfð, þæt hym þincð þæt hē hæbbe, þæt hym byð ætbrōdyn.
text_bare: Witodlice ælcon þæra þe hæfð man sylþ, and he hæfð genoh; ðam þe næfð, þæt hym þincð þæt he hæbbe, þæt hym byð ætbrodyn.

text: And wurpað þone unnyttan þēowan on þā ūttran þȳstru; þǣr byð wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
text_bare: And wurpað þone unnyttan þeowan on þa uttran þystru; þær byð wop and toþa gristbitung.

text: Witudlīce þonne mannes Sunu cymð on hys mægenþrymme, and ealle englas mid him, þonne sitt hē ofer hys mægenþrymmes setl.
text_bare: Witudlice þonne mannes Sunu cymð on hys mægenþrymme, and ealle englas mid him, þonne sitt he ofer hys mægenþrymmes setl.

text: And ealle þēoda bēoþ tōforan hym gegaderude; and hē āsyndrað hī hym betwȳnan, swā swā sē hyrde āsyndraþ ðā scēp fram tyccenum;
text_bare: And ealle þeoda beoþ toforan hym gegaderude; and he asyndrað hi hym betwynan, swa swa se hyrde asyndraþ ða scep fram tyccenum;

text: and hē gesett þā scēp on hys swīðran healfe, and þā tyccenu on hys wynsteran healfe.
text_bare: and he gesett þa scep on hys swiðran healfe, and þa tyccenu on hys wynsteran healfe.

text: Ðonne cwið sē Cyning tō ðām þe on his swīðran healfe bēoð, Cumað gē geblētsode mīnes Fæder, and onfōð þæt rīce þæt ēow gegearwod ys of middaneardes frymþe.
text_bare: Ðonne cwið se Cyning to ðam þe on his swiðran healfe beoð, Cumað ge gebletsode mines Fæder, and onfoð þæt rice þæt eow gegearwod ys of middaneardes frymþe.

text: Mē hingrode, and gē mē sealdon etan; mē þyrste, and gē mē sealdun drincan; ic wæs cuma, and gē mē in laþodon;
text_bare: Me hingrode, and ge me sealdon etan; me þyrste, and ge me sealdun drincan; ic wæs cuma, and ge me in laþodon;

text: ic wæs nacud, and gē mē scrȳddon; ic wæs untrum, and gē ēodun tō mē; ic wæs on cwearterne, and gē cōmon tō mē.
text_bare: ic wæs nacud, and ge me scryddon; ic wæs untrum, and ge eodun to me; ic wæs on cwearterne, and ge comon to me.

text: Þonne andswariað þā rihtwīsan and cweþað, Drihten, hwænne gesāwe wē ðē hingrigendne, and wē ðē fēddon?
text_bare: Þonne andswariað þa rihtwisan and cweþað, Drihten, hwænne gesawe we ðe hingrigendne, and we ðe feddon?

text: þyrstendne, and wē ðē drinc sealdon?
text_bare: þyrstendne, and we ðe drinc sealdon?

text: Hwænne gesāwe wē þæt ðū cuma wǣre, and þē in laþodon?
text_bare: Hwænne gesawe we þæt ðu cuma wære, and þe in laþodon?

text: oððe nacodne, and wē þē scrȳddon?
text_bare: oððe nacodne, and we þe scryddon?

text: oððe hwænne gesāwon wē ðē untrumne, oððe on cwearterne, and cōmon tō þē?
text_bare: oððe hwænne gesawon we ðe untrumne, oððe on cwearterne, and comon to þe?

text: Ðonne andswarað sē Cyning hym and cwyþ tō heom, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Swā lange swā gē dydon ānum of ðysum mīnum lǣstum gebrōðrum, swā lange gē hyt dydon mē.
text_bare: Ðonne andswarað se Cyning hym and cwyþ to heom, Soþ ic eow secge, Swa lange swa ge dydon anum of ðysum minum læstum gebroðrum, swa lange ge hyt dydon me.

text: Þonne segþ hē þām þe bēoð on hys wynstran healfe, Gewītað, āwyrgyde, fram mē on þæt ēce fȳr þe ys dēofle and hys englum gegearwud.
text_bare: Þonne segþ he þam þe beoð on hys wynstran healfe, Gewitað, awyrgyde, fram me on þæt ece fyr þe ys deofle and hys englum gegearwud.

text: Witodlīce mē hingryde, and gē ne sealdon mē etan; mē þyrste, and gē mē drincan ne sealdun;
text_bare: Witodlice me hingryde, and ge ne sealdon me etan; me þyrste, and ge me drincan ne sealdun;

text: ic wæs cuma, and gē mē in ne gelaþodun; ic wæs nacod, and gē ne scrȳddon mē; ic wæs untrum and on cwearterne, and gē ne cōmon æt mē.
text_bare: ic wæs cuma, and ge me in ne gelaþodun; ic wæs nacod, and ge ne scryddon me; ic wæs untrum and on cwearterne, and ge ne comon æt me.

text: Ðonne andswarigeaþ hym þā and cweðaþ, Dryhtyn, hwænne gesāwe wē þē hingrigendne, oððe þyrstendne, oðþe cuman, oððe untrumne, oþþe on cwearterne, and wē ne þēnedon þē?
text_bare: Ðonne andswarigeaþ hym þa and cweðaþ, Dryhtyn, hwænne gesawe we þe hingrigendne, oððe þyrstendne, oðþe cuman, oððe untrumne, oþþe on cwearterne, and we ne þenedon þe?

text: Þonne andswarað sē Cyning heom and cwyð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Swā lange swā gē ne dydon ānum of þysum lǣstum, ne dyde gē hyt mē.
text_bare: Þonne andswarað se Cyning heom and cwyð, Soþ ic eow secge, Swa lange swa ge ne dydon anum of þysum læstum, ne dyde ge hyt me.

text: And þonne farað hig on ēce sūsle; and þā rihtwīsan on þæt ēce līf.
text_bare: And þonne farað hig on ece susle; and þa rihtwisan on þæt ece lif.

text: Witodlīce þā sē Hǣlend hæfde ealle þās sprǣca geendud, þā cwæð hē tō hys leorningcnihtum,
text_bare: Witodlice þa se Hælend hæfde ealle þas spræca geendud, þa cwæð he to hys leorningcnihtum,

text: Wite gē þæt æfter twām dagum bēoð ēastro, and mannes Bearn byþ geseald þæt hē sī on rōde āhangen.
text_bare: Wite ge þæt æfter twam dagum beoð eastro, and mannes Bearn byþ geseald þæt he si on rode ahangen.

text: Ðā wǣron gesamnode þā ealdras þǣra sācerda, and hlāfordas þæs folces, to ðǣra sācerda ealdres botle þe wæs genemned Kaiphas;
text_bare: Ða wæron gesamnode þa ealdras þæra sacerda, and hlafordas þæs folces, to ðæra sacerda ealdres botle þe wæs genemned Kaiphas;

text: and hig hæfdon mycel gemōt þæt hig woldon þone Hǣlend mid fācne besyrwan, and ofslēan.
text_bare: and hig hæfdon mycel gemot þæt hig woldon þone Hælend mid facne besyrwan, and ofslean.

text: Hig cwǣdon witodlīce sume þæt hyt ne mihte bēon on þām frēolsdæge, þē lǣs tō mycel styrung wurde on þām folce.
text_bare: Hig cwædon witodlice sume þæt hyt ne mihte beon on þam freolsdæge, þe læs to mycel styrung wurde on þam folce.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlynd wæs on Bethania, on Symones hūse þæs hrēoflan,
text_bare: Ða se Hælynd wæs on Bethania, on Symones huse þæs hreoflan,

text: ðā genēalǣhte him tō sum wīf, sēo hæfde box mid dēorwyrðre sealfe, and āgēat uppan hys hēafud þǣr hē sæt.
text_bare: ða genealæhte him to sum wif, seo hæfde box mid deorwyrðre sealfe, and ageat uppan hys heafud þær he sæt.

text: Þā gesāwun hys leorningcnihtas þæt, and wurdon gebolgene, and cwǣdon, Tō hwan ys þiss forspilled?
text_bare: Þa gesawun hys leorningcnihtas þæt, and wurdon gebolgene, and cwædon, To hwan ys þiss forspilled?

text: Þis mihte bēon geseald tō myclum wurþe, and þearfum gedǣled.
text_bare: Þis mihte beon geseald to myclum wurþe, and þearfum gedæled.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend hyt wiste, þā cwæð hē tō heom, Hwī synt gē grame þysum wīfe?
text_bare: Þa se Hælend hyt wiste, þa cwæð he to heom, Hwi synt ge grame þysum wife?

text: witodlīce gōd weorc hēo worhte on me.
text_bare: witodlice god weorc heo worhte on me.

text: Symle gē habbað þearfan mid ēow; ac gē nabbað mē symle.
text_bare: Symle ge habbað þearfan mid eow; ac ge nabbað me symle.

text: Hēo dyde þās sealfe on mīnne līchaman þæt ic wǣre gesmyryd tō bebyrgynne.
text_bare: Heo dyde þas sealfe on minne lichaman þæt ic wære gesmyryd to bebyrgynne.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Swa hwǣr swā þys godspel byð gebodud on eallum middanearde, byð gesǣd on hyre gemynd þæt hēo ðiss dyde.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Swa hwær swa þys godspel byð gebodud on eallum middanearde, byð gesæd on hyre gemynd þæt heo ðiss dyde.

text: Ðā fērde ān of þām twelfum, þe wæs genemned Iudas, sē wiþersaca, tō þǣra sācerda ealdrum,
text_bare: Ða ferde an of þam twelfum, þe wæs genemned Iudas, se wiþersaca, to þæra sacerda ealdrum,

text: and cwæð tō heom, Hwæt wylle gē mē syllan, and ic hyne belǣwe ēow?
text_bare: and cwæð to heom, Hwæt wylle ge me syllan, and ic hyne belæwe eow?

text: Ðā behēton hig hym þrītig scyllinga.
text_bare: Ða beheton hig hym þritig scyllinga.

text: And syþþan hē smēade geornlīce þæt hē hyne wolde belǣwan.
text_bare: And syþþan he smeade geornlice þæt he hyne wolde belæwan.

text: Þā on þām forman gearcungdæge genēalǣhton ðā leorningcnihtas tō þām Hǣlende, and þus cwǣdon, Hwǣr wylt ðū þæt wē gegearwion þē þīne ðēnunga tō ēastron?
text_bare: Þa on þam forman gearcungdæge genealæhton ða leorningcnihtas to þam Hælende, and þus cwædon, Hwær wylt ðu þæt we gegearwion þe þine ðenunga to eastron?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlynd, Farað on þās ceastre tō sumum menn, and secgeað him, Sē Lārēow segð, Mīn tīma ys gehende þæt ic mid þē wyrce mīne ēastro mid mīnum leorningcnihtum.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælynd, Farað on þas ceastre to sumum menn, and secgeað him, Se Lareow segð, Min tima ys gehende þæt ic mid þe wyrce mine eastro mid minum leorningcnihtum.

text: And þā leorningcnihtas dydon swā sē Hǣlynd heom bebēad; and hig gegearwodon him ēasterþēnunga.
text_bare: And þa leorningcnihtas dydon swa se Hælynd heom bebead; and hig gegearwodon him easterþenunga.

text: On þām ǣfene sæt sē Hǣlynd mid hys twelf leorningcnihtum æt gereorde.
text_bare: On þam æfene sæt se Hælynd mid hys twelf leorningcnihtum æt gereorde.

text: And þā hī ǣtun, hē cwæð tō him, Witodlīce ic secge ēow þæt ān ēower belǣwð mē.
text_bare: And þa hi ætun, he cwæð to him, Witodlice ic secge eow þæt an eower belæwð me.

text: Ðā wurdon hig swīþe geunrōtsode, and ongann ānra gehwylc cweðan, Drihtyn, cwyst þū eom ic hyt?
text_bare: Ða wurdon hig swiþe geunrotsode, and ongann anra gehwylc cweðan, Drihtyn, cwyst þu eom ic hyt?

text: And hē andswarode and þus cwæð, Sē þe bedȳpð on disce mid mē hys hand sē mē belǣwð.
text_bare: And he andswarode and þus cwæð, Se þe bedypð on disce mid me hys hand se me belæwð.

text: Witodlīce mannes Sunu færþ, swā hit āwriten ys be him; wā þām menn þurh þone þe byþ mannes Sunu belǣwed!
text_bare: Witodlice mannes Sunu færþ, swa hit awriten ys be him; wa þam menn þurh þone þe byþ mannes Sunu belæwed!

text: betere wǣre þām menn þæt hē nǣfre nǣre ācenned.
text_bare: betere wære þam menn þæt he næfre nære acenned.

text: Þā cwæð Iudas þe hyne belǣwde, Cwyst þū, Lārēow, hwæðer ic hyt sī?
text_bare: Þa cwæð Iudas þe hyne belæwde, Cwyst þu, Lareow, hwæðer ic hyt si?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Þū hyt sǣdest.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Þu hyt sædest.

text: Witodlīce þā hig ǣtun, sē Hǣlend nam hlāf, and hyne geblētsode, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and cwæð, Onfōþ, and etað; þis ys mīn līchama.
text_bare: Witodlice þa hig ætun, se Hælend nam hlaf, and hyne gebletsode, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and cwæð, Onfoþ, and etað; þis ys min lichama.

text: And hē genam þone calic, þanciende, and sealde hym, þus cweþende, Drincað ealle of þisum;
text_bare: And he genam þone calic, þanciende, and sealde hym, þus cweþende, Drincað ealle of þisum;

text: þis is witodlīce mīnes blōdes calic nīwre ǣ, þæt byð for manegum āgoten on synna forgyfenysse.
text_bare: þis is witodlice mines blodes calic niwre æ, þæt byð for manegum agoten on synna forgyfenysse.

text: Witodlīce ic secge ēow þæt ic ne drince heonun forð of þysum eorðlīcan wīne, ǣr þām dǣge þe ic drince þæt nīwe mid ēow on mīnes Fæder rīce.
text_bare: Witodlice ic secge eow þæt ic ne drince heonun forð of þysum eorðlican wine, ær þam dæge þe ic drince þæt niwe mid eow on mines Fæder rice.

text: Ðā hig hæfdon heora lofsang gesungene, þā fērdon hig uppan Oliuetes dūne.
text_bare: Ða hig hæfdon heora lofsang gesungene, þa ferdon hig uppan Oliuetes dune.

text: Ðā sǣde sē Hǣlend heom, Ealle gē wurþað geuntrēowsode on mē on þysse nihte: hyt ys āwriten, Þurh þæs hyrdes slege byð sēo heord tōdrǣfed.
text_bare: Ða sæde se Hælend heom, Ealle ge wurþað geuntreowsode on me on þysse nihte: hyt ys awriten, Þurh þæs hyrdes slege byð seo heord todræfed.

text: Witodlīce æfter þām þe ic of dēaþe ārīse, ic cume tō ēow on Galilea.
text_bare: Witodlice æfter þam þe ic of deaþe arise, ic cume to eow on Galilea.

text: Ðā andwyrde Petrus him and þus cwæð, Ðēah þe hig ealle geuntrēowsion on þē, ic nǣfre ne geuntrēowsige.
text_bare: Ða andwyrde Petrus him and þus cwæð, Ðeah þe hig ealle geuntreowsion on þe, ic næfre ne geuntreowsige.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Sōþ ic secge þē þæt on þissere nihte, ǣr þām þe cocc crāwe þrīwa, þū wiðsæcst mīn.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Soþ ic secge þe þæt on þissere nihte, ær þam þe cocc crawe þriwa, þu wiðsæcst min.

text: Ðā sǣde Petrus him, Witudlīce þēah þe ic scyle sweltan mid þē, ne wiþsace ic þīn.
text_bare: Ða sæde Petrus him, Witudlice þeah þe ic scyle sweltan mid þe, ne wiþsace ic þin.

text: Gelīce þām cwǣdon ealle ðā ōþre leorningcnihtas.
text_bare: Gelice þam cwædon ealle ða oþre leorningcnihtas.

text: Ðā cōm sē Hǣlynd mid him on þone tūn þe is genemned Gezemani, and sǣde hys leorningcnihtum, Sittað hēr, oð þæt ic gā hider geond and mē gebidde.
text_bare: Ða com se Hælynd mid him on þone tun þe is genemned Gezemani, and sæde hys leorningcnihtum, Sittað her, oð þæt ic ga hider geond and me gebidde.

text: And hē genam Petrum and Zebedeus twēgen suna, and ongann unrōtsian and bēon unrōt.
text_bare: And he genam Petrum and Zebedeus twegen suna, and ongann unrotsian and beon unrot.

text: Ðā sǣde sē Hǣlynd heom, Unrōt ys mīn sāwl oþ dēað; gebīdað hēr, and waciað mid mē.
text_bare: Ða sæde se Hælynd heom, Unrot ys min sawl oþ deað; gebidað her, and waciað mid me.

text: And þā hē wæs lȳthwōn þanon āgān, hē āfēoll on hys ansȳne, and hyne gebæd and þus cwæð, Fæder mīn, gyf hyt bēon mæge, gewīte þēs calic fram mē; þēah hwæþere nā swā swā ic wylle, ac swā swā þū wylt.
text_bare: And þa he wæs lythwon þanon agan, he afeoll on hys ansyne, and hyne gebæd and þus cwæð, Fæder min, gyf hyt beon mæge, gewite þes calic fram me; þeah hwæþere na swa swa ic wylle, ac swa swa þu wylt.

text: And hē cōm tō hys leorningcnihtum, and hē gemētte hig slǣpende; and hē sǣde Petre, Swā, ne mihton gē nū wacian āne tīd mid mē?
text_bare: And he com to hys leorningcnihtum, and he gemette hig slæpende; and he sæde Petre, Swa, ne mihton ge nu wacian ane tid mid me?

text: Waciaþ and gebiddað ēow þæt gē in ne gān on costunge; witudlīce sē gāst is hræd, and þæt flǣsc ys untrum.
text_bare: Waciaþ and gebiddað eow þæt ge in ne gan on costunge; witudlice se gast is hræd, and þæt flæsc ys untrum.

text: Eft ōþre sīðe hē fērde, and hyne gebæd and cwæþ, Mīn Fæder, gyf þēs calic ne mæge gewītan būton ic hyne drince, gewurþe þīn willa.
text_bare: Eft oþre siðe he ferde, and hyne gebæd and cwæþ, Min Fæder, gyf þes calic ne mæge gewitan buton ic hyne drince, gewurþe þin willa.

text: And hē cōm eft, and gemētte hig slǣpende; sōðlīce heora ēagan wǣron gehefegode.
text_bare: And he com eft, and gemette hig slæpende; soðlice heora eagan wæron gehefegode.

text: And hē forlēt hig eft and fērde, and hyne gebæd þryddan sīðe, cweþende þæt ylce gebed.
text_bare: And he forlet hig eft and ferde, and hyne gebæd þryddan siðe, cweþende þæt ylce gebed.

text: Þā cōm hē tō hys leorningcnihtum, and sǣde heom, Slāpað eallunga, and restað ēow; nū genēalǣcþ sēo tīd, and mannes Sunu byð geseald on synfulra hand.
text_bare: Þa com he to hys leorningcnihtum, and sæde heom, Slapað eallunga, and restað eow; nu genealæcþ seo tid, and mannes Sunu byð geseald on synfulra hand.

text: Ārīsað, uton faran; nū genēalǣcð sē þe mē belǣwð.
text_bare: Arisað, uton faran; nu genealæcð se þe me belæwð.

text: Ðā hē þās þing spræc, þā cōm Iudas, ān of þām twelfum, and micel folc mid hym mid swurdum and sāhlum, āsende fram þǣra sācerda ealdrum and þæs folces ealdrum.
text_bare: Ða he þas þing spræc, þa com Iudas, an of þam twelfum, and micel folc mid hym mid swurdum and sahlum, asende fram þæra sacerda ealdrum and þæs folces ealdrum.

text: Sē þe hyne belǣwde sealde heom tācn and cwæð, Swā hwæne swā ic cysse, sē hyt is; nimaþ hyne.
text_bare: Se þe hyne belæwde sealde heom tacn and cwæð, Swa hwæne swa ic cysse, se hyt is; nimaþ hyne.

text: And hē genēalǣhte hrædlīce tō þām Hǣlende, and cwæð, Hāl bēo þū, Lārēow; and he cyste hyne.
text_bare: And he genealæhte hrædlice to þam Hælende, and cwæð, Hal beo þu, Lareow; and he cyste hyne.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ēalā frēond, tō hwan becōm þū?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Eala freond, to hwan becom þu?

text: Ðā genēalǣhton hig, and þone Hǣlend genāmon.
text_bare: Ða genealæhton hig, and þone Hælend genamon.

text: Witudlīce ān þǣra þe mid þām Hǣlende wæs ābrǣd hys swurd, and āslōh of ānys þǣra sācerda ealdres þēowan ēare.
text_bare: Witudlice an þæra þe mid þam Hælende wæs abræd hys swurd, and asloh of anys þæra sacerda ealdres þeowan eare.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hælend tō hym, Dō þīn swurd on hys scǣþe; witodlīce ealle þā ðe swurd nymað, mid swurde hig forwurþað.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to hym, Do þin swurd on hys scæþe; witodlice ealle þa ðe swurd nymað, mid swurde hig forwurþað.

text: Wēnst þū þæt ic ne myhte biddan mīnne Fæder þæt hē sende mē nū mā þonne twelf ēorydu engla?
text_bare: Wenst þu þæt ic ne myhte biddan minne Fæder þæt he sende me nu ma þonne twelf eorydu engla?

text: Hū magon bēon gefyllede þā hālgan gewritu þe be mē āwritene synt, for þām þus hyt gebyrað tō bēonne?
text_bare: Hu magon beon gefyllede þa halgan gewritu þe be me awritene synt, for þam þus hyt gebyrað to beonne?

text: On þǣre tīde cwæð sē Hǣlend tō þām folce, Eall swā tō þēofe gē synt cumene mid swurdum and mid sāhlum mē tō nymenne; dæghwāmlīce ic sæt mid ēow on þām temple and lǣrde ēow, and gē mē ne nāmon.
text_bare: On þære tide cwæð se Hælend to þam folce, Eall swa to þeofe ge synt cumene mid swurdum and mid sahlum me to nymenne; dæghwamlice ic sæt mid eow on þam temple and lærde eow, and ge me ne namon.

text: Ðis eall ys geworden þæt ðǣra wītegena hālgan gewritu sȳn gefyllede.
text_bare: Ðis eall ys geworden þæt ðæra witegena halgan gewritu syn gefyllede.

text: Þā flugon ealle þā leorningcnihtas, and forlēton hyne.
text_bare: Þa flugon ealle þa leorningcnihtas, and forleton hyne.

text: And hig genāmon þone Hǣlend, and lǣddon hyne tō Caiphan þǣra sācerda ealdre þǣr ðā bōceras and þā ealdras gesamnod wǣron.
text_bare: And hig genamon þone Hælend, and læddon hyne to Caiphan þæra sacerda ealdre þær ða boceras and þa ealdras gesamnod wæron.

text: Petrus hym fylide feorrane oð hē cōm tō þǣra sācerda ealdres botle; and hē in ēode, and sæt mid þām þēnum þæt hē gesāwe þone ende.
text_bare: Petrus hym fylide feorrane oð he com to þæra sacerda ealdres botle; and he in eode, and sæt mid þam þenum þæt he gesawe þone ende.

text: Witodlīce þǣra sācerda ealdras and eall þæt gemōt sōhton lēase saga ongēn þone Hǣlend ðæt hig hyne tō dēaþe sealdon;
text_bare: Witodlice þæra sacerda ealdras and eall þæt gemot sohton lease saga ongen þone Hælend ðæt hig hyne to deaþe sealdon;

text: and hig ne mihton nāne findan.
text_bare: and hig ne mihton nane findan.

text: Ðā þā manega mid lēasum onsagum genēalǣhton, þā æt nēhstan cōmon twēgen þǣra lēogera, and cwǣdon,
text_bare: Ða þa manega mid leasum onsagum genealæhton, þa æt nehstan comon twegen þæra leogera, and cwædon,

text: Ðēs sǣde, Ic mæg tōwurpan Godes templ, and æfter þrȳm dagum hyt eft getimbrigean.
text_bare: Ðes sæde, Ic mæg towurpan Godes templ, and æfter þrym dagum hyt eft getimbrigean.

text: Ðā ārās ealdor þǣra sācerda, and cwæð, Ne andwyrtst þū nan þing ongēn þā ðe þiss ðē onsecgeað?
text_bare: Ða aras ealdor þæra sacerda, and cwæð, Ne andwyrtst þu nan þing ongen þa ðe þiss ðe onsecgeað?

text: Sē Hǣlend suwode.
text_bare: Se Hælend suwode.

text: Þā sē ealdor þǣra sācerda cwæð, Ic hālsige þē ðurh þone lyfiendan God þæt ðū secge ūs gyf þū sȳ Crīst, Godes Sunu.
text_bare: Þa se ealdor þæra sacerda cwæð, Ic halsige þe ðurh þone lyfiendan God þæt ðu secge us gyf þu sy Crist, Godes Sunu.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlynd him tō, Þæt ðū sǣdest.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælynd him to, Þæt ðu sædest.

text: Sōð ic ēow secge, Æfter þyson gē gesēoð mannes Bearn sittende on þā swīðran healfe Godes mægenþrymmes, and cumendne on heofones wolcnum.
text_bare: Soð ic eow secge, Æfter þyson ge geseoð mannes Bearn sittende on þa swiðran healfe Godes mægenþrymmes, and cumendne on heofones wolcnum.

text: Ðā þǣra sācerda ealdor slāt hys āgyn rēaf, and cwæð, Þis ys bysmorsprǣc; tō hwī wilnige wē ǣnigre ōþre sage?
text_bare: Ða þæra sacerda ealdor slat hys agyn reaf, and cwæð, Þis ys bysmorspræc; to hwi wilnige we ænigre oþre sage?

text: nū gē gehȳrdon of hym gyltlīce sprǣce;
text_bare: nu ge gehyrdon of hym gyltlice spræce;

text: hwæt ys ēow nū geþūht?
text_bare: hwæt ys eow nu geþuht?

text: Hig andwyrdon ealle and cwǣdon, Hē is dēaþes scyldig.
text_bare: Hig andwyrdon ealle and cwædon, He is deaþes scyldig.

text: Þā spǣtton hig on hys ansȳne, and bēoton hyne mid heora fȳstum; sume hyne slōgon on his ansȳne mid hyra brādum handum,
text_bare: Þa spætton hig on hys ansyne, and beoton hyne mid heora fystum; sume hyne slogon on his ansyne mid hyra bradum handum,

text: and cwǣdon, Sege ūs, Crīst, hwæt is sē þe ðē slōh
text_bare: and cwædon, Sege us, Crist, hwæt is se þe ðe sloh

text: Petrus sōðlīce sǣt ūte on þām cafertūne; þā cōm tō hym ān þēowyn, and cwæð, And þū wǣre mid þām Galileiscean Hǣlynde.
text_bare: Petrus soðlice sæt ute on þam cafertune; þa com to hym an þeowyn, and cwæð, And þu wære mid þam Galileiscean Hælynde.

text: And hē wiðsōc beforan eallum and cwæð, Nāt ic hwæt þū segst.
text_bare: And he wiðsoc beforan eallum and cwæð, Nat ic hwæt þu segst.

text: Ðā hē ūt ēode of þǣre dura, ðā geseah hyne ōþer wȳln, and sǣde þām ðe þǣr wǣron, And þēs wæs mid þām Nazareniscean Hǣlende.
text_bare: Ða he ut eode of þære dura, ða geseah hyne oþer wyln, and sæde þam ðe þær wæron, And þes wæs mid þam Nazareniscean Hælende.

text: And hē wiðsōc eft mid āþe þæt hē hys nān þing ne cūðe.
text_bare: And he wiðsoc eft mid aþe þæt he hys nan þing ne cuðe.

text: Ðā æfter lȳtlum fyrste genēalǣhton þā ðe þǣr stōdun, and cwǣdon to Petre, Sōþlīce þū eart of hym, and þīn sprǣc þē geswutelað.
text_bare: Ða æfter lytlum fyrste genealæhton þa ðe þær stodun, and cwædon to Petre, Soþlice þu eart of hym, and þin spræc þe geswutelað.

text: Ðā ætsōc hē and swerede þæt hē nǣfre þone man ne cūþe.
text_bare: Ða ætsoc he and swerede þæt he næfre þone man ne cuþe.

text: And hrædlīce þā crēow sē cocc.
text_bare: And hrædlice þa creow se cocc.

text: Þā gemunde Petrus þæs Hǣlendes word þe hē cwæð, Ǣr ðām þe sē cocc crāwe, þrīwa ðū mē widsæcst.
text_bare: Þa gemunde Petrus þæs Hælendes word þe he cwæð, Ær ðam þe se cocc crawe, þriwa ðu me widsæcst.

text: And hē ēode ūt, and wēop bityrlīce.
text_bare: And he eode ut, and weop bityrlice.

text: Witodlīce þā hyt morgen wæs, ðā worhton ealle þǣra sācerda ealdras gemōt and þæs folces ealdras ongēn þone Hǣlend þæt hig hyne dēaþe belǣwdon;
text_bare: Witodlice þa hyt morgen wæs, ða worhton ealle þæra sacerda ealdras gemot and þæs folces ealdras ongen þone Hælend þæt hig hyne deaþe belæwdon;

text: and hig lǣddon hyne gebundenne, and sealdon hyne þām Pontiscean Pilate þām dēman.
text_bare: and hig læddon hyne gebundenne, and sealdon hyne þam Pontiscean Pilate þam deman.

text: Ðā geseah Iudas þe hyne belǣwde þæt hē fordēmed wæs, þā ongann hē hrēowsian, and brōhte þā þrīttig scyllingas tō þǣra sācerda ealdrum, and cwæð,
text_bare: Ða geseah Iudas þe hyne belæwde þæt he fordemed wæs, þa ongann he hreowsian, and brohte þa þrittig scyllingas to þæra sacerda ealdrum, and cwæð,

text: Ic syngode, þā ic sealde þæt rihtwīse blōd.
text_bare: Ic syngode, þa ic sealde þæt rihtwise blod.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Hwæt spycst þū þæt tō ūs?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Hwæt spycst þu þæt to us?

text: And hē āwearp þā scyllingas in on þæt templ, and fērde and mid grȳne hyne sylfne āhēng.
text_bare: And he awearp þa scyllingas in on þæt templ, and ferde and mid gryne hyne sylfne aheng.

text: Ðā sōðlīce þǣra sācerda ealdras onfēngon þæs seolfres, and cwǣdon, Nys hyt nā ālȳfed þæt wē āsendon hyt on ūre maðmcyste, for þām hyt is blōdes wurð.
text_bare: Ða soðlice þæra sacerda ealdras onfengon þæs seolfres, and cwædon, Nys hyt na alyfed þæt we asendon hyt on ure maðmcyste, for þam hyt is blodes wurð.

text: Hig worhton þā gemōt, and smēadon hū hig sceoldon þæs Hǣlendes wurð ātēon; þā gebohton hig ǣnne æcyr mid þām fēo tigylwyrhtena on tō bebyrgenne elþēodisce menn.
text_bare: Hig worhton þa gemot, and smeadon hu hig sceoldon þæs Hælendes wurð ateon; þa gebohton hig ænne æcyr mid þam feo tigylwyrhtena on to bebyrgenne elþeodisce menn.

text: For þām is sē æcer gehāten Acheldemagh, þæt is on ūre geþēode, blōdes æcyr; and swā hē is gehāten oð þisne dæg.
text_bare: For þam is se æcer gehaten Acheldemagh, þæt is on ure geþeode, blodes æcyr; and swa he is gehaten oð þisne dæg.

text: Ðā wæs gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Hieremiam þone wītegan, þus cweþende, And þā hig onfēngon þrīttig scyllinga, þæs gebohtan wurð þone ðe wæs ǣr gewurþod fram Israhela bearnum;
text_bare: Ða wæs gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Hieremiam þone witegan, þus cweþende, And þa hig onfengon þrittig scyllinga, þæs gebohtan wurð þone ðe wæs ær gewurþod fram Israhela bearnum;

text: and hig sealdon þæt on tigelwyrhtena æcyr, swā swā Drihten mē gesette.
text_bare: and hig sealdon þæt on tigelwyrhtena æcyr, swa swa Drihten me gesette.

text: Þā stōd sē Hǣlend beforan þām dēman, and sē dēma hyne āxode þus cweðende, Eart þū Iudea Cyning?
text_bare: Þa stod se Hælend beforan þam deman, and se dema hyne axode þus cweðende, Eart þu Iudea Cyning?

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Þæt ðū segst.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Þæt ðu segst.

text: And mid þȳ ðe hyne wrēgdon þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā hlāfordas, nān þing hē ne andswarode.
text_bare: And mid þy ðe hyne wregdon þæra sacerda ealdras and þa hlafordas, nan þing he ne andswarode.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Ne gehȳrst þū hū fela sagena hig ongēn þē secgeað?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus to him, Ne gehyrst þu hu fela sagena hig ongen þe secgeað?

text: And hē nē andwyrde mid nānum worde; swā þæt sē dēma wundrode swīþlīce.
text_bare: And he ne andwyrde mid nanum worde; swa þæt se dema wundrode swiþlice.

text: Hig hæfdon heom tō gewunan tō heora symbeldæge þæt sē dēma sceolde forgyfan þām folce ǣnne forwyrhtne mann, swylcne hig habban woldon.
text_bare: Hig hæfdon heom to gewunan to heora symbeldæge þæt se dema sceolde forgyfan þam folce ænne forwyrhtne mann, swylcne hig habban woldon.

text: Hē hæfde þā sōðlīce ǣnne strangne þēofmann gehæftne, sē wæs genemned Barrabbas.
text_bare: He hæfde þa soðlice ænne strangne þeofmann gehæftne, se wæs genemned Barrabbas.

text: Þā þæt folc gesamnod wæs, þā cwæð Pilatus, Hwæþer wylle gē þæt ic ēow āgyfe?
text_bare: Þa þæt folc gesamnod wæs, þa cwæð Pilatus, Hwæþer wylle ge þæt ic eow agyfe?

text: þe Barrabban, ðe þone Hǣlynd ðe is Crīst gehāten?
text_bare: þe Barrabban, ðe þone Hælynd ðe is Crist gehaten?

text: Hē wiste sōðlīce þæt hig hyne for andan him sealdon.
text_bare: He wiste soðlice þæt hig hyne for andan him sealdon.

text: Hē sæt þā Pilatus on his dōmsetle; þā sende his wīf tō hym, and cwæð, Ne bēo þē nān þing gemǣne ongēn þisne rihtwīsan; sōðlīce fela ic hæbbe geþolod tō dæg þurh gesyhðe for hym.
text_bare: He sæt þa Pilatus on his domsetle; þa sende his wif to hym, and cwæð, Ne beo þe nan þing gemæne ongen þisne rihtwisan; soðlice fela ic hæbbe geþolod to dæg þurh gesyhðe for hym.

text: Ðā lǣrdon þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā hlāfordas þæt folc þæt hig bǣdon Barrabban, and þone Hǣlend fordydon.
text_bare: Ða lærdon þæra sacerda ealdras and þa hlafordas þæt folc þæt hig bædon Barrabban, and þone Hælend fordydon.

text: Ðā andwyrde sē dēma and sǣde heom, Hwæþerne wylle gē þæt ic forgyfe ēow of þisum twām?
text_bare: Ða andwyrde se dema and sæde heom, Hwæþerne wylle ge þæt ic forgyfe eow of þisum twam?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Barrabban.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Barrabban.

text: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō heom, Witodlīce hwæt dō ic be þām Hǣlende þe is Crīst genemned?
text_bare: Þa cwæð Pilatus to heom, Witodlice hwæt do ic be þam Hælende þe is Crist genemned?

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig ealle, Sȳ hē on rōde āhangen.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig ealle, Sy he on rode ahangen.

text: Ðā cwæð sē dēma tō heom, Witodlīce hwæt yfeles dyde þēs?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se dema to heom, Witodlice hwæt yfeles dyde þes?

text: Hī ðā swīþor clypodon þus cweðende, Sȳ hē āhangen.
text_bare: Hi ða swiþor clypodon þus cweðende, Sy he ahangen.

text: Ðā geseah Pilatus þæt hyt nāht ne fremode, ac gewurde māre gehlȳd, þā genam hē wæter and þwōh hys handa beforan þām folce, and cwæð, Unscyldig ic eom fram þyses rihtwīsan blōde; gē gesēoð.
text_bare: Ða geseah Pilatus þæt hyt naht ne fremode, ac gewurde mare gehlyd, þa genam he wæter and þwoh hys handa beforan þam folce, and cwæð, Unscyldig ic eom fram þyses rihtwisan blode; ge geseoð.

text: Ðā andswarode eall þæt folc and cwæð, Sȳ hys blōd ofer ūs and ofer ūre bearn.
text_bare: Ða andswarode eall þæt folc and cwæð, Sy hys blod ofer us and ofer ure bearn.

text: Ðā forgeaf hē hym Barrabban; and þone Hǣlynd hē lēt swingan, and sealde heom tō āhōnne.
text_bare: Ða forgeaf he hym Barrabban; and þone Hælynd he let swingan, and sealde heom to ahonne.

text: Þā underfēngon þæs dēman cempan þone Hǣlynd on ðām dōmerne, and gegaderodon ealne þone ðrēat tō heom;
text_bare: Þa underfengon þæs deman cempan þone Hælynd on ðam domerne, and gegaderodon ealne þone ðreat to heom;

text: and unscrȳddon hyne hys āgenum rēafe, and scrȳddon hyne mid weolcenrēadum scyccelse;
text_bare: and unscryddon hyne hys agenum reafe, and scryddon hyne mid weolcenreadum scyccelse;

text: and wundon cynehelm of þornum, and āsetton ofer hys hēafod, and hrēod on hys swīðran; and bīgdon heora cnēow beforan him, and bysmorudun hyne þuss cweþende,
text_bare: and wundon cynehelm of þornum, and asetton ofer hys heafod, and hreod on hys swiðran; and bigdon heora cneow beforan him, and bysmorudun hyne þuss cweþende,

text: Hāl wes þū, Iudea Cyning!
text_bare: Hal wes þu, Iudea Cyning!

text: and spǣtton on hyne, and nāmon hrēod and bēotun hys hēafod.
text_bare: and spætton on hyne, and namon hreod and beotun hys heafod.

text: And æfter þām þe hig hyne þus bysmerodon, hig unscrȳddon hyne þām scyccelse, and scrȳddon hyne mid hys āgenum rēafe, and lǣddon hyne tō āhōnne.
text_bare: And æfter þam þe hig hyne þus bysmerodon, hig unscryddon hyne þam scyccelse, and scryddon hyne mid hys agenum reafe, and læddon hyne to ahonne.

text: Sōþlīce ðā hig ūt fērdon, þā gemētton hig ǣnne Cyreniscne mann cumende heom tōgēnes, þæs nama wæs Symon; þone hig nȳddon þæt hē bǣre hys rōde.
text_bare: Soþlice ða hig ut ferdon, þa gemetton hig ænne Cyreniscne mann cumende heom togenes, þæs nama wæs Symon; þone hig nyddon þæt he bære hys rode.

text: Ðā cōmon hig on þā stōwe þe ys genemned Golgotha, þæt is, hēafodpannan stōw.
text_bare: Ða comon hig on þa stowe þe ys genemned Golgotha, þæt is, heafodpannan stow.

text: And hig sealdon hym wīn drincan, wið geallan gemenged; and þā hē hys onbyrigde, þā nolde hē hyt drincan.
text_bare: And hig sealdon hym win drincan, wið geallan gemenged; and þa he hys onbyrigde, þa nolde he hyt drincan.

text: Sōþlīce ǣfter þām þe hig hyne on rōde āhēngon, hig tōdǣldon hys rēaf, and wurpon hlot þǣr ofer: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, and þus cwæð, Hig tōdǣldon heom mīne rēaf, and ofer mīne rēaf hig wurpon hlot.
text_bare: Soþlice æfter þam þe hig hyne on rode ahengon, hig todældon hys reaf, and wurpon hlot þær ofer: þæt wære gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh ðone witegan, and þus cwæð, Hig todældon heom mine reaf, and ofer mine reaf hig wurpon hlot.

text: And hig behēoldon hyne, sittende.
text_bare: And hig beheoldon hyne, sittende.

text: And hig āsetton ofer hys hēafod hys gylt þuss āwritenne, Ðis ys sē Hǣlynd, Iudea Cyning
text_bare: And hig asetton ofer hys heafod hys gylt þuss awritenne, Ðis ys se Hælynd, Iudea Cyning

text: Ðā wǣron āhangen mid hym twēgen sceaþan, ān on þā swīðran healfe, and ōðer on þā wynstran.
text_bare: Ða wæron ahangen mid hym twegen sceaþan, an on þa swiðran healfe, and oðer on þa wynstran.

text: Witodlīce þā wegfērendan hyne bysmeredon, and cwehton heora hēafod,
text_bare: Witodlice þa wegferendan hyne bysmeredon, and cwehton heora heafod,

text: And cwǣdon, Wā þæt ðēs tōwyrpð Godes templ, and on þrīm dagum hyt eft getimbrað; gehǣl nū þē sylfne; gyf þū sȳ Godes Sunu, gā nyþer of þǣre rōde.
text_bare: And cwædon, Wa þæt ðes towyrpð Godes templ, and on þrim dagum hyt eft getimbrað; gehæl nu þe sylfne; gyf þu sy Godes Sunu, ga nyþer of þære rode.

text: Ēac þǣra sācerda ealdras hyne bysmeredon mid þām bōcerum and mid þam ealdrum, and cwǣdun,
text_bare: Eac þæra sacerda ealdras hyne bysmeredon mid þam bocerum and mid þam ealdrum, and cwædun,

text: Ōþere hē gehǣlde, and hyne sylfne gehǣlan ne mæg.
text_bare: Oþere he gehælde, and hyne sylfne gehælan ne mæg.

text: Gyf hē Israhela Cyning sȳ, gā nū nyþer of þǣre rōde, and wē gelȳfað hym.
text_bare: Gyf he Israhela Cyning sy, ga nu nyþer of þære rode, and we gelyfað hym.

text: Hē gelȳfð on God; ālȳse hē hyne nū, gyf hē wylle: witodlice hē sǣde, Godes Sunu ic eom.
text_bare: He gelyfð on God; alyse he hyne nu, gyf he wylle: witodlice he sæde, Godes Sunu ic eom.

text: Gelīce þā sceaðan þe mid him āhangene wǣron hyne hyspdun.
text_bare: Gelice þa sceaðan þe mid him ahangene wæron hyne hyspdun.

text: Witodlīce fram þǣre sixtan tīde wǣron geworden þȳstru ofer ealle eorðan oþ þā nigoþan tīd.
text_bare: Witodlice fram þære sixtan tide wæron geworden þystru ofer ealle eorðan oþ þa nigoþan tid.

text: And ymbe þā nygoðan tīd clypode sē Hǣlend mycelre stefne and þuss cwæð, Heli, Heli, lema zabdani?
text_bare: And ymbe þa nygoðan tid clypode se Hælend mycelre stefne and þuss cwæð, Heli, Heli, lema zabdani?

text: þæt ys on englisc, Mīn God, mīn God, tō hwī forlēte þū me?
text_bare: þæt ys on englisc, Min God, min God, to hwi forlete þu me?

text: Sōþlīce sume þā ðe þǣr stōdon and þis gehȳrdon cwǣdon, Nū hē clypað Heliam.
text_bare: Soþlice sume þa ðe þær stodon and þis gehyrdon cwædon, Nu he clypað Heliam.

text: Ðā hrædlīce arn ān heora and genam āne spongean, and fylde hig mid ecede, and āsette ān hrēod þǣr on, and sealde hym drincan.
text_bare: Ða hrædlice arn an heora and genam ane spongean, and fylde hig mid ecede, and asette an hreod þær on, and sealde hym drincan.

text: Witodlīce þā ōðre cwǣdon, Lǣt; utun gesēon hwæþer Helias cume, and wylle hyne ālȳsan.
text_bare: Witodlice þa oðre cwædon, Læt; utun geseon hwæþer Helias cume, and wylle hyne alysan.

text: Þā clypode sē Hǣlynd eft mycelre stefne, and āsende hys gāst.
text_bare: Þa clypode se Hælynd eft mycelre stefne, and asende hys gast.

text: And þǣrrihte ðæs temples wāhryft wearð tōsliten on twēgen dǣlas fram ufeweardon oð nyþeweard; and sēo eorðe bifode; and stanas tōburston;
