text_bare: And þærrihte ðæs temples wahryft wearð tosliten on twegen dælas fram ufeweardon oð nyþeweard; and seo eorðe bifode; and stanas toburston;

text: and byrgena wurdun geopenode; and manige hālige līchaman ðe ǣr slēpon āryson;
text_bare: and byrgena wurdun geopenode; and manige halige lichaman ðe ær slepon aryson;

text: and þā hig ūt ēodon of þām byrgenum æfter hys ǣryste, hig cōmun on þā hāligan ceastre, and ætēowdon hig manegum.
text_bare: and þa hig ut eodon of þam byrgenum æfter hys æryste, hig comun on þa haligan ceastre, and æteowdon hig manegum.

text: Witodlīce þæs hundredes ealdor, and ðā þe mid him wǣron healdende þone Hǣlynd, þā hig gesāwon þā eorðbifunge and þā ðing ðe þǣr gewurdon, hig ondrēdon heom ðearle, and cwǣdon, Sōðlīce Godes Sunu wæs þēs.
text_bare: Witodlice þæs hundredes ealdor, and ða þe mid him wæron healdende þone Hælynd, þa hig gesawon þa eorðbifunge and þa ðing ðe þær gewurdon, hig ondredon heom ðearle, and cwædon, Soðlice Godes Sunu wæs þes.

text: Witodlīce þǣr wǣron manega wīf feorran, þā ðe fyligdon þām Hǣlende fram Galilea, him ðēnigende.
text_bare: Witodlice þær wæron manega wif feorran, þa ðe fyligdon þam Hælende fram Galilea, him ðenigende.

text: Betwuh þām wæs sēo Magdalenisce Maria, and Maria Iacobes mōder and Iosephes mōdur, and Zebedeis sunena mōdor.
text_bare: Betwuh þam wæs seo Magdalenisce Maria, and Maria Iacobes moder and Iosephes modur, and Zebedeis sunena modor.

text: Sōðlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, cōm sum welig mann of Arimathia, þæs nama wæs Iosep, sē sylfa wæs þæs Hǣlyndes leorningcniht.
text_bare: Soðlice þa hyt æfen wæs, com sum welig mann of Arimathia, þæs nama wæs Iosep, se sylfa wæs þæs Hælyndes leorningcniht.

text: Hē genēalǣhte tō Pilate, and bæd þæs Hǣlyndes līchaman.
text_bare: He genealæhte to Pilate, and bæd þæs Hælyndes lichaman.

text: Ðā hēt Pilatus āgyfan him þone līchaman.
text_bare: Ða het Pilatus agyfan him þone lichaman.

text: And Iosep genam þone līchaman, and bewand hyne mid clǣnre scȳtan,
text_bare: And Iosep genam þone lichaman, and bewand hyne mid clænre scytan,

text: and lēde hyne on hys nīwan byrgene, ðā hē āhēow on stāne; and hē tō āwylte mycelne stān tō hlide þǣre byrgene, and fērde syþþan.
text_bare: and lede hyne on hys niwan byrgene, ða he aheow on stane; and he to awylte mycelne stan to hlide þære byrgene, and ferde syþþan.

text: Ðǣr wæs sōðlīce sēo Magdalenisce Maria and sēo ōðer Maria, sittende æt þǣre byrgene.
text_bare: Ðær wæs soðlice seo Magdalenisce Maria and seo oðer Maria, sittende æt þære byrgene.

text: Witodlīce ōðrum dæge þe wæs gearcungdæg, cōmon tōgædere þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā sundorhālgan tō Pilate,
text_bare: Witodlice oðrum dæge þe wæs gearcungdæg, comon togædere þæra sacerda ealdras and þa sundorhalgan to Pilate,

text: and cwǣdon, Hlāford, wē gemunon þæt sē swica sǣde, þā hē on līfe wæs, Æfter þrȳm dagon ic ārīse.
text_bare: and cwædon, Hlaford, we gemunon þæt se swica sæde, þa he on life wæs, Æfter þrym dagon ic arise.

text: Hāt nū healdan þā byrgene oð þone þryddan dæg, þē lǣs hys leorningcnihtas cumon and forstelon hyne, and secgeon þām folce þæt hē āryse of dēaþe; þonne byð þæt æftre gedwyld wyrse þonne þæt ǣrre.
text_bare: Hat nu healdan þa byrgene oð þone þryddan dæg, þe læs hys leorningcnihtas cumon and forstelon hyne, and secgeon þam folce þæt he aryse of deaþe; þonne byð þæt æftre gedwyld wyrse þonne þæt ærre.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus, Gē habbað heordrǣdenne; farað, and healdað swā swā gē witon.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus, Ge habbað heordrædenne; farað, and healdað swa swa ge witon.

text: Sōþlīce hig fērdon, and ymbetrymedon þā byrgene, and innseglodon þone stān, mid þām weardum.
text_bare: Soþlice hig ferdon, and ymbetrymedon þa byrgene, and innseglodon þone stan, mid þam weardum.

text: Sōðlīce þām restedæges ǣfene, sē þe onlīhte on þām forman restedæge, cōm sēo Magdalenisce Maria and sēo ōðer Maria þæt hig woldon gesēon þā byrgene.
text_bare: Soðlice þam restedæges æfene, se þe onlihte on þam forman restedæge, com seo Magdalenisce Maria and seo oðer Maria þæt hig woldon geseon þa byrgene.

text: And þǣr wearð geworden micel eorþbifung; witodlīce Drihtenes engel āstāh of heofenan, and genēalǣhte and āwylte þone stān, and sæt þǣr onuppan.
text_bare: And þær wearð geworden micel eorþbifung; witodlice Drihtenes engel astah of heofenan, and genealæhte and awylte þone stan, and sæt þær onuppan.

text: Hys ansȳn wæs swylce līgyt, and hys rēaf swā hwīte swā snāw.
text_bare: Hys ansyn wæs swylce ligyt, and hys reaf swa hwite swa snaw.

text: Witodlīce þā weardas wǣron āfyrhte, and wǣron gewordene swylce hig dēade wǣron.
text_bare: Witodlice þa weardas wæron afyrhte, and wæron gewordene swylce hig deade wæron.

text: Ðā andswarode sē engel and sǣde þām wīfon, Ne ondrǣde gē ēow; ic wāt witodlīce þæt gē sēceað þone Hǣlynd þone þe on rōde āhangen wæs.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se engel and sæde þam wifon, Ne ondræde ge eow; ic wat witodlice þæt ge seceað þone Hælynd þone þe on rode ahangen wæs.

text: Nys hē hēr; hē ārās sōðlīce, swā swā hē sǣde.
text_bare: Nys he her; he aras soðlice, swa swa he sæde.

text: Cumað, and gesēoþ þā stōwe þe sē Hǣlynd wæs on ālēd.
text_bare: Cumað, and geseoþ þa stowe þe se Hælynd wæs on aled.

text: And farað hrædlīce, and secgeað hys leorningcnihtum þæt hē ārās; and sōðlīce hē cymð beforan ēow on Galileam; þǣr gē hyne gesēoþ: nū ic secge ēow.
text_bare: And farað hrædlice, and secgeað hys leorningcnihtum þæt he aras; and soðlice he cymð beforan eow on Galileam; þær ge hyne geseoþ: nu ic secge eow.

text: Ðā fērdon hig hrædlīce fram þǣre byrgene mid ege and mid myclum gefēan, and urnon and cȳðdon hyt hys leorningcnihton.
text_bare: Ða ferdon hig hrædlice fram þære byrgene mid ege and mid myclum gefean, and urnon and cyðdon hyt hys leorningcnihton.

text: And efne þā cōm sē Hǣlynd ongēan hig, and cwæð, Hāle wese gē.
text_bare: And efne þa com se Hælynd ongean hig, and cwæð, Hale wese ge.

text: Hig genēalǣhton, and genāmon hys fēt and tō him geēaðmēddon.
text_bare: Hig genealæhton, and genamon hys fet and to him geeaðmeddon.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlynd tō heom, Ne ondrǣde gē ēow; farað, and cȳþað mīnum gebrōþrum þæt hig faron on Galileam, þǣr hig gesēoþ mē.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælynd to heom, Ne ondræde ge eow; farað, and cyþað minum gebroþrum þæt hig faron on Galileam, þær hig geseoþ me.

text: Þā þā hig fērdon, þā cōmon sume þā weardas on þā ceastre, and cȳðdon þǣra sācerda ealdrum ealle þā ðing þe ðǣr gewordene wǣron.
text_bare: Þa þa hig ferdon, þa comon sume þa weardas on þa ceastre, and cyðdon þæra sacerda ealdrum ealle þa ðing þe ðær gewordene wæron.

text: Ðā gesamnudon þā ealdras hig, and worhtun gemōt, and sealdon þām ðegenum micyl feoh, and cwǣdon,
text_bare: Ða gesamnudon þa ealdras hig, and worhtun gemot, and sealdon þam ðegenum micyl feoh, and cwædon,

text: Secgeað þæt hys leorningcnihtas cōmon nihtes, and forstǣlan hyne ðā wē slēpun.
text_bare: Secgeað þæt hys leorningcnihtas comon nihtes, and forstælan hyne ða we slepun.

text: And gyf sē dēma þiss geāxað, wē lǣrað hyne, and gedōð ēow sorhlēase.
text_bare: And gyf se dema þiss geaxað, we lærað hyne, and gedoð eow sorhlease.

text: Ðā onfēngon hig þæs fēos, and dydon eall swā hig gelǣrede wǣron; and þis word wæs gewīdmǣrsod mid Iudeum oð þisne andweardan dæg.
text_bare: Ða onfengon hig þæs feos, and dydon eall swa hig gelærede wæron; and þis word wæs gewidmærsod mid Iudeum oð þisne andweardan dæg.

text: Ðā fērdon þā endlufun leorningcnihtas on þone munt þǣr sē Hǣlynd heom dihte,
text_bare: Ða ferdon þa endlufun leorningcnihtas on þone munt þær se Hælynd heom dihte,

text: and hyne þǣr gesāwun, and hig tō him geēaðmēddun; witodlīce sume hig twēonedon.
text_bare: and hyne þær gesawun, and hig to him geeaðmeddun; witodlice sume hig tweonedon.

text: Ðā genēalǣhte sē Hǣlynd, and spræc tō heom þās þing and þuss cwæð, Mē is geseald ǣlc anweald on heofonan and on eorðan.
text_bare: Ða genealæhte se Hælynd, and spræc to heom þas þing and þuss cwæð, Me is geseald ælc anweald on heofonan and on eorðan.

text: Farað witodlīce and lǣrað ealle þēoda, and fulligeað hig on naman Fæder, and Suna, and þæs Hālgan Gāstes;
text_bare: Farað witodlice and lærað ealle þeoda, and fulligeað hig on naman Fæder, and Suna, and þæs Halgan Gastes;

text: and lǣrað þæt hig healdon ealle þā ðing þe ic ēow bebēad.
text_bare: and lærað þæt hig healdon ealle þa ðing þe ic eow bebead.

text: And ic bēo mid ēow ealle dagas oð worulde geendunge.
text_bare: And ic beo mid eow ealle dagas oð worulde geendunge.

text: Amen.
text_bare: Amen.
